descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Device Physics

__


Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conducting applied research in the area of power device physics with focus on dielectric insulation, breakdown phenomena, and other multi-physics topics

  • Contributing to and leading research projects towards sustainable solutions for the upcoming energy transformation, integration of renewable energies and energy storage systems

  • Applying commercial and in-house developed advanced simulation tools

  • Planning, setting up, and executing scientific experiments

  • Driving research activities, generating intellectual property, and writing scientific publications

  • Closely cooperating with scientists and engineers within the team, driving collaborations within the research center, with universities, and global ABB divisions

In this role, as a member of the Power Device Physics team, within Energy Technologies department, you work on the broad portfolio of ABB devices and systems from longer-term fundamental research up to time-critical questions in products. You provide novel and innovative solutions in the field of dielectric insulation in gases and solids with overlap to other multi-physical topics. Translating your findings from basic research on physical phenomena to prototypes demonstrating the technologies, you contribute to evolving applications in such fields as protection systems for sustainable energy generation and distribution. To achieve this, you utilize state-of-the-art simulations, perform scientific experiments, and apply the results to technology development and expert support of ABBs business divisions.


Reporting to the research team manager, you will engage with cross-functional teams inside and outside the company, contribute to the definition of the team research roadmap, and to the management of the research projects.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in physics or electrical engineering, background in dielectric is a plus (please submit a list of publications if available).

  • Hands-on experience in a scientific or industrial laboratory, a willingness to work independently and take initiatives in designing, building, and testing prototypes

  • Experience in simulations, e.g., COMSOL

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach with good ability to build and maintain work relationships

  • Strong communication and presentation skills in English (both written and spoken)

​More about us

The Power Device Physics Team at the ABB research center in Switzerland conducts interdisciplinary research focusing on multi-physical phenomena related to the broad portfolio of ABB's devices and systems, including switchgear and power electronics. The team consists of enthusiastic scientists and engineers whose activities span from deepening the knowledge of physical phenomena such as dielectric breakdowns in gases/solids/vacuum, or thermal management with novel cooling concepts, to solving questions directly related to ABB's product portfolio. Our expertise and solutions are used to enable and support the development of next-generation products. This unique opportunity allows you to carry out research in an evolving field and to contribute with your expertise to ABB’s success by reinforcing our team. If you are passionate about science and technology and want to work in an inspiring environment where your skills and ideas become part of solutions for a sustainable future, then apply now.


This recruitment process is managed by Pedro Labian, Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Manager Production Development

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, equipment performance, and materials/components in support of production targets. You will also showcase your expertise by defining the working phase sequence of a new production process to achieve the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

The work model for the role is onsite.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Drive process optimization and digitalization initiatives across Battery and Converter Production by analyzing and improving production processes, shopfloor workflows, and the interaction between machines, systems, and operators.

  • Manage and further develop production data, reporting solutions, and manufacturing systems, including MES, ERP, smart tools, Power BI, and related applications.

  • Support the reliability of digital shopfloor infrastructure and provide hands-on troubleshooting for manufacturing equipment, OT systems, industrial networks, interfaces, and other production systems.

  • Support the transition from engineering to manufacturing and coordinate the implementation, testing, rollout, documentation, and training of manufacturing solutions, including product data flows, PLM processes, BOM transformations, and design guidelines.


• Qualifications for the role

  • University degree in engineering or a related technical field, or a strong technical background combined with relevant industrial experience, for example in production, assembly, testing, or maintenance.

  • Basic digital know-how and a strong interest in digital manufacturing, production systems, PLM topics, and the use of 3D models in manufacturing processes.

  • Practical understanding of industrial operations and shopfloor requirements, ideally within battery or converter manufacturing.

  • Ability to analyze production processes, workflows, manufacturing machines, and production plants, identify improvement potential, and translate findings into structured and practical solutions.

  • Interest in production data analysis and familiarity with manufacturing systems such as MES, ERP, Power BI, smart tools, OT systems, or industrial networks.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with Production, Engineering, Maintenance, IT, and other stakeholders. Fluency in German and English is required.

  • High motivation, curiosity, and willingness to take responsibility; basic knowledge of BOM structures, PLM processes, or troubleshooting of digital shopfloor systems is an advantage.



More about us

The ABB Traction Division is a recognized market leader in drive technologies for rail vehicles, buses, and industrial vehicles, driving innovation in electrification.

Our comprehensive portfolio of high-performance traction, auxiliary, and energy storage solutions – all managed across the entire life cycle – helps to improve energy efficiency and make transportation more sustainable.

Together, we make a difference for our customers every single day. We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruitment process is led by Talent Acquisition Partner Gema de Vicente.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

• Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

In dieser Position haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die Montagemethoden, Prozesse und Anlagen der Produktionsorganisation zu optimieren, um den Arbeitsaufwand im Einklang mit den Unternehmensstrategien hinsichtlich Qualität, Effizienz, Kosten und Sicherheit zu minimieren. Sie stellen täglich sicher, dass geeignete Produktionsmethoden, Zykluszeiten, Anlagenleistungen sowie Materialien und Komponenten zur Erreichung der Produktionsziele eingesetzt werden. Darüber hinaus bringen Sie Ihre Expertise ein, indem Sie die Arbeitsabläufe neuer Produktionsprozesse definieren, um die angestrebten Produktkosten und das Investitionsbudget für Anlagen einzuhalten.

Der Arbeitsort für diese Position ist vor Ort.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:

  • Vorantreiben von Prozessoptimierungs- und Digitalisierungsinitiativen in der Batterie- und Konverterproduktion durch Analyse und Verbesserung von Produktionsprozessen, Shopfloor-Abläufen sowie der Interaktion zwischen Maschinen, Systemen und Mitarbeitenden.

  • Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Produktionsdaten, Reporting-Lösungen und Manufacturing-Systemen, einschließlich MES, ERP, Smart Tools, Power BI und verwandter Anwendungen.

  • Sicherstellung der Zuverlässigkeit der digitalen Shopfloor-Infrastruktur sowie praktische Unterstützung bei der Fehleranalyse und Störungsbehebung von Produktionsanlagen, OT-Systemen, industriellen Netzwerken, Schnittstellen und weiteren Produktionssystemen.

  • Unterstützung des Übergangs von der Entwicklung in die Fertigung sowie Koordination der Implementierung, Tests, Einführung, Dokumentation und Schulung von Fertigungslösungen, einschließlich Produktdatenflüssen, PLM-Prozessen, Stücklisten-Transformationen (BOM) und Konstruktionsrichtlinien.

Qualifikationen für diese Position

  • Hochschulabschluss im Ingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten technischen Fachgebiet oder ein fundierter technischer Hintergrund kombiniert mit einschlägiger Industrieerfahrung, beispielsweise in Produktion, Montage, Prüfung oder Instandhaltung.

  • Grundlegendes digitales Know-how sowie großes Interesse an digitaler Fertigung, Produktionssystemen, PLM-Themen und dem Einsatz von 3D-Modellen in Fertigungsprozessen.

  • Praktisches Verständnis industrieller Abläufe und Produktionsanforderungen, idealerweise im Bereich Batterie- oder Konverterfertigung.

  • Fähigkeit, Produktionsprozesse, Arbeitsabläufe, Fertigungsmaschinen und Produktionsanlagen zu analysieren, Verbesserungspotenziale zu identifizieren und die Erkenntnisse in strukturierte und praxisnahe Lösungen umzusetzen.

  • Interesse an der Analyse von Produktionsdaten sowie Kenntnisse von Fertigungssystemen wie MES, ERP, Power BI, Smart Tools, OT-Systemen oder industriellen Netzwerken.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion, Engineering, Instandhaltung, IT und weiteren Stakeholdern. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich.

  • Hohe Motivation, Neugier und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Grundkenntnisse in Stücklistenstrukturen (BOM), PLM-Prozessen oder der Fehlerbehebung digitaler Shopfloor-Systeme sind von Vorteil.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Universitätsabschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich oder einen starken technischen Hintergrund in Kombination mit relevanten industriellen Erfahrungen, zum Beispiel in der Produktion, Montage, Prüfung oder Wartung.

  • Grundlegendes digitales Know-how und ein starkes Interesse an digitaler Fertigung, Produktionssystemen, PLM-Themen und dem Einsatz von 3D-Modellen in Fertigungsprozessen.

  • Praktisches Verständnis von industriellen Abläufen und Shopfloor-Anforderungen, idealerweise in der Batterie- oder Wandlerfertigung.

  • Fähigkeit, Produktionsprozesse, Arbeitsabläufe, Fertigungsmaschinen und Produktionsanlagen zu analysieren, Verbesserungspotenziale zu identifizieren und Erkenntnisse in strukturierte und praktische Lösungen umzusetzen.

  • Interesse an Produktionsdatenanalyse und Vertrautheit mit Fertigungssystemen wie MES, ERP, Power BI, Smart Tools, OT-Systemen oder industriellen Netzwerken.

  • Starke Kommunikations- und Zusammenarbeitsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, sich effektiv mit Produktion, Engineering, Wartung, IT und anderen Stakeholdern zu koordinieren. Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch sind erforderlich.

  • Hohe Motivation, Neugier und Verantwortungsbereitschaft; Grundkenntnisse über Stücklistenstrukturen, PLM-Prozesse oder die Fehlersuche bei digitalen Shopfloor-Systemen sind von Vorteil.



Mehr über uns

Die ABB Traction Division ist anerkannter Marktführer für Antriebstechnologien für Schienenfahrzeuge, Busse und Industriefahrzeuge, die Innovationen in der Elektrifizierung vorantreiben.

Unser umfassendes Portfolio an leistungsstarken Traktions-, Hilfs- und Energiespeicherlösungen – alle über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg verwaltet – trägt dazu bei, die Energieeffizienz zu verbessern und den Transport nachhaltiger zu gestalten.

Gemeinsam machen wir jeden Tag einen Unterschied für unsere Kunden. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez-nous à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Cette position fait rapport à:

Développement de la production des gestionnaires

Votre rôle et responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la possibilité d'optimiser les méthodes d'assemblage de l'organisation de production, les processus et l'équipement pour minimiser les heures de travail conformément aux stratégies d'affaires liées à la qualité, l'efficacité, les coûts et la sécurité. Chaque jour, vous assurerez les méthodes de production, le temps de cycle, la performance de l'équipement et les matériaux/composants appropriés à l'appui des objectifs de production. Vous présenterez également votre expertise en définissant la séquence de la phase de travail d'un nouveau processus de production pour atteindre le budget d'investissement ciblé en matière de coûts et d'équipement.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est sur place.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Mettre en oeuvre des initiatives d'optimisation des processus et de numérisation dans l'ensemble de la production de piles et de convertisseurs en analysant et en améliorant les processus de production, les flux de travail et l'interaction entre les machines, les systèmes et les opérateurs.

  • Gérer et développer davantage les données de production, les solutions de déclaration et les systèmes de fabrication, y compris le MES, le PGI, les outils intelligents, le Power BI et les applications connexes.

  • Soutenir la fiabilité de l'infrastructure d'atelier numérique et fournir un dépannage pratique pour les équipements de fabrication, les systèmes OT, les réseaux industriels, les interfaces et autres systèmes de production.

  • Appuyer la transition de l'ingénierie à la fabrication et coordonner la mise en oeuvre, la mise à l'essai, le déploiement, la documentation et la formation des solutions de fabrication, y compris les flux de données sur les produits, les processus PLM, les transformations BOM et les lignes directrices de conception.


• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Diplôme universitaire en génie ou dans un domaine technique connexe, ou une solide expérience technique associée à une expérience industrielle pertinente, par exemple en production, en montage, en essai ou en maintenance.

  • Le savoir-faire numérique de base et un vif intérêt pour la fabrication numérique, les systèmes de production, les sujets de PLM et l'utilisation de modèles 3D dans les processus de fabrication.

  • Compréhension pratique des opérations industrielles et des exigences de l'atelier, idéalement dans la fabrication de piles ou de convertisseurs.

  • Capacité d'analyser les processus de production, les flux de travail, les machines de fabrication et les usines de production, de déterminer le potentiel d'amélioration et de traduire les résultats en solutions structurées et pratiques.

  • Intérêt pour l'analyse des données de production et la connaissance des systèmes de fabrication tels que MES, ERP, Power BI, des outils intelligents, des systèmes OT ou des réseaux industriels.

  • Fortes compétences en communication et en collaboration, avec la capacité de coordonner efficacement avec la production, l'ingénierie, la maintenance, les TI et d'autres intervenants. La maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais est requise.

  • La grande motivation, la curiosité et la volonté de prendre des responsabilités; la connaissance de base des structures du BOM, des processus du PLM ou du dépannage des systèmes numériques d'atelier sont un avantage.



Plus sur nous

La Division de la traction ABB est un leader reconnu sur le marché des technologies d'entraînement pour les véhicules ferroviaires, les autobus et les véhicules industriels. Notre portefeuille complet de solutions de traction, auxiliaires et de stockage d'énergie de haute performance – toutes gérées tout au long du cycle de vie – contribue à améliorer l'efficacité énergétique et à rendre le transport plus durable.

Ensemble, nous faisons une différence pour nos clients tous les jours. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre demande.

Le processus de recrutement est dirigé par Talent Acquisition Partner Gema de Vicente.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

• Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

En dieser Position haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die Montagemethoden, Prozesse und Anlagen der Produktionsorganisation zu optimieren, um den Arbeitsaufwand im Einklang mit den Unternehmensstrategien hinsichtlich Qualität, Effizienz, Kosten und Sicherheit zu minimiren. Sie stellen täglich sicher, dass geeignete Produktionsmethoden, Zykluszeiten, Anlagenleistungen sowie Materialien und Komposenten zur Erreichung der Produktionsziele eingesetzt werden. En outre, il est possible d'obtenir des données sur les activités de l'industrie de l'Union européenne. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich.

  • Hohe Motivation, Neugier und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Grundkenntnisse in Stücklistenstrukturen (BOM), PLM-Prozessen oder der Fehlerbehebung digitaler Shopfloor-Systeme sind von Vorteil.

    • Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Communications Leader

__

Your role and responsibilities

Do you thrive on turning big ideas into memorable live marketing experiences? We are looking for a Marketing Allrounder with a focus on events for the Swiss market who combines strong customer focus, compelling storytelling, smart budget management, and seamless execution.

With a genuine interest in technical products, you know how to translate our solutions into engaging messages that resonate with local target audiences and address market needs. As a hands-on team player with a strong performance mindset, you are comfortable managing multiple priorities and rolling up your sleeves to make things happen. Creating impact across both physical and digital touchpoints comes naturally to you.

In this role, you will work closely with our local Sales and Product Marketing teams, as well as with a dynamic Marketing & Communications team that is passionate about creating impact.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role reports to the Marketing & Communications Manager for the Electrification Business Area in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Bringing live marketing experiences to life by planning and delivering small to big customer events and trade shows from concept through execution and evaluation.

  • Leveraging our CRM and Account Engagement tools to support campaign execution, audience engagement, lead management, and performance tracking.

  • Managing agencies and external partners, ensuring high-quality delivery on time and within budget.

  • Localizing global campaigns for the Swiss market and activating them across relevant digital channels, adapting content, messaging, and assets to local audiences and market needs.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

  • Approximately 5–8 years of experience in marketing and event management, preferably within a B2B or industrial environment. An established industry network is considered a advantage.

  • Native-level German, fluency in English, and very good proficiency in French.

  • Experience sourcing, negotiating with, and managing suppliers and partners.

  • Excellent time-management, organizational, and multitasking skills.

  • Outstanding communication and stakeholder-management skills, with a collaborative and solution-oriented approach.

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI in daily marketing to streamline workflows, enhance content, and improve customer experiences.

More about us

ABB Electrification is a global technology leader enabling the efficient and reliable distribution of electricity from source to socket. With more than 50,000 employees across 100 countries, we collaborate with our customers and partners to solve the world’s greatest challenges in electrical distribution and energy management. As the energy transition accelerates and electricity demands grow, we are electrifying the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. At ABB, we are ‘Engineered to Outrun’, and we are passionate about helping our customers and partners do the same.

The recruitment process is being led by Reto Korstick, Talent & Acquisition Partner.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Communications Manager - BL Mining & Materials

__

An opportunity has become available in ABB Swizterland as Marketing and Communications Specialist for our division Process Industries. In addition, 30% of the role will include leading assigned projects for the Global Business Line Mining & Materials.

The role holder is an enthusiastic team player, creative, proactive and self-motivated, and is familiar with digital marketing and marketing automation tools.

Reporting to the Global Business Line Communications and Marketing Manager for Mining & Materials, you work closely with the Local Management and Sales Teams and the Business Line Communications Leads to develop, localize and implement integrated marketing communications initiatives and campaigns to promote ABB’s portfolio and references to key stakeholders, including customers, trade media, influencers and employees.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to propose and implement communication plans. Each day, you will implement assigned marketing communications activities through all available communications tools according to group guidelines, directives, and messages, within the approved budget. You will also showcase your expertise by generating leads via advertising, sponsorship, and other promotional activities, using the internet as a hub for integrated marketing communications.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Act as a strategic communications partner to local management, identifying and driving internal and external communication priorities and opportunities, ensuring alignment with divisional objectives, with a strong focus on employee engagement, sales enablement and thought leadership

  • Lead internal communications and employee engagement, including town halls, leadership communications, internal channels, content creation, and employee recognition initiatives

  • Support sales and business growth through communications, developing sales materials, presentations, customer success stories, references, and other collateral that strengthen customer engagement, market visibility, and business results

  • Support global marketing and communications (30% of the role) for a designated product line within the Mining & Materials portfolio, by leading thought leadership, lead nurturing initiatives, product launches, sales enablement and social media presence


• Qualifications for the role

  • University’s degree preferably in journalism / communication / marketing / or related field

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in marketing communications, ideally in communication agency or related B2B industries

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage several projects at the same time

  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) in English with ability to explain technology in an easy and engaging way with strong writing, editing and proofreading capabilities

  • Creative personality and innovative mindset with the capacity to come with new and fresh ideas, while ensuring consistency with brand and BL positioning

  • A solution-focused and self-starter mindset combined with passion for strategic and analytical thinking

  • Knowledge of digital marketing and marketing automation (SalesForce, Pardot, etc)



More about us

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry-specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment; digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Mining, Pulp & Paper, Metals, Aluminum and Cement, Data centers and Food and Beverage.

The recruitment process is supported by Talent Partner Gema de Vicente.

This position reports to:

Principal Technical Support Engineer

__

In this role, you will support the development of hardware and software tools and procedures to ensure consistent and professional commissioning, diagnostics, and maintenance of Critical Power products (UPS, STS, power conditioning). You will analyze technical documentation and system behavior to provide guidance to software developers. You will test the tools at customer sites and in test environments. You will work with field service technicians to fully understand their workflows and identify opportunities to improve their performance.

This role contributes to the Global Service Engineering team. The main stakeholders are the product R&D teams, service software developers, and field service engineers.

You will join a newly formed, rapidly developing, globally focused team where you will be able to thrive.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing technical documentation to support the developers writing programs that support the field service technician’s jobs.

  • Testing new programs both in test areas and at customer site to ensure they work as expected.

  • Engaging with service technician to train them on the tool and learn from their usage to improve the tool.

  • Writing proposals for new Service applications, equipment, and methods.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • A bachelor’s degree, diploma, or higher academic qualification in Electrical or Electronic Engineering.

  • Several years of hands-on experience in commissioning, after-sales technical support, and advanced diagnostics of UPS, PCS, or energy storage solutions are beneficial.

  • Experience in commissioning and troubleshooting mission-critical applications such as data centers, high-volume industrial facilities, and critical infrastructure installations would be a plus.

  • Proficiency in both verbal and written English communication (B2 level or higher) Knowledge of any other language is a welcome asset.

  • The ability to write clear and concise technical documents, reports, and field support procedures.

  • A willingness to engage directly with clients and teams worldwide, with a travel commitment of up to 50%.

What does ABB have to offer you?

A versatile and varied full-time job of 40 hours within an international concern. ABB likes to invest in your development. • We offer you education, training and growth opportunities. Furthermore, we offer you:

  • a salary appropriate to your knowledge, experience and this position.

  • a thirteenth month.

  • 40 days off (27 holidays and 13 ADV). You have the option of converting part of your leave hours into salary.

  • a lease car.

  • an annual allowance for part of your sports subscription.

  • a good pension scheme.

  • a company phone and laptop.

Diese Rolle trägt zum Global Service Engineering Team bei. Die Hauptakteure sind die Produkt-R&D-Teams, Service-Software-Entwickler und Außendienstingenieure.

Sie werden einem neu gebildeten, sich schnell entwickelnden, global ausgerichteten Team beitreten, in dem Sie erfolgreich sein können.

  • Testen neuer Programme sowohl in Testbereichen als auch bei Kunden vor Ort, um sicherzustellen, dass sie wie erwartet funktionieren.

  • Erstellen von Vorschlägen für neue Service-Anwendungen, Geräte und Methoden.

  • Ein Bachelor-Abschluss, ein Diplom oder eine höhere akademische Qualifikation in Elektrotechnik oder Elektronik.

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Inbetriebnahme, After-Sales-technischer Support und fortgeschrittene Diagnose von USV-, PCS- oder Energiespeicherlösungen sind von Vorteil.

  • Erfahrung in der Inbetriebnahme und Fehlerbehebung unternehmenskritischer Anwendungen wie Rechenzentren, großvolumige Industrieanlagen und kritische Infrastrukturinstallationen wären ein Plus.

  • Kenntnisse in sowohl verbaler als auch schriftlicher englischer Kommunikation (B2-Niveau oder höher) Kenntnisse in jeder anderen Sprache sind ein willkommenes Gut.

  • Die Fähigkeit, klare und prägnante technische Dokumente, Berichte und Support-Verfahren zu schreiben.

  • Die Bereitschaft, sich direkt mit Kunden und Teams weltweit zu engagieren, mit einer Reiseverpflichtung von bis zu 50%.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Supervisor - Prototype Construction

__

Your Role

In this role, you support the Prototype Construction area in ensuring efficient material supply and coordinating prototype construction processes. You work closely with internal interfaces and make a significant contribution to timely and high-quality prototype manufacturing.


Work Model: On-site

This position supports the Electrification Smart Buildings division, Business Line Energy Distribution, in Schaffhausen.


Your Main • Responsibilities

  • Planning, coordination and implementation of prototype and sample construction orders in close collaboration with Development, Engineering, Production, Quality and SCM
  • Management of production, work and process documentation as well as bill of materials and manufacturing documents (creation, maintenance and updating)
  • Material flow management: ensuring timely material availability for prototypes and pre-series, monitoring material bottlenecks and initiating appropriate measures
  • Process optimization: planning and organization of workflows as well as continuous improvement according to Lean principles

Your • Qualifications

  • Completed technical vocational training
  • 3-5 years of professional experience in an industrial production or engineering environment, ideally in prototype, sample construction or manufacturing
  • Technical understanding and experience reading technical drawings and bill of materials
  • Good knowledge of ERP systems (SAP an advantage) and MS Office applications
  • Enjoyment of collaborating with different departments and coordinating various tasks
  • Strong communication skills with high self-initiative and hands-on mentality
  • Fluent German; English skills are an advantage

What We Offer

We want you to bring your full potential – your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You will receive the tools and freedom to further develop your skills, shape your own path and take on challenges that truly matter. Your work has visible and tangible impact every day.


Benefits

• We offer a range of attractive benefits to support your well-being and work-life balance:

  • REKA vouchers for leisure and travel
  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year
  • Various health and wellness benefits
  • Gym membership contribution

About Us

ABB Smart Buildings enables the optimization of energy efficiency, security and comfort for every building type through new installations or retrofit solutions. The division offers integrated digital technologies for controlling HVAC, lighting, blinds and security as well as energy distribution solutions, including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial connectors and sockets and conventional cabling accessories, suitable for single-family homes, multi-family residences, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications.

The division's highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve the worldwide increasing demand from real estate developers, owners and investors for intelligent building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to achieve significant sustainable and financial benefits, meet social and environmental requirements while being able to meet even the most complex customer carbon reduction strategies.


This recruitment process is supported by Ece Özen, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Head of Treasury


Reporting to the Corporate Treasurer of ABB Robotics, you will own and lead the Trade & Structured Finance function for the standalone company. You will be accountable for the full bank guarantee portfolio and facilities, and for developing the structured finance, receivables and supply chain finance solutions that optimize working capital and unlock liquidity for the business. You will design the operating model, systems and controls that support these activities, drive automation and AI across trade processes, and partner commercially with the business and banking market. Supported by a Trade Finance Specialist, and working closely with Treasury leadership, Finance, Legal, the business and banking partners, you will build and run a scalable, independent trade finance capability.

The work model for the role is hybrid; #LI-hybrid

The location of the role is within Europe

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Trade finance leadership & ownership: Owning the Trade & Structured Finance function end to end – setting strategy, standards and policy and acting as the accountable owner for guarantees, structured finance and working capital solutions across the group.

  • Bank guarantees & instruments: Owning the full guarantee portfolio and facilities – bank guarantees, parent company guarantees, surety bonds and standby letters of credit – including facility negotiation, the day-to-day lifecycle (issuance, amendment, extension, reduction, renewal, cancellation, claims), and guarantee fee management.

  • Guarantee operating model & systems: Owning the operating model and system solution for guarantee management: a structured process for subsidiary requests, tracking and approval, electronic transmission to banks, and record keeping (Komgo)

  • Structured finance, AR factoring & supply chain finance: Developing and implementing receivables (AR) factoring based on business requirements, supply chain / payables finance and structured trade finance solutions to optimize working capital and release liquidity; assessing feasibility, structuring programs, negotiating with providers, and ensuring correct documentation and accounting treatment.

  • Bank relationships: Managing trade finance banking relationships and the wider counterparty set; leading new bank onboarding, account opening and KYC / AML processes, and negotiating commercial terms and limits.

  • Covenants, controls & governance: Owning covenant monitoring and lender reporting for the trade finance perimeter, and establishing the internal controls, governance and compliance framework for the function.

  • AI & automation of trade processes: Driving automation and AI across the trade finance process – from request intake and issuance to tracking, reconciliation and reporting – leveraging the Trade Finance System and ERP (SAP S4), analytics and emerging tooling to build a low-touch, scalable operation.

  • Commercial partnering: Partnering with the business on tenders, bids and contracts, providing guarantee and financing solutions that support commercial wins while protecting the group’s risk and liquidity position.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Extensive treasury experience in global, multinational companies, with a strong track record leading trade finance and bank guarantee management.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise across guarantee instruments – bank guarantees, PCGs, surety bonds, standby letters of credit – including facility negotiation and guarantee-wording review.

  • Solid knowledge of structured finance, receivables (AR) factoring and supply chain / payables finance, including program structuring, provider negotiation and the accounting implications.

  • Practical experience of bank onboarding, KYC / AML, covenant frameworks and lender reporting in a multi-entity, multi-country context.

  • Experience applying AI and / or automation to trade finance processes.

  • A dynamic, highly agile and commercially aware professional with a strong ownership mindset, who thrives in fast-moving, international environments; carve-out or standalone build experience is an advantage.

  • Experience leading, developing and getting the best from a small team or direct report.

  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

What’s in it for you:

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
descriptionByLocale.it:
A ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a superare - più snella e più pulita. Qui, il progresso è un'aspettativa - per voi, la vostra squadra, e il mondo. Come leader di mercato globale, vi daremo quello che dovete fare per farlo accadere. Non sarà sempre facile, la crescita prende grinta. Ma ad ABB, non correrete mai da soli. Gestire ciò che dirige il mondo. Questo ruolo si trova all'interno del business di ABB Robotics, una società di robotica globale leader. Stiamo entrando in un nuovo capitolo emozionante come abbiamo annunciato il piano per SoftBank Group per acquisire ABB Robotics. SoftBank è un gruppo tecnologico riconosciuto a livello mondiale e investitore/operatore focalizzato su AI, robotica e computing di nuova generazione. Unendoci ora, sarai parte di un team pionieristico che modella il futuro della robotica – lavorando insieme ad esperti di livello mondiale in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione e guidato dall’innovazione. Questa posizione riferisce a:

Head of Treasury

Segnalando al Corporate Treasurer di ABB Robotics, possederai e guiderai la funzione Trade & Structured Finance per la società standalone. Sarete responsabili per l'intero portafoglio di garanzie bancarie e strutture, e per lo sviluppo del finanziamento strutturato, crediti e soluzioni di finanziamento della supply chain che ottimizzano il capitale di lavoro e sbloccano la liquidità per il business. Potrai progettare il modello operativo, sistemi e controlli che supportano queste attività, guidare l'automazione e l'IA attraverso i processi commerciali, e partner commerciali con il mercato aziendale e bancario. Sostenuto da uno specialista di finanza commerciale, e lavorando a stretto contatto con la leadership del Tesoro, finanza, legale, affari e partner bancari, costruirete e gestite una capacità scalabile, indipendente di finanza commerciale. Sarete principalmente responsabili per: A causa della funzione Trade & Structured Finance finiscono per porre fine alla strategia, agli standard e alla politica e fungere da responsabile proprietario per le garanzie, la finanza strutturata e le soluzioni di capitale di lavoro in tutto il gruppo. Grazie al portafoglio e alle strutture di garanzia – garanzie bancarie, garanzie della società madre, obbligazioni di sicurezza e lettere di credito – tra cui la negoziazione di strutture, il ciclo di vita diurno (emissione, modifica, estensione, riduzione, rinnovo, cancellazione, reclami), e la gestione della tassa di garanzia. A causa del modello operativo e della soluzione di sistema per la gestione della garanzia: un processo strutturato per richieste, monitoraggio e approvazione, trasmissione elettronica alle banche e mantenimento del record (Komgo) Sviluppare e implementare i crediti (AR) in base ai requisiti aziendali, alla supply chain / payables finanza e soluzioni di finanza commerciale strutturate per ottimizzare il capitale di lavoro e rilasciare liquidità; valutare la fattibilità, strutturare i programmi, negoziare con i fornitori e garantire la corretta documentazione e il trattamento contabile. Gestire le relazioni bancarie di finanza commerciale e il più ampio insieme di controparti; leader di nuove banche onboarding, apertura account e processi KYC / AML, e negoziare termini e limiti commerciali. Controllo del patto e rendicontazione del credito per il perimetro di finanza commerciale e definizione del quadro interno di controllo, governance e conformità per la funzione. Collaborare con l’azienda su offerte, offerte e contratti, fornendo soluzioni di garanzia e finanziamento che supportano le vincite commerciali, proteggendo la posizione di rischio e liquidità del gruppo. • Qualifiche per il ruolo: Estensiva esperienza di tesoreria in aziende globali e multinazionali, con una forte esperienza di finanza commerciale e di garanzia bancaria. Cosa c'è dentro per voi: Ti diamo il potere di prendere iniziative, sfidare idee e condurre con fiducia. Crescerai attraverso un lavoro significativo, un apprendimento continuo e un supporto che è su misura per i tuoi obiettivi. Ogni idea che si condivide e ogni azione che si prende contribuisce a qualcosa di più grande. Potrebbe essere la tua storia? Applicare oggi o visitare www.abb.com per saperne di più su di noi e conoscere l'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

Führe, was die Welt regiert.

>

Diese Rolle ist Teil des Robotics-Geschäfts von ABB, einem führenden globalen Robotik-Unternehmen. Wir treten in ein spannendes neues Kapitel ein, da wir den Plan für die SoftBank Group zur Übernahme von ABB Robotics angekündigt haben. SoftBank ist ein weltweit anerkannter Technologiekonzern und Investor / Betreiber, der sich auf KI, Robotik und Next-Generation-Computing konzentriert. Wenn Sie jetzt zu uns kommen, werden Sie Teil eines Pionierteams sein, das die Zukunft der Robotik gestaltet und mit erstklassigen Experten in einer sich schnell entwickelnden, innovationsgetriebenen Umgebung zusammenarbeitet.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Head of Treasury


Wenn Sie an den Corporate Treasurer von ABB Robotics berichten, besitzen und leiten Sie die Trade & Structured Finance-Funktion für das eigenständige Unternehmen. Sie sind verantwortlich für das gesamte Bankgarantieportfolio und die Einrichtungen sowie für die Entwicklung strukturierter Finanz-, Forderungs- und Supply-Chain-Finanzlösungen, die das Betriebskapital optimieren und Liquidität für das Unternehmen freisetzen. Sie entwerfen das Betriebsmodell, die Systeme und Steuerungen, die diese Aktivitäten unterstützen, die Automatisierung und KI über Handelsprozesse hinweg vorantreiben und kommerziell mit dem Geschäfts- und Bankenmarkt zusammenarbeiten. Unterstützt von einem Trade Finance Specialist und in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Treasury Leadership, Finance, Legal, den Geschäfts- und Bankpartnern bauen und betreiben Sie eine skalierbare, unabhängige Trade Finance-Fähigkeit.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist hybrid; #LI-hybrid

>Der Standort der Rolle liegt in Europa

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Trade Finance Leadership & Ownership: Eigentümer der Trade & Structured Finance-Funktion – Strategie, Standards und Richtlinien festlegen und als rechenschaftspflichtiger Eigentümer für Garantien, strukturierte Finanzierungen und Working Capital-Lösungen im gesamten Konzern auftreten.

  • Bankgarantien & Instrumente: Besitz des vollständigen Garantieportfolios und der Fazilitäten – Bankgarantien, Muttergesellschaftsgarantien, Bürgschaftsanleihen und Standby-Akkreditiv – einschließlich Fazilitätsverhandlungen, des täglichen Lebenszyklus (Ausgabe, Änderung, Erweiterung, Reduzierung, Erneuerung, Kündigung, Forderungen) und des Garantiegebührenmanagements.

  • Garantiebetriebsmodell & -systeme: Eigentümer des Betriebsmodells und der Systemlösung für das Garantiemanagement: ein strukturierter Prozess für Tochteranfragen, Tracking und Genehmigung, elektronische Übermittlung an Banken und Aufzeichnung (Komgo)

  • Strukturierte Finanzierung, AR Factoring & Supply Chain Finance: Entwicklung und Implementierung von Forderungs- (AR) Factoring basierend auf Geschäftsanforderungen, Supply Chain / Verbindlichkeiten und strukturierten Handelsfinanzierungslösungen zur Optimierung des Betriebskapitals und zur Freigabe von Liquidität; Bewertung der Machbarkeit, Strukturierung von Programmen, Verhandlungen mit Anbietern und Sicherstellung einer korrekten Dokumentation und buchhalterischen Behandlung.

  • Bankbeziehungen: Management von Handelsfinanzierungsbankbeziehungen und des breiteren Kontrahentensatzes; Führung neuer Bank-Onboarding-, Kontoeröffnungs- und KYC / AML-Prozesse sowie Aushandeln von Geschäftsbedingungen und -limits.

  • Covenants, Kontrollen & Governance: Owning Covenant Monitoring und Kreditgeber-Reporting für den Trade Finance Perimeter und die Festlegung der internen Kontrollen, Governance und Compliance-Framework für die Funktion.

  • AI & Automatisierung von Handelsprozessen: Automatisierung und KI durch den gesamten Trade Finance-Prozess - von Anfrageeingang und -emission bis hin zu Tracking, Abgleich und Reporting - Nutzung des Trade Finance Systems und ERP (SAP S4), Analyse und neue Tools, um eine Low-Touch, skalierbare Operation aufzubauen.

  • Commercial Partnering: Partnerschaft mit dem Unternehmen bei Ausschreibungen, Angeboten und Verträgen, Bereitstellung von Garantie- und Finanzierungslösungen, die kommerzielle Gewinne unterstützen und gleichzeitig die Risiko- und Liquiditätsposition der Gruppe schützen.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Umfangreiche Treasury-Erfahrung in globalen, multinationalen Unternehmen, mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz führende Handelsfinanzierung und Bankgarantiemanagement.

  • Deep, Hands-on-Know-how über Garantieinstrumente - Bankgarantien, PCGs, Bürgschaftsanleihen, Standby-Akkreditive - einschließlich Facility-Verhandlung und Garantie-Wortsetzungsüberprüfung.

  • Festes Wissen über strukturierte Finanzen, Forderungs- (AR) Factoring und Supply Chain / Verbindlichkeiten-Finanzierung, einschließlich Programmstrukturierung, Anbieter-Verhandlung und die Buchhaltung Implikationen.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Bank-Onboarding, Covenant Frameworks und Kreditgeber-Reporting in einem Multi-Entity, Multi-Country-Kontext.

  • Ein dynamischer, hoch agiler und kaufmännischer Fachmann mit einer starken Eigentümer-Mentalität, der in schnelllebigen, internationalen Umgebungen gedeiht; Car Was ist für dich drin:

    Wir befähigen Sie, Initiative zu ergreifen, Ideen herauszufordern und mit Zuversicht zu führen. Sie werden durch sinnvolle Arbeit, kontinuierliches Lernen und Unterstützung wachsen, die auf Ihre Ziele zugeschnitten ist. Jede Idee, die Sie teilen, und jede Aktion, die Sie unternehmen, trägt zu etwas Größerem bei.

    Wir schätzen Menschen mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund. Könnte das deine Geschichte sein? Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie www.abb.com, um mehr über uns zu lesen und mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à dépasser - plus maigre et plus propre. Ici, le progrès est une attente - pour vous, votre équipe, et le monde. En tant que leader mondial du marché, nous vous donnerons ce dont vous avez besoin pour que cela se produise. Il n'a pas toujours été facile, la croissance prend du grain. Mais à ABB, vous ne fuirez jamais seul. Lancez ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce rôle fait partie de l'activité Robotics d'ABB, une entreprise de robotique mondiale de premier plan. Nous entrons dans un nouveau chapitre passionnant alors que nous avons annoncé le projet de SoftBank Group d'acquérir ABB Robotics. SoftBank est un groupe technologique mondialement reconnu et un investisseur/exploitant axé sur l'IA, la robotique et l'informatique de prochaine génération. En vous joignant à nous maintenant, vous ferez partie d'une équipe pionnière qui façonnera l'avenir de la robotique, travaillant aux côtés d'experts de calibre mondial dans un environnement dynamique et axé sur l'innovation. Ce poste relève :

Chef du Trésor


Sous l'autorité du Trésorier d'ABB Robotics, vous serez propriétaire et directeur de la fonction Trade & Structured Finance pour l'entreprise autonome. Vous serez responsable de l'ensemble du portefeuille et des facilités de garantie bancaire, ainsi que du développement des solutions de financement structuré, de créances et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement qui optimisent le fonds de roulement et libèrent des liquidités pour l'entreprise. Vous concevrez le modèle d'exploitation, les systèmes et les contrôles qui soutiennent ces activités, stimuleront l'automatisation et l'IA dans tous les processus commerciaux et établirez des partenariats commerciaux avec le marché des affaires et des services bancaires. Avec l'appui d'un spécialiste des finances commerciales et en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants de la Trésorerie, les Finances, les Services juridiques, les partenaires commerciaux et bancaires, vous créerez et gérerez une capacité évolutive et indépendante de financement du commerce.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est hybride; #LI-hybrid

L'emplacement du rôle est en Europe

Vous serez principalement responsable :

  • Leadership et propriété du financement commercial: La fonction Commerce et finances structurées prend fin – établir une stratégie, des normes et des politiques et agir comme propriétaire responsable des garanties, des finances structurées et des solutions de fonds de roulement dans l'ensemble du groupe.

  • Garanties et instruments bancaires: Posséder l'intégralité du portefeuille et des facilités de garantie – garanties bancaires, garanties des sociétés mères, cautions et lettres de crédit – y compris la négociation des facilités, le cycle de vie quotidien (émission, modification, extension, réduction, renouvellement, annulation, réclamations) et la gestion des frais de garantie.

  • Modèle et systèmes d'exploitation de la garantie: Posséder le modèle d'exploitation et la solution du système pour la gestion de la garantie: un processus structuré pour les demandes subsidiaires, le suivi et l'approbation, la transmission électronique aux banques et la tenue de dossiers (Komgo)

  • Financement structuré, affacturage des EI et financement de la chaîne d'approvisionnement: Élaboration et mise en oeuvre de l'affacturage des créances (AR) en fonction des besoins des entreprises, des finances de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et des créditeurs et des solutions de financement du commerce structuré afin d'optimiser le fonds de roulement et de libérer la liquidité; évaluation de la faisabilité, structuration des programmes, négociation avec les fournisseurs, et garantie d'une documentation et d'un traitement comptables corrects.

  • Relations bancaires: Gérer les relations avec les banques de financement commercial et l'ensemble plus large des contreparties; diriger les nouveaux processus d'embarquement, d'ouverture de compte et de CYK/MLA, et négocier les modalités et les limites commerciales.

  • Provêtements, contrôles et gouvernance: La surveillance de l'alliance et les rapports des prêteurs pour le périmètre du financement du commerce, et l'établissement du cadre de contrôle interne, de gouvernance et de conformité pour la fonction.

  • AI et l'automatisation des processus commerciaux: L'automatisation et l'IA dans l'ensemble du processus du financement du commerce - de la réception et de l'émission des demandes au suivi, au rapprochement et à l'établissement des rapports - tirer parti du système de financement du commerce et du PGI (SAP S4), de l'analyse et de l'outillage émergent pour construire une opération à faible toucher et évolutive.

  • Partenaire commercial: Partenariat avec l'entreprise sur les appels d'offres, les soumissions et les contrats, fournissant des solutions de garantie et de financement qui soutiennent les gains commerciaux tout en protégeant le risque et la position de liquidité du groupe.

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Une vaste expérience en matière de trésorerie dans les entreprises multinationales à l'échelle mondiale, avec une solide expérience en matière de financement commercial et de gestion des garanties bancaires.

  • Expertise approfondie et pratique des instruments de garantie – garanties bancaires, PCG, obligations de garantie, lettres de crédit en attente – y compris la négociation d'installations et l'examen de la formulation de la garantie.

  • Connaissance solide en matière de financement structuré, d'affacturage des créances et de financement de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et des créditeurs, y compris la structuration des programmes, la négociation des fournisseurs et les répercussions comptables.

  • Expérience pratique de la banque à bord, de la KYC et de l'AML, des cadres d'alliance et des rapports des prêteurs dans un contexte multi-entités, multi-pays.

  • Expérience à l'application de l'IA et/ou à l'automatisation des processus de financement commercial

  • < Qu'y a-t-il pour vous :

    Nous vous donnons les moyens de prendre des initiatives, de contester les idées et de diriger avec confiance. Vous grandirez grâce à un travail significatif, l'apprentissage continu et le soutien qui est adapté à vos objectifs. Chaque idée que vous partagez et chaque action que vous prenez contribue à quelque chose de plus grand.

    Nous valorisons les gens de différents horizons. Ça pourrait être votre histoire ? Faites une demande aujourd'hui ou visitez www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur nous et découvrez l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Business Manager - E2E

__

In this role, you own the Trade Compliance framework for the Local Business Line (LBL) and are accountable for establishing, implementing, and continuously improving the policies, processes, controls, and governance required to ensure compliant execution of our global business activities. You ensure that all international business transactions, project deliveries, imports, exports, cross-border shipments, and related trade activities are conducted in accordance with ABB's Global Trade Program and applicable customs, export control, sanctions, and origin regulations. As the LBL's Trade Compliance authority, you define and maintain the operational trade compliance framework. You establish clear processes, responsibilities, controls, and escalation mechanisms and ensure effective implementation across all relevant functions. You drive the integration of trade compliance requirements into daily operations and act as the main point for complex compliance matters, regulatory changes, and risk mitigation. You are further responsible for developing, documenting, and maintaining procedures and training programs related to export controls, sanctions, customs, and origin management.

Working model is: #LI-Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop, improve and implement processes of LBL’s customs procedures, origin management, sanction lists screening, dual-use classification and export controls.

  • Functionally lead trade compliance resources in the LBL.

  • Lead and oversee Trade Compliance within the Local Business Line (LBL), including the implementation and continuous improvement of ABB’s Trade Compliance Program, internal directives, internal control system, local trade reviews, self-audits, and corrective actions.

  • Provide expert guidance and training on customs, origin, export control, and sanctions compliance, supporting the LBL, coordinating trade compliance resources and support functions, and maintaining strong alignment with key stakeholders such as CTCO, TCS, PCE, declarants, and logistics teams.

  • Drive Trade Compliance in day-to-day operations and complex projects, including risk assessments, internal checks, master data and supplier-related compliance requirements, and regular updates to stakeholders on implementation progress and relevant regulatory changes.

  • Advise and drive all trade compliance matters in LBL’s complex projects to different countries


What we are looking for:

  • Degree as a Foreign Trade Specialist / Manager or Export Control / Customs Compliance Officer with at least 8 years of experience in a relevant field (Senior Trade Compliance or Legal/Compliance background)

  • Excellent experience in free trade and preferential origins as well as in trade compliance matters

  • Solid knowledge in Swiss (GKV), EU and US (EAR) dual-use and sanctions regulations

  • Experience in an industry with large project businesses in various countries and ability as a people leader and solution-oriented team player

  • SAP and SAP GTS E4H experiences

  • Fluent in English, German is a plus

More about us:

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry- specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Understanding and addressing challenges and opportunities take a deep domain knowledge. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment. Digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Pulp, Paper & Fiber, Mining, Gearless Mill Drives (GMDs), Hoists, Metals, Growth Industries such as Cement, Food & Beverage, Data Center Automation, High Power Rectifiers, and Batteries.

This recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Team Lead, ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

As a Commissioning Engineer, you will oversee commissioning in projects with low to medium complexity, and guide Associate Commissioning Engineers and coordinating work. You will ensure that commissioning activities are completed efficiently and cost-effectively, in accordance with specifications, standards, and safety requirements.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

Conduct remote services and support to enhance the solutions and additionally perform network stability studies with a focus on power plant stabilities and grid code compliance.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach and written and spoken communication skills in English (German advance).

descriptionByLocale.it:
In ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a funzionare più snello e più pulito.E ogni persona qui fa che accada. You.ll essere autorizzato a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che gestisce il mondo.

Questa posizione è indirizzata a: Capo dell'intelligence strategica

E' un'idea divertente.

Come partecipante al Global Early Total Program nell'ambito di Strategy e M&A, otterrete sin dall'inizio la responsabilità diretta. Costruirete rapidamente le vostre competenze e la vostra esperienza attraverso una serie di incarichi emozionanti, cross-funzionali e internazionali. La strategia aziendale e M&A è responsabile dei processi di strategia aziendale, pianificazione strategica e gestione del portafoglio di ABB. nonché dell'esecuzione di acquisizioni e cessioni.

Creerai un'eredità di cui essere orgogliosi mentre approfondisci le tue competenze di leadership e le tue competenze soft, costruendo una forte rete all'interno di ABB.

Le persone eccezionali con cui lavori, i progetti impegnativi che affronterai e la scala globale del nostro business daranno l'esperienza necessaria per costruire una carriera di livello mondiale in strategia e M&A.

Per questa particolare posizione, sarete assunti nell'ambito della strategia aziendale e della funzione M&A a Zurigo, Svizzera, con rotazioni nell'area del Motion Business in Svizzera e Finlandia.

La data di inizio del programma è ottobre 2026.

Il programma è composto da tre incarichi nel corso di 24 mesi:

1) Un incarico a Zurigo nell'ambito della strategia aziendale e della funzione M&A con una forte attenzione all'Intelligence strategica a partire dal 1o ottobre 2026 come introduzione alla società.

2) Un incarico nella strategia aziendale all'estero per ottenere una panoramica di ABB.s business in un ambiente / ruolo diverso, e lavorare su un incarico emozionante con un team diverso, espandendo la vostra rete.

3) Uno o due incarichi in strategia aziendale, M&A o team collegati a Zurigo con Motion, dove approfondirete la conoscenza dell'azienda e della vostra funzione, rafforzando le vostre competenze tecniche e morbide.

Durante l'ultima missione, i partecipanti si incontreranno a Zurigo per una settimana di formazione, focalizzata sullo sviluppo delle competenze di leadership. L'ultima rotazione sarà anche il momento in cui i partecipanti inizieranno a cercare la loro prima posizione permanente, da iniziare dopo la fine del programma. Tutti gli allenamenti programma sono destinati a costruire le basi della vostra futura evoluzione professionale.

• Le vostre responsabilità

A seconda del ruolo di assegnazione, le responsabilità più comuni includono:

- Get coinvolto durante tutto il ciclo strategico, dalla diagnosi, analisi di mercato e concorrente, modellazione strategica e pianificazione, alla gestione del portafoglio e delle attività di M&A, nonché alla gestione delle prestazioni

- Fornire aggiornamenti periodici macroeconomici, di mercato e di intelligence competitiva

- Contribuire a progetti strategici.

- Supporto in aggiornamenti periodici sulla strategia e sulle informazioni di mercato al Consiglio di Amministrazione e al Comitato Esecutivo

- Preparare piani aziendali, sinergie previste e valutazioni

- Sostegno alla preparazione della documentazione M&A per il processo decisionale ABB

- Sostegno durante le diverse fasi delle operazioni M&A: pianificazione e preparazione, valutazione iniziale, due diligence, negoziati contrattuali, preparativi di chiusura, ecc.

- dilagarsi con le imprese ABB e altre funzioni durante tutto il processo di M&A

- Gestire e rivedere le proposte di acquisizione che ABB riceve da parti esterne

• Qualifiche per il ruolo:

- Recente laureato (livello Masters) in Finanza, Business Administration, Economia, Ingegneria o campi affini

- Si può prendere in considerazione la precedente esperienza iniziale in settori quali la consulenza strategica, la strategia aziendale, gli investimenti bancari, ecc.

- Eccellenti capacità analitiche, strutturazione, soluzione dei problemi, modellazione

- Passione per affrontare problemi complessi, alto livello di curiosità, voglia di imparare e avviare l'impegno con gli altri

- Fluenza professionale in inglese, altre lingue sono un plus

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale

- Spirito di squadra e mentalità globale

- Attenzione ai dettagli e precisione, disposti a sfidare lo status quo e portare i progetti al livello successivo

- Eleggibilità per il permesso di lavoro in Svizzera, ad esempio, cittadino svizzero o UE/EFTA (non sponsorizzeremo una domanda di visto per questo ruolo)

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede ogni tipo di mente: il curioso, il coraggioso e il creativo. Ecco perché accogliamo persone provenienti da ogni provenienza ed esperienza.

Pronto a fare un impatto?

Applica oggi o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Head of Strategic Intelligence

__

As Global Early Talent Program participant within Strategy and M&A, you will get hands-on responsibility from the start. You will rapidly build your skills and experience through a series of exciting, cross-functional, and international assignments. Corporate Strategy and M&A is responsible for ABB’s corporate strategy, strategic planning and portfolio management processes as well as execution of acquisitions and divestments.

You will create a legacy to be proud of as you deepen your leadership competences and soft skills, building a strong network within ABB.

The exceptional people you work with, the challenging projects you tackle and the global scale of our business will give the experience you need to build a world-class career in strategy and M&A.

For this particular position, you will be hired within the Corporate Strategy and M&A function in Zurich, Switzerland, with rotations in the Motion Business Area in Switzerland and Finland.

Program start date is October 2026.

The program is made up of three assignments over the course of 24 months:

1) One assignment in Zurich within the Corporate Strategy and M&A function with a strong focus on Strategic Intelligence starting on 1 October 2026 as an introduction to the company.

2) One assignment in business strategy abroad to get an overview of ABB’s business in a different environment/role, and work on an exciting assignment with a different team, expanding your network.

3) One or two assignments in business strategy, M&A or related teams back in Zurich with Motion, where you will deepen your knowledge of the company and your function, strengthening your technical and soft skills.

During the last assignment, participants will meet in Zurich, Switzerland, for a week of training, focused on leadership competencies development. The last rotation will also be the time where the participants start to look for their first permanent position, to be started after the end of the program. All program trainings are meant to build the foundations of your future career evolution.

• Your responsibilities

Depending on the assignment role you will be in, most common responsibilities include:

-
Get involved throughout the entire strategic cycle spanning from diagnosis, market and competitor analysis, strategic modelling and planning to portfolio management and M&A activities as well as performance management

-
Provide regular macroeconomic, market and competitive intelligence updates

-
Contribute to strategy projects – delivering results against partially tight deadlines

-
Support in regular updates on strategy and market insights to the Board of Directors and the Executive Committee

-
Prepare business plans, projected synergies, and valuations

-
Support in the preparation of M&A documentation for ABB decision-making

-
Support during different phases of M&A transactions: planning & preparations, initial assessment, due diligence, contract negotiations, closing preparations, etc.

-
Collaborate with ABB businesses and other functions throughout the M&A process

-
Handle and review acquisition proposals that ABB receives from external parties

• Qualifications for the role:

-
Recent graduate (Master’s level) in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering or related fields

-
Previous initial work experience in relevant fields such as strategy consulting, corporate strategy, M&A, investment banking etc. can be considered

-
Excellent analytical skills – structuring, problem solving, modeling

-
Passion for tackling complex problems, high level of curiosity, eagerness to learn and initiate engagement with others

-
Professional fluency in English, other languages are a plus

-
Excellent written and oral communication skills

-
Team spirit and global mindset

-
Attention to detail and accuracy, willing to challenge the status quo and take projects to the next level

-
Eligibility for work permit in Switzerland, e.g., Swiss or EU/EFTA citizen (we will not sponsor a visa application for this role)

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu werden – und das macht jeder Mensch hier. Sie werden dazu befähigt, zu führen, zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam erzeugen.

Diese Position berichtet an: Leiter der strategischen Intelligenz

Als Global Early Talent Program Teilnehmer bei Strategy und M&A erhalten Sie von Anfang an praktische Verantwortung. Sie werden Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen durch eine Reihe von spannenden, funktionsübergreifenden und internationalen Aufgaben schnell aufbauen. Corporate Strategy und M&A sind verantwortlich für ABB, die Unternehmensstrategie, strategische Planungs- und Portfoliomanagementprozesse sowie die Durchführung von Akquisitionen und Veräußerungen.

Sie werden ein Erbe schaffen, auf das Sie stolz sein können, wenn Sie Ihre Führungskompetenzen und Soft Skills vertiefen und ein starkes Netzwerk innerhalb der ABB aufbauen.

Die außergewöhnlichen Menschen, mit denen Sie arbeiten, die herausfordernden Projekte, die Sie angehen, und das globale Ausmaß unseres Geschäfts werden Ihnen die Erfahrung geben, die Sie brauchen, um eine Weltklasse-Karriere in Strategie und M&A aufzubauen.

Für diese besondere Position werden Sie im Rahmen der Corporate Strategy und M&A-Funktion in Zürich, Schweiz, mit Rotationen im Motion Business Area in der Schweiz und Finnland eingestellt.

Programmstart ist Oktober 2026.

Das Programm besteht aus drei Aufgaben im Laufe von 24 Monaten:

1) Ein Auftrag in Zürich im Rahmen der Corporate Strategy und M&A-Funktion mit einem starken Fokus auf Strategic Intelligence ab dem 1. Oktober 2026 als Einführung in das Unternehmen.

2) Ein Auftrag in der Geschäftsstrategie im Ausland, um einen Überblick über ABB zu bekommen, das Geschäft in einem anderen Umfeld/Role, und an einem spannenden Auftrag mit einem anderen Team arbeiten, Ihr Netzwerk zu erweitern.

3) Ein oder zwei Aufgaben in der Business-Strategie, M&A oder verwandten Teams zurück in Zürich mit Motion, wo Sie Ihre Kenntnisse über das Unternehmen und Ihre Funktion vertiefen, Ihre technischen und weichen Fähigkeiten zu stärken.

Während der letzten Aufgabe treffen sich die Teilnehmer in Zürich, Schweiz, für eine Woche Training, konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung von Führungskompetenzen. Die letzte Rotation wird auch die Zeit sein, wo die Teilnehmer beginnen, ihre erste dauerhafte Position zu suchen, die nach dem Ende des Programms begonnen werden soll. Alle Programm-Trainings sollen die Grundlagen Ihrer zukünftigen Karriereentwicklung aufbauen.

• Ihre Verantwortung

Je nach Aufgabenstellung sind die häufigsten Aufgaben:

- Sich während des gesamten strategischen Zyklus von Diagnose, Markt- und Konkurrenzanalyse, strategischer Modellierung und Planung bis hin zu Portfoliomanagement und M&A-Aktivitäten sowie Performance Management engagieren

- Bereitstellung regelmäßiger makroökonomischer, markt- und wettbewerbsorientierter Nachrichtendienste

- Beitrag zu Strategieprojekten – Ergebnisse liefern gegen teilweise enge Fristen

- Unterstützung bei regelmäßigen Aktualisierungen der Strategie und Markteinblicke für den Verwaltungsrat und die Konzernleitung

- Erstellung von Geschäftsplänen, projizierten Synergien und Bewertungen

- Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von M&A-Dokumenten für ABB-Entscheidungen

- Unterstützung in verschiedenen Phasen der M&A-Transaktionen: Planung & Vorbereitung, Erstbewertung, Due Diligence, Vertragsverhandlungen, Abschlussvorbereitungen usw.

- Zusammenarbeit mit ABB-Unternehmen und anderen Funktionen während des gesamten M&A-Prozesses

- Bearbeitung und Überprüfung von Übernahmeanträgen, die ABB von externen Parteien erhält

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

- Neuer Absolvent (Master, s-Level) in Finanzen, Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaft, Ingenieurwesen oder verwandten Bereichen

- Frühere erste Berufserfahrungen in relevanten Bereichen wie Strategieberatung, Unternehmensstrategie, M&A, Investment Banking etc. können berücksichtigt werden

- Ausgezeichnete analytische Fähigkeiten – Strukturierung, Problemlösung, Modellierung

- Leidenschaft für die Bewältigung komplexer Probleme, hohe Neugier, Lernbereitschaft und Initiierung der Auseinandersetzung mit anderen

- Professionelle Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch, andere Sprachen sind ein Plus

- Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

- Teamgeist und globale Denkweise

- Aufmerksamkeit für Detail und Genauigkeit, bereit, den Status quo herauszufordern und Projekte auf die nächste Ebene zu bringen

- Zulassungsvoraussetzungen für Arbeitserlaubnis in der Schweiz, z.B. Schweizer oder EU/EFTA-Bürger (wir werden keinen Visumantrag für diese Rolle sponsern)

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.
