  • Partner closely with ABB distribution channels to enhance customer journey and maintain precise customer data within the CRM system (Salesforce).

  • Continuously expand your technical expertise, monitor market trends, and apply diverse sales techniques such as value-based selling to maximize business success.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Strong technical expertise in low voltage products, with a solid understanding of the Swiss industry and automation.

  • Proficiency in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems; experience with order development tools (ERP) is a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships, paired with a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in German and English; French is an advantage.

  • Technical qualification, preferably a bachelor's degree in Automation, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.

  • Valid Swiss driver’s license and work authorization in Switzerland.


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers,
low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Principal Technical Support Engineer

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to ensure that change notifications by the Agile teams of the UPS product lines consider the serviceability of the products. You will engage with the change managers of the Agile teams and the stakeholders within Service on a daily basis.

This role contributes to the Global Service Engineering team in Quartino. The main stakeholders include change managers from the Agile teams of the UPS product lines in Quartino, service professionals responsible for technical support, documentation, and spare parts, as well as supply chain specialists responsible for spare part creation and stock management.

You will join a newly formed Service Engineering team, where you will have the opportunity to thrive.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing new ECN (engineering change notices) for potential impact on Service
  • Maintaining a tracker for ECN potentially affecting Service
  • Run the meetings where Service stakeholders discuss ECN impact and suggest changes to the change leaders
  • Track the updates to the ECN based on Service stakeholder consensus and approve acceptable ECN
  • Track the execution of Service implementation of the ECN (Service News, Spare part (list) updates, information to global technical support)
  • Providing technical support and solving problems in own expertise area via remote or on-site service in any Service category
  • You will support the change managers pro-actively to improve the correctness, completeness, and effectiveness of the Service aspects of the ECN

• Qualifications for the role:

  • A bachelor’s degree, diploma, or higher academic qualification in Electrical or Electronic Engineering
  • At least 5 years of experience in similar roles, or 10 years of experience in UPS development or service roles
  • Experience with the product lines manufactured in Quartino
  • Experience with change management process and related documentation
  • Experience in the Windchill change management system
  • Proficiency in both verbal and written English communication (B2 level or higher) Knowledge of any other language is a welcome asset

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Team Leader Power Electronics Engineering

__

Power Electronics Engineer for Traction Projects (m/f/d) (80 - 100%)

Are you ready to take your passion for traction power electronics to new heights? Whether you're diving into designing powerful traction systems for passenger trains, metros, trams, next generation locomotives, or innovative platform products, this is your chance to make an impact!

Bring your enthusiasm and expertise in power electronics and explore a world of exciting opportunities. You'll be working alongside global teams in engineering, production, R&D, and project management, all united in pushing the boundaries of technology.

We believe in the power of inclusion, gender equality, and building a diverse environment where every voice is valued. Whether you're expanding your skills or building on past experiences, your unique perspective is essential to driving innovation forward. We’re eager to see what you’ll bring to the table; fresh ideas come from diverse minds.

Reporting to the Power Electronics Engineering Manager, you’ll be part of a team focused on delivering traction projects efficiently, and with high quality through close collaboration, technical excellence, and inclusivity. Ready for the journey?

Key • Responsibilities:

  • Advanced Systems Engineering: Design traction power electronics converter and energy storage systems (ESS), while ensuring their seamless integration within vehicles. Your work will align with customer needs, industry standards, and internal specifications.

  • Testing & Validation: Lead the specification, execution, analysis, and documentation of Type and Qualification tests to ensure robust system performance, focusing on traction converters and ESS for enhanced energy efficiency.

  • Technical leadership: Develop deep expertise in core power engineering competencies, components, or tools to provide technical guidance for your peers. Optimize design processes and customer solutions independently or by collaborating in cross-functional specialist teams.

  • Product Standardization: Contribute to the evolution of our traction product families through standardization, and continuous improvements. Leverage your expertise to drive innovation in the integration of traction converters with ESS.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Power Electronics Expertise: A qualified Power Electronics/Electrical Engineer with a solid background in power electronics design and engineering. Experience with traction converters and energy storage systems is an advantage.

  • Curiosity & Continuous Learning: Eager to continuously expand technical expertise, drive continuous improvement, share knowledge with the team, fostering a culture of growth and collaboration.

  • Problem Solver & Team Player: A proactive individual who thrives on solving complex challenges and takes ownership of their tasks, while also being an effective player in an inclusive team.

  • Fluent Communicator: Clear and efficient communication in English is essential, both written and spoken. German language skills are a strong advantage.

  • Willingness to Travel: Occasional travel opportunities to support projects.

Join us and elevate your career in the thrilling world of rail vehicle drive systems! This is your opportunity to thrive and grow while making a meaningful impact on the future of sustainable transportation!

Power Electronics Engineer for Traction Projects (m/f/d) (80 - 100%)

Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft für Traktionsleistungselektronik auf ein neues Level zu heben? Ob Sie leistungsstarke Traktionssysteme für Personenzüge, Metros, Straßenbahnen, Lokomotiven der nächsten Generation oder innovative Plattformprodukte entwickeln – hier haben Sie die Chance, wirklich etwas zu bewegen!

Bringen Sie Ihre Begeisterung und Ihr Fachwissen in der Leistungselektronik ein und entdecken Sie eine Welt voller spannender Möglichkeiten. Sie arbeiten Hand in Hand mit globalen Teams aus den Bereichen Engineering, Produktion, F&E und Projektmanagement – alle vereint mit dem Ziel, technologische Grenzen zu verschieben.

Wir glauben an die Kraft der Inklusion, Gleichstellung der Geschlechter und an den Aufbau eines vielfältigen Umfelds, in dem jede Stimme zählt. Egal ob Sie neue Fähigkeiten entwickeln oder auf bestehenden Erfahrungen aufbauen – Ihre einzigartige Perspektive ist entscheidend, um Innovation voranzutreiben. Wir sind gespannt, was Sie einbringen werden – denn frische Ideen entstehen aus vielfältigen Köpfen.

Sie berichten an den Engineering Manager Power Electronics und sind Teil eines Teams, das sich auf die effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung von Traktionsprojekten konzentriert – durch enge Zusammenarbeit, technische Exzellenz und Inklusion. Bereit für die Reise?

Hauptaufgaben:

  • Fortgeschrittenes Systems Engineering: Entwicklung von Leistungselektronik-Konvertern und Energiespeichersystemen (ESS) für Traktionsanwendungen sowie Sicherstellung ihrer nahtlosen Integration in Fahrzeuge. Ihre Arbeit orientiert sich an Kundenanforderungen, Industriestandards und internen Spezifikationen.

  • Testen & Validierung: Leitung der Spezifikation, Durchführung, Analyse und Dokumentation von Typ- und Qualifikationstests zur Sicherstellung einer robusten Systemleistung – mit Fokus auf Traktionskonverter und ESS für verbesserte Energieeffizienz.

  • Technische Führung: Aufbau tiefgehender Expertise in zentralen Power-Engineering-Kompetenzen, Komponenten oder Tools, um Ihre Kollegen fachlich zu unterstützen. Optimierung von Designprozessen und Kundenlösungen – eigenständig oder in cross-funktionalen Spezialistenteams.

  • Produktstandardisierung: Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Traktionsproduktfamilien durch Standardisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Nutzen Sie Ihr Fachwissen, um Innovation in der Integration von Traktionskonvertern mit ESS voranzutreiben.

• Anforderungen:

  • Expertise in Leistungselektronik: Qualifizierter Ingenieur im Bereich Leistungselektronik / Elektrotechnik mit fundiertem Hintergrund in Design und Engineering. Erfahrung mit Traktionskonvertern und Energiespeichersystemen ist von Vorteil.

  • Neugier & kontinuierliches Lernen: Begeisterung für den stetigen Ausbau technischer Expertise, Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und Weitergabe von Wissen im Team – für eine Kultur des Wachstums und der Zusammenarbeit.

  • Problemlöser & Teamplayer: Eine proaktive Persönlichkeit, die komplexe Herausforderungen liebt, Verantwortung für ihre • Aufgaben übernimmt und gleichzeitig ein effektiver Teil eines inklusiven Teams ist.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Klare und effiziente Kommunikation auf Englisch ist unerlässlich – schriftlich wie mündlich. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein klarer Vorteil.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Gelegentliche Reisen zur Projektunterstützung sind möglich.

The recruitment process is supported by Talent Partner Gema de Vicente.

Description
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Marketing & Sales Manager

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will be responsible for driving front end sales for large and strategic mining projects, positioning ABB as a full-scope solution provider across the mining value chain. You will lead sales activities for complex international opportunities, covering the broader ABB portfolio in electrification, automation, drives and digital solutions, with an additional focus on the grinding portfolio.

The work model for the role is: Onsite

This role is contributing to AUPI in Switzerland. Main stakeholders are Global Accounts, EPCMs and key Local Business Lines within AUPI.

You will be mainly accountable for:
- Driving the sales of strategic mining projects, positioning ABB as a global solution provider.
- Promoting and selling the full ABB portfolio for mining, including high voltage, medium voltage, low voltage, variable frequency drives, electrification, automation and digital solutions, with an additional focus on the grinding portfolio, including GMDs, RMDs and related applications.
- Leading front-end sales activities for large, international mining opportunities with multiple stakeholders.
- Managing capture teams and coordinating multinational and cross-functional resources towards a winning strategy.
- Developing and executing account and opportunity strategies in close collaboration with account managers, OEMs, EPCMs and local ABB units.
- Ensuring ABB’s value proposition is clearly communicated and professionally presented to customers and stakeholders.
- Leading strategic discussions related to scope allocation and division of responsibilities between global and local units.
- Building, qualifying and developing a strong pipeline of mining opportunities to support sustainable growth.

Our team dynamics
You will join a talented, high- performing and internationally connected team, where collaboration, business insight and customer focus are key to success.

Qualifications for the role
- Minimum 5 years of experience in the mining industry or similar, with a strong track record in sales or execution of complex industrial solutions.
- Proven experience in front end sales, strategic project sales or solution sales in mining or similar heavy industrial environments.
- Strong knowledge of electrification, automation, drives and/or digital solutions for mining, with a solution-oriented approach.
- Experience in the grinding domain, including GMDs, RMDs or similar applications, is a strong advantage.
- Experience in process, drives and control applications related to mining is an advantage.
- Established strategic contacts with OEMs and/or EPCMs in the mining industry are highly desirable.
- Preferably a degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Demonstrated success in leading multinational and multicultural teams in complex project environments, with strong communication , influencing and stakeholder alignment skills.

What’s in it for you?
- Opportunity to shape ABB’s position in some of the world’s largest mining projects.
- Exposure to global customers, EPCMs and ABB stakeholders across multiple countries.
- A highly visible role with strategic impact on business growth.
- The chance to work in an international environment with experienced sales and execution professionals.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Contact
Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Diese Rolle trägt zum AUPI in der Schweiz bei. Hauptakteure sind Global Accounts, EPCMs und wichtige lokale Business Lines innerhalb von AUPI.

Sie werden vor allem verantwortlich sein für: - Den Vertrieb von strategischen Bergbauprojekten vorantreiben, ABB als globalen Lösungsanbieter positionieren. - Das komplette ABB-Portfolio für den Bergbau fördern und verkaufen, einschließlich Hochspannung, Mittelspannung, Niederspannung, variable Frequenzantriebe, Elektrifizierung, Automatisierung und digitale Lösungen, mit einem zusätzlichen Fokus auf das Schleifportfolio, einschließlich GMDs, RMDs und verwandter Anwendungen. - Führende Front-End-Vertriebsaktivitäten für große, internationale Bergbaumöglichkeiten mit mehreren Stakeholdern.

- Management von Capture Teams und Koordinierung multinationaler und funktionsübergreifender Ressourcen zu einer Gewinnstrategie. - Entwicklung und Durchführung von Account- und Opportunity-Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Account Managern, OEMs, EPCMs und lokalen ABB-Einheiten. - Gewährleistung der ABB,s Wertversprechen wird klar kommuniziert und professionell an Kunden und Stakeholdern präsentiert. - Führende strategische Diskussionen im Zusammenhang mit der Umfangsverteilung und Aufteilung der Verantwortlichkeiten zwischen globalen und lokalen Einheiten.

- Aufbau, Qualifizierung und Entwicklung einer starken Pipeline von Bergbaumöglichkeiten zur Unterstützung eines nachhaltigen Wachstums.

Unsere Teamdynamik Sie werden sich einem talentierten, leistungsstarken und international vernetzten Team anschließen, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Business Insight und Kundenorientierung der Schlüssel zum Erfolg sind.

Qualifikation für die Rolle - Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Bergbauindustrie oder ähnliche, mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz in Vertrieb oder Ausführung von komplexen industriellen Lösungen. - Bewährte Erfahrung in Front-End-Vertrieb, strategische Projekt-Vertrieb oder Lösungsverkäufe in Bergbau oder ähnliche schwere Industrieumgebungen. - Starke Kenntnisse der Elektrifizierung, Automatisierung, Antriebe und / oder digitale Lösungen für den Bergbau, mit einem lösungsorientierten Ansatz. - Erfahrung in der Schleifbranche, einschließlich GMDs, RMDs oder ähnliche Anwendungen, ist ein großer Vorteil.

- Erfahrung in Prozess-, Antriebs- und Steuerungsanwendungen im Zusammenhang mit dem Bergbau ist ein Vorteil. - Es sind sehr wünschenswert, strategische Kontakte mit OEMs und/oder EPCMs in der Bergbauindustrie aufzubauen. - Vorzugsweise ein Studium in Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder einer verwandten technischen Disziplin. - Gezeigter Erfolg in führenden multinationalen und multikulturellen Teams in komplexen Projektumgebungen, mit starker Kommunikation, Einflussnahme und Stakeholder-Anpassung Fähigkeiten.

Was, ist es für Sie? - Gelegenheit, ABB, eine Position in einigen der weltweit größten Bergbauprojekte zu gestalten. - Exposition gegenüber globalen Kunden, EPCMs und ABB Stakeholder in mehreren Ländern. - Eine sehr sichtbare Rolle mit strategischen Auswirkungen auf das Wachstum des Unternehmens. - Die Chance, in einem internationalen Umfeld mit erfahrenen Vertriebs-und Ausführungsexperten arbeiten.

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Marketing & Sales Leader - ELSB/ELSP

__

As Sales Manager - Panel Builders, you will lead one of ABB Electrification's key sales channels in Switzerland. Combining strategic leadership with a strong customer focus, you will drive profitable growth, strengthen long-term customer relationships, and lead a high-performing sales team. Working closely with colleagues across the business, you will play an important role in shaping our commercial success while helping customers accelerate the transition to a more sustainable and electrified future.

The working model is: LI-Hybrid

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Lead, coach, and develop the local Panel Builders sales team, fostering a high-performance, customer-centric culture and ensuring strong market coverage across all regions of Switzerland.

  • Drive profitable growth by identifying new business opportunities and implementing effective sales, market segmentation, and pricing strategies aligned with ABB’s business objectives.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and partners, ensuring an excellent customer experience throughout the entire sales process.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product marketing, operations, and other stakeholders to support business success, while coordinating sales information flow, providing accurate forecasts and market insights, and managing commercial and contractual risks.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree or similar in a technical field (preferably Electrical Engineering) with minimum 3 years of successful sales leadership background with a proven track record in the Swiss market.

  • Demonstrated people leadership experience and solid cross-functional collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across functions and organizational levels.

  • Good technical knowledge of energy distribution and low-voltage switchgear or similar technical field. Furthermore, ability and interest to sell and promote digital solutions.

  • Sound understanding of contract negotiations, risk management, and commercial and legal terms.

  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, a customer-focused mindset, and a professional, proactive "can-do" attitude.

  • Fluent in German, with a good command of French and English.

More about us:

Electrification offers technologies across the entire electrification value chain—from the substation to the point of consumption. In doing so, it contributes to a secure and reliable power supply. The portfolio includes digital and connected innovations that improve the reliability and efficiency of low- and medium-voltage electrical installations. These include electric vehicle charging infrastructure, modular substations, distribution automation solutions, switchgear, sensor technology and control systems, as well as KNX systems for the automation and networking of building infrastructure.

This recruitment process is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Acquisition Partner, ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Marketing & Sales Leader - ELSB/ELSP

Als Sales Manager - Panel Builders leiten Sie einen der wichtigsten Vertriebskanäle von ABB Electrification in der Schweiz. Durch die Kombination von strategischer Führung mit einer starken Kundenorientierung werden Sie profitables Wachstum vorantreiben, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen stärken und ein leistungsstarkes Verkaufsteam leiten. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen im gesamten Unternehmen werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Gestaltung unseres kommerziellen Erfolgs spielen und gleichzeitig den Kunden helfen, den Übergang zu einer nachhaltigeren und elektrifizierteren Zukunft zu beschleunigen.

• Ihre Hauptaufgaben werden sein:

  • Führen, coachen und entwickeln Sie das lokale Panel Builders-Vertriebsteam, fördern Sie eine leistungsstarke, kundenorientierte Kultur und sorgen Sie für eine starke Marktabdeckung in allen Regionen der Schweiz.

  • Steigern Sie profitables Wachstum, indem Sie neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten identifizieren und effektive Vertriebs-, Marktsegmentierungs- und Preisstrategien implementieren, die auf die Geschäftsziele von ABB ausgerichtet sind.

  • Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu wichtigen Kunden und Partnern, um eine hervorragende Kundenerfahrung während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses zu gewährleisten.

  • Arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend mit Marketing, Produktmarketing, Operations und anderen Stakeholdern zusammen, um den Geschäftserfolg zu unterstützen, während Sie den Vertriebsinformationsfluss koordinieren, genaue Prognosen und Marktinformationen liefern und kommerzielle und vertragliche Risiken verwalten.

Was wir suchen:

  • Bachelor-Abschluss oder ähnliches in einem technischen Bereich (vorzugsweise Elektrotechnik) mit mindestens 3 Jahren erfolgreicher Vertriebsführung mit nachgewiesener Erfolgsbilanz auf dem Schweizer Markt.

  • Demonstrierte Führungserfahrung und solide funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und Teamfähigkeit mit der Fähigkeit, effektive Beziehungen über Funktionen und organisatorische Ebenen hinweg aufzubauen.

  • Gute technische Kenntnisse der Energieverteilung und Niederspannungsschaltanlagen oder ähnliches technisches Gebiet. Darüber hinaus die Fähigkeit und das Interesse, digitale Lösungen zu verkaufen und zu bewerben.

  • Ein fundiertes Verständnis von Vertragsverhandlungen, Risikomanagement sowie kaufmännischen und rechtlichen Bedingungen.

  • Außergewöhnliches Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsgeschick, eine kundenorientierte Denkweise und eine professionelle, proaktive "Can-Do" -Haltung.

  • Fluent auf Deutsch, mit guten Französisch- und Englischkenntnissen.

Mehr über uns:

Mehr über uns:

>Electrification bietet Technologien entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette der Elektrifizierung – vom Umspannwerk bis zum Verbrauchsort. Damit trägt sie zu einer sicheren und zuverlässigen Stromversorgung bei. Das Portfolio umfasst digitale und vernetzte Innovationen, die die Zuverlässigkeit und Effizienz von Nieder- und Mittelspannungsinstallationen verbessern. Ce poste relève de :

Marketing & Sales Leader - ELSB/ELSP

En tant que Sales Manager - Panel Builders, vous dirigerez l'un des principaux canaux de vente d'ABB Electrification en Suisse. Combinant leadership stratégique avec une forte concentration client, vous stimulerez la croissance rentable, renforcerez les relations client à long terme, et dirigerez une équipe de ventes hautement performante. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des collègues de l'ensemble de l'entreprise, vous jouerez un rôle important pour façonner notre succès commercial tout en aidant les clients à accélérer la transition vers un avenir plus durable et électrifié.

Le modèle de travail est : LI-Hybrid

Vos principales responsabilités seront :

  • Diriger, coacher et développer l'équipe locale de ventes de Panel Builders, en favorisant une culture de haute performance centrée sur le client et en assurant une forte couverture du marché dans toutes les régions de la Suisse.

  • Favoriser la croissance rentable en identifiant de nouvelles possibilités d'affaires et en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies efficaces de vente, de segmentation du marché et de tarification conformes aux objectifs commerciaux d'ABB.

  • Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les principaux clients et partenaires, en assurant une excellente expérience client tout au long du processus de vente.

  • Collaborer de façon interfonctionnelle avec la commercialisation, la commercialisation des produits, les opérations et d'autres intervenants afin d'appuyer la réussite des entreprises, tout en coordonnant la circulation de l'information sur les ventes, en fournissant des prévisions précises et des perspectives de marché, et en gérant les risques commerciaux et contractuels.

Ce que nous recherchons :

  • Baccalauréat ou similaire dans un domaine technique (de préférence en génie électrique) avec un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience en leadership commercial réussie avec une expérience éprouvée sur le marché suisse.

  • Expérience de leadership des personnes démontrées et solide collaboration interfonctionnelle et compétences en travail d'équipe, avec la capacité d'établir des relations efficaces entre les fonctions et l'organisation.

  • Bonne connaissance technique de la distribution d'énergie et de la commande à basse tension ou d'un domaine technique similaire. En outre, la capacité et l'intérêt de vendre et de promouvoir des solutions numériques.

  • Bonne compréhension des négociations contractuelles, de la gestion des risques et des termes commerciaux et juridiques.

  • Des compétences exceptionnelles en communication et en négociation, un état d'esprit axé sur le client et une attitude professionnelle et proactive.

  • Fluent en allemand, avec une bonne maîtrise du français et de l'anglais.

Plus sur nous:

L'électrification offre des technologies dans toute la chaîne de valeur de l'électrification, depuis la sous-station jusqu'au point de consommation. Ce faisant, elle contribue à une alimentation électrique sûre et fiable. Le portefeuille comprend des innovations numériques et connectées qui améliorent la fiabilité et l'efficacité des installations électriques à basse et moyenne tension. Il s'agit notamment de l'infrastructure de recharge des véhicules électriques, des sous-stations modulaires, des solutions d'automatisation de la distribution, des systèmes de commutation, de la technologie des capteurs et des systèmes de commande, ainsi que des systèmes KNX pour l'automatisation et la mise en réseau des infrastructures de construction.

This position reports to:

Chapter Leader Product Management

__

In this role, you will be part of the DC UPS agile team. As a Product Manager within the team you will be responsible for profitable growth of your product line driving and contributing return on investment for ABB’s Power Protection business. You will be part of the DC UPS strategy to market covering specific UPS product lines ensuring ABB has a full understanding of market requirements and transforming those requirements into offer specifications and development activities.

You will also showcase your expertise by performing various offer lifecycle activities a: supporting development, value propositions developments, driving successful launches, managing product maintenance, pricing, and profitability—while meeting aggressive cost-per-kW targets and sustainability commitments.

The role is a Global role with no intention for relocation, the designated locations are where Critical Power have manufacturing units and hence are of a preference, although all candidates are welcome to apply and will be considered.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid and the preferred location of hire is Europe or US


Your role and responsibilities
  • Understanding and following global standards, market and customer requirements, and their impact on the current offer portfolio.
  • Conducting valuation of market size and trends, competitor benchmarking (including reverse-costing), and identifying offering gaps to strengthen ABB’s market standing.
  • Collaborate within the team and other Electrification teams in regards of DC developments and align products with technical standards to ensure a succesful DC UPS development.
  • Managing technical specifications for assigned products and supporting business cases for new developments, cost reduction, and lifecycle transitions.
  • Driving design-to-cost initiatives to achieve low kW targets without compromising quality or compliance.
  • Coordinating IEC/UL certification pathways, sustainability deliverables (EPDs, circularity), and preconfigured solution codes for priority regions.
  • Drive go-to-market activities, including product launches and brand positioning together with other global functions including sales enablement, customer success, training, support, and product expertise where needed.
  • Drive pricing models and be adept at working with templates, thereby achieve target profitability.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or Business Administration (or equivalent).
  • You are highly skilled in Agile methodologies and product management. Understanding of High power / DC technologies within product management are considered an advantage.
  • Ability to demonstrate 5+ years of experience in product management. Gate model experience, stakeholder management and collaboration capabilities together with global functions as Sales, Operations, Service for product success
  • Previous experience with an adjacent topic to DC technologies / products /solutions are nice-to-have
  • Possess advanced knowledge of PLM tools, SAP, and MS Office Suite; familiarity with cost modeling and competitor benchmarking is a plus.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage for APAC engagement.
  • Ability to travel internationally as required.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Regional Sales Manager Europe for Excitation & Hydropower

__

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible to develop the Energy market by executing sales strategy aiming to meet the sales target and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction. You will create, and complete winning bids, estimations or quotations based on customer specification, customer requirements or budget to meet market competitiveness and high margin of the Energy Industries’ sales strategy to accomplish both qualitative and quantitative targets for the business line Excitation in a profitable way.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Energy Industries division in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Customer Engagement: Build and maintain solid customer relationships, ensuring a positive experience and providing technical support during sales interactions.
  • Sales Execution: Enhance sales through strategic initiatives, value-based selling, target setting, and engaged participation in contract negotiations.
  • Bid Management: Manage the preparation of competitive bids and proposals, addressing technical, financial, and project aspects while identifying risks and ensuring accurate documentation.
  • Process & Compliance: Ensure compliance with internal guidelines, efficient use of tools, accurate forecasting, and support for administrative and reporting processes.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor/master’s Electrical Engineering
  • More than 8 years of experience in related field e.g., In Bids & Proposals/Engineering in power generation/industry projects or service
  • Previous experience in the field of Excitation- / power electronics systems / protection or synchronous generators will be a benefit
  • Experience in system modelling or simulation will be an advantage
  • Experience in developing strong customer and internal relationships locally and globally as well as enjoy working in a wide variety of cultures and in many different sectors
  • Fluent in English, German or French language beneficial
  • Willingness to engage directly with clients and teams worldwide—travel commitment up to 15%.

More about us

ABB Energy Industries is enabling safe, smart and sustainable projects and operations for businesses across the oil, gas, chemicals, life sciences, power generation and water sectors. Driving integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify industry we connect our people and technology to help our customers adapt and succeed. With over 50 years domain expertise, we continue to innovate and reshape traditional approaches across the energy sector with our technologies designed to improve operational efficiency, reduce risk, reduce energy consumption and waste.

Are you ready to take off a new journey with ABB? This is your opportunity! We look forward to receiving your application. The recruiting process is being led by Ceren Oezen, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Engineering Manager - GMD

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will ensure the effective delivery of the Service portfolio according to ABB's standard processes and safety guidelines, ensuring customer satisfaction. Each day, you will provide technical support, act as a specialist, and solve problems within your area of expertise. You will also leverage your expertise by proactively communicating with both customers and ABB service sales and life cycle management teams to understand customer needs and capitalize on business opportunities for service growth. The role includes on-site assignments up to 40% of the time.

The work model for the role is: LI-Hybrid

This role contributes to the Business Line Mining & Materials in a global leadership role for the anchor product GMD (Gearless Mill Drive). Main stakeholders include customers, internal service sales and life cycle management teams, and other engineering disciplines.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Providing technical support and solving problems via remote or on-site service, including installation and commissioning, maintenance, repairs, trouble shooting, back-office engineering and consulting, retrofit engineering, etc.

  • Investigating customer needs through professional consulting. Additionally, managing customer relationships and maintaining regular contact with key customers and acting as 24/7 support line for one complete week, approx. every two months, depending on availability.

  • Proactively suggesting product and quality improvements and communicating them within the ABB organization.

  • Providing technical consulting on Service solutions to management and customers. You will join a truly international and dynamic team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role

  • A bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering or any related field.

  • Proven experience as an electrical engineer, product specialist or in a similar technical role, preferably within the power electronics sector.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach with effective communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling seamless collaboration across departments and with customers.

  • Attention to detail, ensuring product conformity, accurate technical documentation, and adherence to quality standard.

  • Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in other languages such as Spanish is a plus.

More about us

GREAT MINDS, GREAT MINES From cellphones, electric vehicles, batteries, wind farms…virtually every aspect of modern life relies on the ores mined from the earth. But there must be a transformation. The demand for minerals has increased significantly, making sustainable, safe, and productive mining more crucial than ever. ABB’s GMD is the most powerful mill drive system in the market to power semi autogenous (SAG), ball and autogenous (AG) mills. This ’workhorse’ for grinding operations combines a robust, service-friendly, and fit-for-purpose design to provide the highest throughput, reliability, and availability for your processing plant.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.

With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations.

Plus au sujet de nous

La Division des solutions de distribution d'ABB fournit des composantes de tension moyenne, des commutateurs et des solutions qui connectent et protègent le réseau électrique en évolution, assurant une distribution fiable et prévisible de l'énergie. Description

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Global Head of Mobile e-Power

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

As part of our strategic growth agenda, we are hiring a Global Mobile e-Power Systems Manager for our Motion Traction business line.

Reporting to the Global Business Line Manager, Mobile e-Power, this role is a key leadership position responsible for defining and driving the global product strategy, system architecture, and portfolio execution for electrified powertrain solutions in mining applications.

This is a global leadership role at the intersection of technology, product management, and business growth. You will lead a team of Product Managers and Mining Engineering specialists, shaping the future of electrified heavy-duty mobile equipment and delivering high-performance, scalable solutions for demanding environments.

This role is open globally, and preferred locations are set close to our main Motion Traction locations in Switzerland, Germany or Poland.

The work model is hybrid #LIhybrid.

Responsibilities

- Own the global product portfolio and lifecycle for mobile e‑power systems, ensuring competitiveness and long-term value creation
- Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap, aligned with business growth objectives and market opportunities
- Translate market trends, customer needs, and technology evolution into differentiated system-level offerings
- Lead and develop a global team of Product Managers, fostering strong product ownership and market focus
- Manage and steer a Mining Engineering team, driving technical excellence and application expertise
- Define and oversee system architecture and integration across power converters, electric motors, battery systems, and control infrastructure
- Engage with key global customers, OEMs, and strategic partners to shape value propositions and strengthen market positioning
- Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, Sales, Operations, and Service to drive innovation, portfolio execution, and business growth

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- At least 8+ years of experience in electrified powertrain systems, e‑mobility, or relevant industrial applications
- Proven experience leading teams, such as Product Managers or senior engineering teams and developing people
- Strong expertise in power electronics, including converters and inverters
- Solid knowledge of electric machines, traction systems, and battery integration
- Experience in system engineering, architecture design, and complex system integration
- Exposure to heavy-duty vehicles, mining equipment, or off-highway applications is strongly preferred
- Strong stakeholder management skills with experience operating in global matrix organizations

Additional Information

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

About ABB Motion

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb /motion

Diversity and Inclusion

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit careers.abb to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Call to Action

Ready to make an impact?
Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB , aiutiamo le industrie a funzionare più snella e più pulita—e ogni persona qui lo fa accadere. Il Global Procurement Specialist / Global Categoria Specialist for Power Electronics Components è un collaboratore individuale senior responsabile per lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione di strategie di categoria globali per il semiconduttore di potenza chiave e componenti passivi utilizzati nelle linee di prodotti di elettronica di potenza di ABB. Il ruolo richiede una profonda conoscenza tecnica dell'elettronica di potere BOMs, un forte acume commerciale, e la capacità di gestire relazioni complesse e multi-sito fornitori a livello globale. Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: ibrido Le tue principali responsabilità saranno: Definire ed eseguire strategie di approvvigionamento di categoria globale per IGBT, condensatori di film/elettrolitici, SCR, Thyristors, Displays e Fuses. Leader globale RFQ/RFP processi; condurre analisi TCO, benchmarking dei costi e negoziati commerciali con fornitori di semiconduttori tier-1 e strategici.

  • Sviluppare e mantenere accordi a lungo termine (LTA) e contratti globali di frame con fornitori chiave (ad esempio Infineon, ABB Semiconductors, Vishay, KYOCERA, Eaton, Littelfuse, ecc.). Gestire la qualificazione del fornitore e l'imbarco in collaborazione con i team di Fornitore Quality Engineering (SQE) e R&D. descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Procurement Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

The Global Procurement Specialist / Global Category Specialist for Power Electronics Components is a senior individual contributor responsible for developing and executing global category strategies for key power semiconductor and passive components used across ABB's power electronics product lines. The role requires deep technical knowledge of power electronics BOMs, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to manage complex, multi-site supplier relationships globally.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

Your main accountabilities will be to:
  • Define and execute global category sourcing strategies for IGBTs, Film/Electrolytic Capacitors, SCRs, Thyristors, Displays, and Fuses.
  • Lead global RFQ/RFP processes; conduct TCO analysis, cost benchmarking, and commercial negotiations with tier-1 and strategic semiconductor suppliers.
  • Develop and maintain long-term agreements (LTAs) and global frame contracts with key suppliers (e.g. Infineon, ABB Semiconductors, Vishay, KYOCERA, Eaton, Littelfuse, etc.).
  • Manage supplier qualification and onboarding in collaboration with Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE) and R&D teams.
  • Analyse global spend, supplier concentration, and market trends; develop dual-source and multi-source strategies to mitigate supply risk.
  • Monitor power semiconductor market dynamics (silicon, SiC, GaN), component lifecycle, and obsolescence management; implement last-time-buy strategies.
  • Drive year-over-year cost savings through volume consolidation, competitive sourcing, design-to-cost, and VA/VE initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and NPI teams globally to influence component selection and ensure strategic alignment from product concept through mass production.
  • Manage end-to-end contract lifecycle: drafting, review, execution, and compliance monitoring.
  • Report category performance (cost savings, OTD, quality, risk) to senior management on a regular basis.
  • Support global sites (Bangalore, Quartino, Richmond, Frosinone, and others) in executing local procurement aligned with global category strategy.
  • Ensure full compliance with ABB procurement policies, trade-compliance requirements (export control, sanctions), and supplier sustainability (ESG) standards.


Key Performance Indicators

  • Annual cost savings vs. target (PPV, negotiated savings)
  • Supplier On-Time Delivery (OTD) and quality performance
  • LTA / frame contract coverage (% of category spend)
  • Single-source risk reduction (dual-source coverage rate)
  • Component obsolescence incidents and resolution time
  • Supplier sustainability (ESG) assessment coverage

Our team dynamics
You will join a dynamic team, where you will be able to thrive.



• Qualifications for the role
  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics/Power Electronics Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
  • 5–12 years of experience in strategic procurement or category management for power electronics or semiconductor components.
  • Deep technical understanding of IGBTs, thyristors, SCRs, capacitors, fuses, and display technologies used in industrial power electronics.
  • Proven track record in global supplier negotiations, LTA management, and category strategy execution.
  • Familiarity with power electronics products (drives, converters, UPS, traction, renewable energy systems) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, or similar sourcing platforms; advanced MS Excel and Power BI skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel internationally (up to 20–30%).
  • Fluent English (mandatory); Italian, German, or Spanish is an advantage depending on location.
  • Professional certifications (CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent) are a plus.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Ce poste relève de:

Global Procurement Manager

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Le Global Procurement Specialist / Global Category Specialist for Power Electronics Components est un collaborateur principal chargé d'élaborer et d'exécuter des stratégies de catégorie mondiale pour les principaux semi-conducteurs de puissance et composants passifs utilisés dans les gammes de produits de l'électronique de puissance d'ABB. Le rôle exige une connaissance technique approfondie de l'électronique de puissance BOMs, un sens commercial fort, et la capacité de gérer des relations complexes et multi-sites fournisseurs à l'échelle mondiale.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : hybride

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :
  • Définir et exécuter des stratégies d'approvisionnement de catégorie globale pour les IGBT, les condensateurs de films/électrolytiques, les SCR, les Thyristors, les Displays et les Fuses.
  • Diriger les processus mondiaux de RFQ/RFP; effectuer des analyses de TCO, des analyses comparatives des coûts et des négociations commerciales avec les fournisseurs de semi-conducteurs stratégiques de niveau 1.
  • Élaborer et maintenir des ententes à long terme (ALE) et des contrats-cadres mondiaux avec des fournisseurs clés (p. ex. Infineon, ABB Semiconductors, Vishay, KYOCERA, Eaton, Littelfuse, etc.).
  • Gérer la qualification et l'embarquement des fournisseurs en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de la qualité des fournisseurs et de R-D.
  • Analyser les dépenses mondiales, la concentration des fournisseurs et les tendances du marché; élaborer des stratégies à deux sources et à plusieurs sources pour atténuer le risque d'approvisionnement.
  • Moniteur dynamique du marché des semi-conducteurs d'énergie (silicium, SiC, GaN), cycle de vie des composants et gestion de l'obsolescence; mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'achat pour la dernière fois.
  • Conduire des économies de coûts d'une année à l'autre grâce à la consolidation du volume, à l'approvisionnement concurrentiel, à la conception au coût et à des initiatives d'AV/VE.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes du génie et de l'INN à l'échelle mondiale pour influencer la sélection des composantes et assurer l'alignement stratégique du concept de produit à la production de masse.
  • Gérer le cycle de vie des contrats de bout en bout : rédaction, examen, exécution et surveillance de la conformité.
  • Rapporter régulièrement le rendement de la catégorie (économies de coûts, DTO, qualité, risque) à la haute direction. Appuyer les sites mondiaux (Bangalore, Quartino, Richmond, Frosinone, etc.) dans l'exécution des achats locaux alignés sur la stratégie de catégorie mondiale.
  • Assurer la pleine conformité aux politiques d'approvisionnement de l'ABB, aux exigences en matière de conformité au commerce (contrôle des exportations, sanctions) et aux normes de durabilité des fournisseurs (ESG).

Principaux indicateurs de rendement

  • Épargnes de coûts annuels par rapport à la cible (PPV, économies négociées)
  • Livraison en temps voulu du fournisseur (OTD) et rendement en matière de qualité
  • Couverture des contrats (% des dépenses de catégorie)
  • Réduction des risques à source unique (taux de couverture à double source)
  • Incidences d'obsolescence du fournisseur et délai de résolution
  • Couverture de l'évaluation de la viabilité du fournisseur (ESG)
Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique, où vous pourrez prospérer.



• Qualifications pour le rôle
  • Bachelor's/Master en génie électrique/électronique/électronique de puissance, gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ou domaine connexe.
  • 5–12 ans d'expérience en approvisionnement stratégique ou en gestion de catégorie pour l'électronique de puissance ou les composants semi-conducteurs.
  • Connaissance technique approfondie des IGBT, des thyristors, des SCR, des condensateurs, des fusibles et des technologies d'affichage utilisées dans l'électronique de puissance industrielle.
  • Expérience éprouvée dans les négociations mondiales sur les fournisseurs, la gestion de l'ALT et l'exécution de la stratégie de catégorie.
  • La familiarité avec les produits électroniques de puissance (drives, convertisseurs, UPS, traction, systèmes d'énergie renouvelable) est fortement préférée.
  • Expérience avec SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, ou des plateformes d'approvisionnement similaires; compétences avancées MS Excel et Power BI.
  • Capacité et volonté de voyager à l'étranger (jusqu'à 20-30 %).
  • Fluent English (obligatoire); l'italien, l'allemand ou l'espagnol est un avantage selon l'emplacement.
  • Les certifications professionnelles (CPSM, CIPS ou équivalent) sont un plus.

  • Cette possibilité est ouverte aux candidats dans plusieurs pays, le lieu de travail final étant déterminé en fonction du candidat sélectionné. Comme la rémunération peut varier selon l'endroit, nous nous engageons à être transparents tout au long du processus d'embauche et partagerons les détails de l'échelle salariale, de la rémunération variable et des avantages sociaux avec les candidats qui passent à la première étape de l'entrevue pour un lieu dans l'Union européenne, couverte par la directive de l'UE sur la transparence des rémunérations.
    L'offre finale sera adaptée en fonction de l'emplacement, de l'expérience, des compétences et des qualifications, du positionnement et de l'alignement du marché intérieur sur les normes internes ABB.

    Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Manager Production Development

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will lead processes that safeguard the efficiency, reliability, and performance of automated production equipment, production lines, and facilities across a dynamic manufacturing environment. This includes our new, state-of-the-art automated battery pack plant, complementing our established battery module and pack lines as well as converter lines. You will ensure that maintenance strategies, technical documentation, and improvement initiatives drive high availability, operational excellence, and the best possible use of technical and financial resources. The role also calls for close collaboration with production engineering to strengthen team redundancy while continuously advancing highly automated manufacturing processes.

The work model for the role is: onsite

This role is contributing to the Traction Operations in Untersiggenthal and Baden. Main stakeholders are ABB Energy Storage Systems and Converter Production.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Partial or full leadership of the Traction Operations maintenance group, coordinating maintenance activities and supporting group performance and development.

  • Defining and implementing maintenance strategies and plans for automated production lines, improving reliability, maintainability, and safety of equipment and facilities.

  • Introducing, developing, and maintaining CMMS tools while ensuring accurate and up-to-date technical documentation of production equipment and systems.

  • Troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues in automated production lines to ensure high availability and stable production performance.

  • Driving continuous improvement initiatives by proposing and implementing projects that optimize production processes, reduce maintenance needs, and enhance operational efficiency in very close collaboration with production development engineers.



You will join an ambitious and high-performing production development team operating highly automated systems. Collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement are key to our success.



• Qualifications for the role

  • Strong experience in industrial maintenance of automated production equipment, including electrical, mechanical, and automation systems

  • Solid knowledge of automation technologies such as PLC programming, robotics, sensors, industrial communication networks, and automated production systems

  • Experience with maintenance concepts, troubleshooting, CMMS systems, machine diagnostics, and reliability improvement methodologies (e.g., OEE optimization, lean manufacturing)

  • Understanding of production engineering principles, or willingness and motivation to learn and contribute to production engineering topics to ensure team redundancy and cross-functional support

  • Proven qualification in Electrical Engineering, Automation Technology, Mechatronics, or a comparable technical field, or equivalent hands-on industrial experience

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable technical improvements

  • You are at ease communicating in German


More about us

The ABB Traction Division is a recognized market leader in drive technologies for rail vehicles, buses, and industrial vehicles, driving innovation in electrification.

Our comprehensive portfolio of high-performance traction, auxiliary, and energy storage solutions – all managed across the entire life cycle – helps to improve energy efficiency and make transportation more sustainable.

Together, we make a difference for our customers every single day. We look forward to receiving your application.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Die Rolle erfordert auch eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Produktionstechnik, um die Teamredundanz zu stärken und gleichzeitig die hochautomatisierten Fertigungsprozesse kontinuierlich voranzutreiben.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: onsite

Diese Rolle trägt zu den Traction Operations in Untersiggenthal und Baden bei. Hauptakteure sind ABB Energy Storage Systems und Converter Production.

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Teilweise oder vollständige Führung der Wartungsgruppe Traction Operations, Koordination der Wartungsaktivitäten und Unterstützung der Leistung und Entwicklung der Gruppe.

  • Definition und Umsetzung von Wartungsstrategien und -plänen für automatisierte Produktionslinien, Verbesserung der Zuverlässigkeit, Wartbarkeit und Sicherheit von Geräten und Anlagen.

  • Einführung, Entwicklung und Wartung von CMMS-Tools bei gleichzeitiger Gewährleistung einer genauen und aktuellen technischen Dokumentation von Produktionsanlagen und -systemen.

  • Troubleshooting und Behebung komplexer technischer Probleme in automatisierten Produktionslinien, um eine hohe Verfügbarkeit und stabile Produktionsleistung zu gewährleisten.

  • Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen durch Vorschlagen und Umsetzen von Projekten, die Produktionsprozesse optimieren, Wartungsanforderungen reduzieren und die Betriebseffizienz in sehr enger Zusammenarbeit mit Produktionsentwicklungsingenieuren verbessern.



Sie werden Teil eines ambitionierten und leistungsstarken Produktionsentwicklungsteams, das hochautomatisierte Systeme betreibt. Zusammenarbeit, technische Exzellenz und kontinuierliche Verbesserung sind der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg.



• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Starke Erfahrung in der industriellen Wartung von automatisierten Produktionsanlagen, einschließlich elektrischer, mechanischer und Automatisierungssysteme

  • Fundiertes Wissen über Automatisierungstechnologien wie SPS-Programmierung, Robotik, Sensoren, industrielle Kommunikationsnetzwerke und automatisierte Produktionssysteme

  • Erfahrung mit Wartungskonzepten, Fehlerbehebung, CMMS-Systemen, Maschinendiagnostik und Zuverlässigkeitsverbesserungsmethoden (z. B. OEE-Optimierung, Lean Manufacturing)

  • Verständnis von Produktionstechnik-Prinzipien oder Bereitschaft und Motivation, zu Themen der Produktionstechnik zu lernen und beizutragen, um Teamredundanz und funktionsübergreifende Unterstützung zu gewährleisten

  • Nachgewiesene Qualifikation in Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Mechatronik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich oder gleichwertige praktische Industrieerfahrung

  • Starke analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Ursachen zu erkennen und nachhaltige technische Verbesserungen umzusetzen

  • Sie kommunizieren gerne auf Deutsch


Mehr über uns

Die ABB Traction Division ist ein anerkannter Marktführer für Antriebstechnologien für Schienenfahrzeuge, Busse und Industriefahrzeuge, der Innovationen in der Elektrifizierung vorantreibt.

<

Unser umfassendes Portfolio an leistungsstarken Traktions-, Hilfs- und Energiespeicherlösungen – alle über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg verwaltet – trägt dazu bei, die Energieeffizienz zu verbessern und den Transport nachhaltiger zu gestalten.

    • Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité d'identifier les causes profondes et de mettre en oeuvre des améliorations techniques durables

Product Line Manager

The Product Specialist serves as the operational backbone of the Process Performance Motor portfolio, responsible for maintaining product data quality, supporting lifecycle projects, coordinating cross-functional activities, and providing market and competitive intelligence. This role translates customer and market needs into actionable insights, ensuring that Product Management and R&D decisions are grounded in accurate data and real customer requirements.

The IEC Low Voltage Division is a technology leader delivering a full range of energy-efficient low voltage motors, including ultra-efficient solutions such as IE5 SynRM (synchronous reluctance motors). Description
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Finance Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support key finance activities while gaining hands-on experience in a global technology and industrial company. Each day, you will contribute to business operations by working closely with finance professionals and business stakeholders, helping to drive data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Finance Team in the Distribution Solution in Electrification Business Area.

This internship will be based in Zurich, with a start date of August 2026 and a duration of 6 or 7 months.

Responsibilities
You will be mainly accountable for:

- Supporting the implementation and rollout of the new SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) 5QRF reporting environment, including testing, validation, documentation, and user support activities.
- Assisting with the preparation and coordination of the Annual Planning Process (APP) by supporting data collection, analysis, reporting, and planning activities across global business units.
- Participating in the testing, validation, and continuous improvement of new CFIN reports and dashboards, helping to ensure data accuracy and reporting effectiveness.
- Supporting CFIN master data management activities, including master data setup, harmonization, and cleanup initiatives to improve data quality and reporting consistency.
- Contributing to the Clean Sales Order Project by assisting with data quality analysis, root-cause investigations, KPI tracking, and process improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing order data quality and governance.
- Collaborating with various stakeholders across multiple countries on assignments with clearly defined KPIs, gaining exposure to diverse business processes and intercultural teamwork.
- Delivering assigned tasks and projects within the internship period while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the finance organization.
- Participating in formal training programs and development activities to strengthen finance, analytical, digital, and leadership skills

Requirements
Qualifications for the role :

- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Strong interest in corporate finance, financial analysis, controlling, and business performance management.
- Solid analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with large sets of data.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with Power BI, SAP, or other financial reporting and analytics tools is an advantage.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Passionate about learning, continuous improvement, and working in a multicultural environment.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present information clearly and effectively.

More about us
ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.

We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

At ELDS Finance team w e act as business partners providing strategic and effective financial planning to ensure profitable growth for the Division and its Business Lines. We strive to be the best Finance team with fit-for-purpose processes and systems, enabling ABB to create superior value.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Contact
Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Mehr über uns Die Division Distribution Solutions von ABB bietet Mittelspannungskomponenten, Schaltanlagen und Lösungen, die das sich entwickelnde Stromnetz verbinden und schützen, um eine zuverlässige und vorhersehbare Energieverteilung zu gewährleisten. Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

Description Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres, et chaque personne ici fait cela. Vous serez habilité à diriger, soutenu pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble.

Ce poste relève de : Gestionnaire des finances

__

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités :

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la possibilité de soutenir des activités financières clés tout en gagnant une expérience pratique dans une entreprise technologique et industrielle mondiale. Chaque jour, vous contribuerez aux opérations commerciales en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les professionnels des finances et les parties prenantes, contribuant à la prise de décisions axées sur les données et à l'amélioration continue.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est: hybride

Ce rôle contribue à l'équipe financière dans le domaine d'activité de la solution de distribution dans le domaine de l'électrification.

Ce stage sera basé à Zurich, avec une date de début d'août 2026 et une durée de 6 ou 7 mois.

Responsabilités Vous serez principalement responsable :

- Appuyer la mise en oeuvre et la mise en oeuvre du nouvel environnement de rapport SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) 5QRF, y compris les activités de test, de validation, de documentation et de soutien aux utilisateurs. - Aider à la préparation et à la coordination du processus de planification annuelle (PPA) en appuyant les activités de collecte, d'analyse, de rapport et de planification des données dans les unités commerciales mondiales. - Participer aux essais, à la validation et à l'amélioration continue des nouveaux rapports et tableaux de bord CFIN, contribuant ainsi à assurer l'exactitude et l'efficacité des données.

- Appuyer les activités de gestion des données de base du CFIN, y compris les initiatives de configuration, d'harmonisation et de nettoyage des données pour améliorer la qualité des données et la cohérence des rapports. - Contribuer au projet de l'ordre de vente propre en aidant à l'analyse de la qualité des données, aux enquêtes sur les causes profondes, au suivi de l'ICP et aux initiatives d'amélioration des processus visant à améliorer la qualité des données et la gouvernance des ordres. - Collaborer avec divers intervenants de plusieurs pays pour des missions comportant des ICR clairement définis, pour mieux connaître les processus d'affaires et le travail d'équipe interculturel.

- Réalisation des tâches et des projets assignés au cours de la période de stage tout en contribuant aux initiatives d'amélioration continue au sein de l'organisme financier. - Participation aux programmes de formation officiels et aux activités de développement pour renforcer les compétences en finance, en analyse, en numérique et en leadership

Exigences Qualifications pour le rôle :

- Il est actuellement titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en finance, comptabilité, économie, administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe. - Il s'agit d'un domaine très intéressant pour la finance d'entreprise, l'analyse financière, le contrôle et la gestion de la performance des entreprises. - Il est avantageux de posséder de solides compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes, en fonction de la capacité de travailler avec de vastes ensembles de données. - Compétence en Microsoft Excel et PowerPoint; connaissance de Power BI, SAP ou d'autres outils d'analyse et de rapports financiers. - Il est important de prêter attention aux détails et d'assurer un travail précis et de haute qualité.

- Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et de travailler efficacement, de façon indépendante et dans le cadre d'une équipe. - Passionné d'apprendre, d'améliorer continuellement et de travailler dans un environnement multiculturel. - Forte capacité de communication et d'interaction, avec la capacité de présenter l'information de façon claire et efficace.

En savoir plus sur nous La division Distribution Solutions d'ABB fournit des composants de moyenne tension, des commutateurs et des solutions qui relient et protègent le réseau électrique en évolution, assurant une distribution d'énergie fiable et prévisible. Nous lions les systèmes à haut-Voltage aux consommateurs à moyen et faible-Voltage, assurant une distribution continue d'énergie aux utilisateurs industriels, commerciaux et résidentiels tout en permettant l'intégration des sources d'énergie renouvelables dans le réseau.

Nous soutenons nos clients et partenaires dans leur capacité à rester en avance sur les besoins croissants en électrification, la technologie et les changements réglementaires, fournissant ainsi la puissance nécessaire pour s'adapter à un paysage énergétique en évolution rapide.

Nous nous efforçons d'être la meilleure équipe de la division des finances avec des processus et des systèmes adaptés à l'usage, ce qui permet à ABB de créer une valeur supérieure.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences.

Contact Prêt à faire un impact?

Faites votre demande aujourd'hui ou visitez https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions dans le monde entier.
