descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Division CFO Smart Buildings

__

IS Division Manager ELSB

Location

This is a global role. The candidate can be based anywhere globally, preferably in Europe and close to an ELSB plant.

In this role, you will lead the Information Systems (IS) function for the Smart Buildings Division, shaping and executing the division’s IS strategy to support business growth and operational excellence. You will be accountable for the division’s IS architecture, technology roadmap, and project portfolio, ensuring the delivery of secure, reliable, and business-focused IS services.

You will drive the modernization, simplification, and standardization of the division’s IS landscape while maintaining alignment with ABB’s enterprise architecture, governance standards, and cybersecurity requirements. In close partnership with business and technology stakeholders, you will identify opportunities to leverage digital technologies, optimize IS investments, and maximize the value delivered through technology solutions.

As a member of the EL IS leadership team, you will build strong relationships across the organization, influence strategic decisions, and foster collaboration between business and IS functions. You will also lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing IS team, promoting a culture of innovation, accountability, continuous improvement, and customer-centricity.

This role is contributing to the Smart Buildings Division within Electrification. Main stakeholders are Division Leadership Team, Electrification IS Manager & direct ELSB IS Management.

• Responsibilities

  • IS Strategy & Architecture: Develop IS strategy and architecture for the Smart Buildings Division in alignment with division business strategy, and broader ABB IS strategy and Enterprise Architecture. Drive modernization and simplification of division IS landscape as part of ABB DSM program, and support data standardization initiatives.

  • IS Delivery: Own and ensure successful delivery of the division distinct IS project portfolio, and Core and Common projects impacting Smart Buildings Division. Deliver Smart Buildings provided IS services, both Distinct and Common (e.g. Country IS Services in Germany, Saudi Arabia as well as Salesforce.com for whole of ABB), and ensure that Core and Common IS services received are in line with agreed SLAs. Drive continuous improvement and facilitate best practice sharing.

  • IS Policies & Information Security adherence: Ensure compliance with ABB IS Enterprise Architecture, relevant IS Policies and regulations. Ensure information security governance, risk management, and compliance across the division.

  • Budget & Financial Control: Control IS budget, spend and cost allocation, ensuring financial accuracy and transparency to optimize controllable IS spend and ensure value-added investments.

  • People Leadership & Development: Ensure your area is properly organized, staffed, skilled, and directed. Guide, motivate, and develop direct and indirect subordinates, demonstrating strong leadership driven by collaboration, transparency, and IS technical know-how.

• Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience across a broad range of information technology disciplines

  • Proven experience leading IS/IT teams, projects, and business initiatives in a complex, global environment with the ability to coach, develop, motivate, and lead high-performing teams across multiple locations and cultures.

  • Strategic technology leader with strong analytical skills, translating business needs into impactful technology solutions and roadmaps aligned to enterprise objectives.

  • Business- and value-focused, with expertise in financial management, technology portfolios, budgets, and vendor partnerships to maximize ROI and operational performance.

  • Influential collaborator and communicator, building strong stakeholder relationships and driving alignment across business and technology teams.

  • Results-driven change agent, leading technology adoption, continuous improvement, and operational excellence while delivering measurable business outcomes.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Ce poste se rapporte à :

Division CFO Smart Buildings

Gestionnaire de la Division du SIS ELSB

Emplacement

C'est un rôle mondial. Le candidat peut être basé partout dans le monde, de préférence en Europe et à proximité d'une usine ELSB.

Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez la fonction de systèmes d'information (SI) de la Division des bâtiments intelligents, façonnant et exécutant la division. Vous serez responsable de l'architecture de SI de la division, de la feuille de route technologique et du portefeuille de projets, assurant la prestation de services de SI sécuritaires, fiables et axés sur les entreprises.

Vous dirigerez la modernisation, la simplification et la normalisation du paysage IS de la division, tout en maintenant l'alignement sur l'architecture d'entreprise d'ABB, les normes de gouvernance et les exigences de cybersécurité. En partenariat étroit avec les intervenants du secteur des affaires et de la technologie, vous identifierez les possibilités de tirer parti des technologies numériques, d'optimiser les investissements dans les SI et de maximiser la valeur offerte par les solutions technologiques.

En tant que membre de l'équipe de leadership des SI, vous établirez de solides relations dans l'ensemble de l'organisation, influencerez les décisions stratégiques et favoriserez la collaboration entre les fonctions des SI et celles des entreprises. Vous dirigerez, développerez et inspirerez également une équipe de SI hautement performante, favorisant une culture d'innovation, de responsabilisation, d'amélioration continue et de centrage client.
Ce rôle contribue à la division des bâtiments intelligents au sein de l'électrification. Les principaux intervenants sont Équipe de leadership de la Division, gestionnaire des SI d'électrification et gestion directe des SI d'ELSB.

• Responsabilités

  • Stratégie et architecture du SIS: Élaborer une stratégie et une architecture du SIS pour la Division des bâtiments intelligents en harmonie avec la stratégie opérationnelle de la Division, et une stratégie plus large du SIS et de l'architecture d'entreprise de l'ABB. Favoriser la modernisation et la simplification du paysage des SI de division dans le cadre du programme ABB DSM, et appuyer les initiatives de normalisation des données.

  • IS Mise en oeuvre: Propre et assurer la prestation réussie du portefeuille distinct de projets de SI de la division, et des projets communs et de base ayant une incidence sur la Division des bâtiments intelligents. Fournir des bâtiments intelligents a fourni des services de SI, à la fois distincts et communs (par exemple, les services de SI de pays en Allemagne, en Arabie saoudite ainsi que Salesforce.com pour l'ensemble d'ABB), et s'assurer que les services de SI de base et communs reçus sont conformes aux SLA convenus. Favoriser l'amélioration continue et faciliter le partage des pratiques exemplaires.

  • Politiques et sécurité de l'information du SISadhésion: Assurer le respect de l'architecture d'entreprise ABB IS, des politiques et des règlements pertinents IS. Assurer la gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information, la gestion des risques et la conformité dans l'ensemble de la division.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Senior Digital Communications Manager

__

As Group Social Media Manager you will be the driving force behind our brand's presence across the Group social media channels, sitting at the corporate team of a large, highly decentralized organization. You will be hands-on, bring creative instinct, a strategic thinker and know how to get things done with a high degree of collaboration with multiple stakeholders.

Working model: hybrid #LI-hybrid

• Responsibilities

  • Creating and publishing content. You will plan and post content developed by other colleagues and by you, across social media channels, including LinkedIn, Instagram, and X, ensuring ABB’s brand shows up consistently, relevantly, and with impact.

  • Repurposing and amplifying. You will work across the organization to surface the best of what they are already producing and reshape it for the Group social media channels.

  • Engage with our audience. You will monitor comments, messages, and mentions, ensuring we engage with our audience in a way that builds trust, fosters community, and builds and protects our reputation.

  • Create live moments. You will plan and execute regular live social media events, both topical and evergreen, around key company milestones and business priorities

  • Work with influencers. You will identify, engage, and manage relationships with influencers whose voice and audience align with our brand, co-creating content that extends our reach authentically and credibly.

  • Manage agencies and external partners. You will brief, coordinate, and hold the agencies we work with accountable, ensuring their output is always on brand, on brief, and on time.

  • Navigate a complex organization. You will collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, each with their own priorities, building alignment and buy-in. You will play a key role in driving our Social Media Community of Practice, where social media colleagues from across the company come together to connect, learn and grow together.

  • Protect and empower the organization. You will develop guidelines, toolkits, and trainings that equip colleagues to use social media confidently and responsibly, safeguarding our brand wherever it shows up online.

  • Measure and report. You will track performance across Group channels, turning data into clear insights and actionable recommendations that inform our strategy and demonstrate the value of social media to leadership.

• Qualifications / Experience / Skills

  • Approx 8-10 years of communications experience with at least 5 years of experience in social media management, ideally within a large, decentralized and complex organization.

  • Proven track record of managing social media channels end-to-end, from strategy to execution.

  • Degree in communications, marketing, journalism, or a related field.

  • Proficiency with social media and project management tools (e.g. Sprout Social, Asana, Talkwalker).

  • Experience working with and briefing agencies, as well as running influencer programs and partnerships.

  • Experience collaborating across multiple teams, geographies and business units. Able to build buy-in across a decentralized organization without formal authority.

  • Experience organizing social media live events. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities.

  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt tone and format across platforms.

  • Solid understanding of the major social media platforms and their respective best practices (LinkedIn, Instagram, X, and others).

  • Ability to repurpose and repackage content creatively from diverse sources.

  • Demonstrable awareness and sound judgment when it comes to reputational risk.

  • Proficiency with analytics platforms (Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence preferred)

  • Familiarity with basic content creation tools (e.g. Canva, Adobe)

  • Candidates must be eligible to work in Switzerland. Visa sponsorship is not offered for this position.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Senior Digital Communications Manager

Als Group Social Media Manager werden Sie die treibende Kraft hinter unseren Marken sein Präsenz über die Social-Media-Kanäle der Gruppe hinweg, sitzend im Unternehmensteam einer großen, stark dezentralen Organisation. Sie werden hands-on, bringen kreativen Instinkt, einen strategischen Denker und wissen, wie man Dinge mit einem hohen Maß an Zusammenarbeit mit mehreren Stakeholdern erledigt.

Arbeitsmodell: hybrid #LI-hybrid

• Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Erstellen und Veröffentlichen von Inhalten. Sie planen und posten Inhalte, die von anderen Kollegen und von Ihnen entwickelt wurden, über Social-Media-Kanäle, einschließlich LinkedIn, Instagram und X, um sicherzustellen, dass die Marke von ABB konsistent, relevant und mit Wirkung erscheint.

  • Verwendung und Verstärkung. Sie werden im gesamten Unternehmen daran arbeiten, das Beste aus dem, was sie bereits produzieren, herauszuholen und es für die Social-Media-Kanäle der Gruppe neu zu gestalten.

  • Mit unserem Publikum in Kontakt treten. Sie werden Kommentare, Nachrichten und Erwähnungen überwachen, um sicherzustellen, dass wir mit unserem Publikum in einer Weise interagieren, die Vertrauen schafft, die Gemeinschaft fördert und unseren Ruf aufbaut und schützt.

  • Erstellen Sie Live-Momente. Sie planen und führen regelmäßige Live-Social-Media-Events, sowohl aktuelle als auch immergrüne, rund um wichtige Meilensteine des Unternehmens und Geschäftsprioritäten aus

  • Arbeiten Sie mit Influencern. Sie identifizieren, engagieren und verwalten Beziehungen zu Influencern, deren Stimme und Publikum mit unserer Marke übereinstimmen, und erstellen gemeinsam Inhalte, die unsere Reichweite authentisch und glaubwürdig erweitern.

  • Agenturen und externe Partner verwalten. Sie werden die Agenturen, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten, briefen, koordinieren und zur Rechenschaft ziehen, um sicherzustellen, dass ihre Ergebnisse immer auf der Marke, kurz und pünktlich sind.

  • Navigieren Sie eine komplexe Organisation. Sie werden mit einer Vielzahl von Interessengruppen zusammenarbeiten, jeder mit seinen eigenen Prioritäten, Aufbau von Ausrichtung und Buy-in. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Förderung unserer Social Media Community of Practice, in der Social Media-Kollegen aus dem gesamten Unternehmen zusammenkommen, um sich zu verbinden, zu lernen und gemeinsam zu wachsen.

  • Schützen und stärken Sie die Organisation. Sie entwickeln Richtlinien, Toolkits und Schulungen, die Kollegen in die Lage versetzen, soziale Medien selbstbewusst und verantwortungsbewusst zu nutzen und unsere Marke zu schützen, wo immer sie online auftaucht.

  • Messen und berichten. Sie verfolgen die Leistung über alle Gruppenkanäle hinweg und verwandeln Daten in klare Erkenntnisse und umsetzbare Empfehlungen, die unsere Strategie beeinflussen und den Wert sozialer Medien für die Führung demonstrieren.

• Qualifikationen / Erfahrung / Skills

  • Rund 8-10 Jahre Kommunikationserfahrung mit mindestens 5 Jahren Erfahrung im Social Media Management, idealerweise innerhalb einer großen, dezentralen und komplexen Organisation.

  • Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung von Social Media Kanälen durchgängig, von der Strategie bis zur Ausführung.

  • Abschluss in Kommunikation, Marketing, Journalismus oder einem verwandten Bereich.

  • Proficiency mit Social Media und Projektmanagement Tools (z. B. Sprout Social, Asana, Talkwalker).

  • Experience working with and briefing agencys, sowie Durchführung von Influencer-Programmen und Partnerschaften.

  • Experience in Zusammenarbeit mit mehreren Teams, Regionen und Geschäftseinheiten. Kann Buy-in in einer dezentralen Organisation ohne formelle Autorität aufbauen.

  • Erleben Sie, wie Sie Social Media-Live-Events organisieren. Starkes Projektmanagement und organisatorische Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu jonglieren.

  • Starke Schreib- und Storytelling-Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Ton und Format plattformübergreifend anzupassen.

  • Solides Verständnis der wichtigsten Social-Media-Plattformen und ihrer jeweiligen Best Practices (LinkedIn, Instagram, X und andere).

  • Fähigkeit, Inhalte kreativ aus verschiedenen Quellen wiederzuverwenden und neu zu verpacken.

  • Demonstrierbares Bewusstsein und fundiertes Urteilsvermögen in Bezug auf Reputationsrisiken.

  • Proficiency with Analytics Platforms (Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence preferred)

  • Familiarity with basic content creation tools (e.g. Canva, Adobe)

  • Bewerber müssen in der Schweiz arbeiten können. Visa-Sponsoring wird für diese Position nicht angeboten.


Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

Responsible for the development and the testing of complex FPGA Firmware (VHDL) for traction and auxiliary converters in railway applications

Feasibility studies, simulation, implementation, testing and documentation according to traction development processes

-

-
Work in interdisciplinary project teams with engineers from power electronics and control domains

Degree (MSc or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering or a related field

- Bewährte Erfahrung im programmierbaren Logikdesign (VHDL) und starke Expertise in FPGA-Architekturen

- Kenntnisse der elektronischen Systeme werden als ein Vorteil angesehen

- Die Erfahrung mit Testmethoden und Softwareentwicklungsprozessen ist ein Vorteil

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global R&D Mgr., Service Division

__

Electrification Business Area Research Manager

Location for the role

Global role with a preference for a location in Europe, an ABB Corporate Research Center location, or a major Electrification R&D site.

This role reports to the Electrification Chief Technology Officer.

• Responsibilities

In this role, you create and lead a high-impact research portfolio across the core technologies relevant for Electrification Business product and service offerings. You will lead research direction and execution by coordinating global resources in the development of new concepts, technologies, technical platforms, and intellectual property.

  • Define strategic research direction together with the Business Lines and CTO and ensures the creation of global technology roadmaps and a high-impact research project portfolio. Coordinate all global research activities.

  • Build a culture of innovation and actively explore relevant new technologies across industries and academia. Facilitate partnering between the Research Centers and Business Lines to ensure business objectives are included in the strategic technology roadmaps.

  • Set project targets, oversee execution of technology roadmaps for the electrification research, and achieve research performance targets. Ensure appropriate project planning, prioritization, and execution of projects in Research Centers.

  • Oversee transfer of technology and knowledge between the Corporate Research Centers (CRC) and internal partners.

  • Maintain effective relationships with global research community, network with universities and innovation partners, and support marketing and promotion activities around research.

  • Manage relevant legal contracts for IP and licensing of technology related to research.

  • Ensure financial planning and budgeting for research. Monitor progress against financial targets and take actions as needed. Manage global resource portfolio. Prepare global resource budget for research. Define and agree resource and skills plan with local CRCs.


• Qualifications

  • 15+ years’ experience in Research or R&D and experience in electrical distribution or related industries

  • MS in Engineering discipline required; PhD preferred

  • Familiar with core Electrification technologies: electrical systems, power electronics, switching & protection, intelligent systems

  • Innovative thought leader; outstanding communicator

  • Able to connect research to Division strategic needs

  • Effective project portfolio manager

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:

Agile Unit Leader Solutions

__

The Application Engineering Chapter Leader drives and continuously advances application expertise for the Critical Power business within ABB Electrification Smart Power (ELSP). This role is responsible for establishing and sharing best practices, standards, and domain know-how that enable customer and market requirements to be translated into optimized solutions and compelling value propositions. Through coaching, mentoring, and capability development, the Chapter Leader fosters a high-performing team of application engineering professionals.

The role leads the development of standards, tools, frameworks, and guidelines that enable efficient solution design, product selection, and adaptation to diverse customer needs. Working closely with Sales and other stakeholders, the Chapter Leader builds competencies across applications, solution architectures, market segments, channels, and value proposition development to support effective solution positioning and business growth.

In addition, the Chapter Leader owns and evolves key knowledge assets, including use cases, reference architectures, technical documentation, and reusable solution frameworks for the Critical Power portfolio. By fostering collaboration and knowledge exchange across Sales, Product Management, R&D, and Agile Units, the role ensures customer needs, emerging use cases, and market insights are captured, shared, and leveraged to support portfolio evolution, innovation priorities, and future product development.

This is a global role with preferred hiring locations in Quartino (Switzerland), Heidelberg (Germany), and Bergamo (Italy). The working model is hybrid.

Roles and • Responsibilities

  • Ensure the Application Engineering Chapter mission is delivered.
  • Act as a coach and subject matter expert, developing chapter members' competencies and skills.
  • Lead chapter alignment meetings, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities.
  • Build and nurture expertise in applications, solution architectures, market segments, channels, and customer value propositions for the Critical Power (ELSP) portfolio.
  • Develop and maintain standards, methods, tools, and best practices for application engineering.
  • Own and continuously evolve application knowledge, key use cases, reference architectures, technical documentation, and reusable solution frameworks.
  • Drive continuous learning and awareness of customer needs, market trends, competitive positioning, and segment dynamics within the chapter.
  • Ensure chapter members are equipped to identify and communicate customer needs, application trends, and market insights across the organization.
  • Promote effective collaboration and knowledge exchange with Sales, Product Management, R&D, and other Agile Units.
  • Lead recruitment, staffing, performance management, and career development of chapter members.

Preferred • Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Energy Systems, or equivalent.
  • Proven experience in Critical Power, UPS, Energy Storage, Power Conversion, or related applications.
  • Strong understanding of applications, solution architectures, market segments, channel dynamics, and emerging market trends.
  • Proven ability to translate customer requirements and application challenges into differentiated solutions and compelling value propositions aligned with Critical Power business strategy.
  • Experience supporting Sales organizations through technical consulting, customer engagement, and channel enablement.
  • Proven leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities.
  • Experience defining standards, methodologies, tools, and best practices within a technical organization.
  • Strong ability to operate and influence across complex stakeholder networks, including EPCs, consultants, end customers, channel partners, Sales, Product Management, and R&D.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with proven ability to engage customers, understand application challenges, and articulate value-driven solutions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Business Line Manager - Mining & Materials

__

As Global Sales Manager for Business Line Mining & Materials, you will lead the global sales function and serve as a member of the Business Line Management Team. You will be responsible for defining and executing the commercial strategy across all BL Mining & Materials businesses, driving profitable growth, strategic account development, market expansion and commercial excellence worldwide. Working closely with business unit leaders, cluster managers and country sales organizations, you will shape ABB’s commercial success in the mining, cement and battery materials industries.

This role reports to Bjorn Jonsson, Business Line Manager, Mining & Materials.

Role & • Responsibilities

In this role, you will have overall responsibility for the global sales organization of Business Line Mining & Materials, leading the commercial agenda across all regions and business units. You will develop and execute the global sales strategy, build and coach an international sales leadership team, and ensure alignment between business priorities, customer needs and growth opportunities. As a member of the BL Management Team, you will play a key role in shaping the strategic direction and long-term success of the business.

  • Leading the global BL Mining & Materials sales function and driving performance, capability development and engagement across the organization.

  • Driving the overall commercial strategy and achieving targets for orders, revenue, profitability, market share and customer satisfaction.

  • Building executive-level relationships with strategic customers, EPCs and industry partners while overseeing major commercial opportunities and negotiations.

  • Partnering with Business Unit Managers, Cluster Managers and Functional Leaders to maximize growth opportunities across the global portfolio.

About Business Line Mining & Materials

Business Line Mining & Materials is part of ABB Process Industries and serves customers in the Mining, Cement and Battery Materials industries. With approximately 2,000 employees across 28 countries, the business is a market leader in application-specific solutions and delivers integrated electrification, automation, digitalization and service offerings across the entire customer value chain. Our mission is to help customers outrun – safer, leaner and cleaner – through technology leadership and deep industry expertise

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Anticipating and identifying the shortfalls in performance and takes appropriate remedial actions, proactively.

  • Identifying and evaluating new opportunities with existing and potential customers, determines plans for implementation, and allocates required resources.

  • Planning and executing customer surveys and acts on the survey results to ensure high level of customer satisfaction.

  • Participating in the negotiation of key contracts.

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing or a related field.

  • Significant experience in global sales leadership, business development or commercial management within mining, process industries, automation, electrification or related sectors.

  • Demonstrated success in developing and executing growth strategies across international markets.

  • Strong leadership capabilities with experience leading global and culturally diverse teams.

  • Excellent commercial acumen including strategic account management, negotiations and business planning.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior customer and business leaders.

  • Fluent in English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

What’s in it for You?

  • Opportunity to shape the commercial strategy and future growth of a globally recognized business line.

  • Exposure to some of the world’s leading mining, cement and battery materials companies.

  • Ability to influence the sustainability transformation of heavy industry through electrification, automation and digitalization.

  • Global career opportunities within ABB.

  • A collaborative international environment focused on innovation, inclusion and continuous learning.

Location

We are committed to hiring the best people to our team and for this global position we are actively hiring in our key cluster locations (Australia, Brazil, Canada, India, South Africa, Sweden, Switzerland)

More About Us

At ABB, we are dedicated to helping industries become more productive, resource-efficient and sustainable. Business Line Mining & Materials combines global technology leadership in electrification, automation and digitalization with deep application knowledge to deliver integrated solutions from mine to market. As Global Sales Manager, you will lead one of the most strategic functions within the Business Line and play a key role in shaping its future growth and market success.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Role & • Responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la responsabilité globale de l'organisation mondiale des ventes de Business Line Mining & Materials, en dirigeant le programme commercial dans toutes les régions et unités commerciales. Vous développerez et exécuterez la stratégie commerciale mondiale, créerez et coacherez une équipe de direction commerciale internationale et assurerez l'alignement entre les priorités commerciales, les besoins des clients et les opportunités de croissance. À propos du secteur d'activité Mines et matériaux

Secteur d'activité L'exploitation minière et les matériaux font partie des industries de procédés ABB et servent les clients des industries de l'exploitation minière, du ciment et des matériaux de batterie. Avec environ 2 000 employés répartis dans 28 pays, l'entreprise est un leader du marché dans les solutions spécifiques aux applications et offre des offres intégrées d'électrification, d'automatisation, de numérisation et de service dans toute la chaîne de valeur client. Notre mission est d'aider les clients à dépasser – plus sûrs, plus maigres et plus propres – grâce au leadership technologique et à l'expertise profonde de l'industrie

  • Prévoir et identifier les lacunes en matière de rendement et prendre les mesures correctives appropriées, de façon proactive.

  • Participer à la négociation des principaux contrats.

  • Expérience importante en leadership des ventes à l'échelle mondiale, en développement des affaires ou en gestion commerciale au sein de l'industrie minière, de l'industrie des procédés, de l'automatisation, de l'électrification ou de secteurs connexes.

  • Mettre en évidence le succès de l'élaboration et de l'exécution de stratégies de croissance sur les marchés internationaux.

  • Mettre en valeur les capacités de leadership avec de l'expérience à la tête d'équipes mondiales et culturellement diversifiées.

  • Excellent acumen commercial, y compris la gestion stratégique des comptes, les négociations et la planification des affaires.

  • Possibilité d'influencer la transformation durable de l'industrie lourde par l'électrification, l'automatisation et la numérisation.

  • Occasions de carrière mondiales au sein de l'ABB.

  • Un environnement international collaboratif axé sur l'innovation, l'inclusion et l'apprentissage continu.

Nous sommes déterminés à recruter les meilleurs employés de notre équipe et, pour ce poste mondial, nous embauchons activement dans nos principaux centres de regroupement (Australie, Brésil, Canada, Inde, Afrique du Sud, Suède, Suisse)

Plus À propos de nous

Chez ABB, nous nous engageons à aider les industries à devenir plus productives, plus économes en ressources et plus durables. Business Line Mining & Materials combine le leadership technologique mondial dans l'électrification, l'automatisation et la numérisation avec une connaissance approfondie de l'application pour fournir des solutions intégrées de la mine au marché. En tant que directeur des ventes à l'échelle mondiale, vous dirigerez l'une des fonctions les plus stratégiques du secteur d'activité et jouerez un rôle clé pour façonner sa croissance future et sa réussite sur le marché.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

  • Steering front-end sales activities across direct and indirect channels and ensuring consistent sales execution.

You will join a collaborative, performance-oriented and internationally connected team, where strategic thinking, ownership, and teamwork are key to success.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Strategy Manager

__

Do you enjoy translating data into useful insights that support strategic decision-making? Join our team as an Electrification Business & Market Intelligence Analyst, where you’ll analyze market trends, provide competitor insights, and uncover growth opportunities around the world. You’ll collaborate with the global leadership team to shape strategic initiatives and ensure market transparency.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid or #LI-remote

This role is contributing to Electrification Business Area Strategy, Business & Market Research team

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Market intelligence processes: Improve existing and define new scalable processes for collecting, validating, and synthesizing market insights from a global sales organization, incl. encouraging adoption and developing reporting frameworks and dashboards for senior leadership

  • Market & Competitor Intelligence: Track and evaluate global market trends, uncovering gaps and opportunities for growth. Deliver compelling analyses to guide management decisions and fuel business growth.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to ensure the high-quality delivery and integration of business intelligence into decision-making processes

  • Data-Driven Strategy: Collect and analyze market, competitor, and financial data to provide high-quality insights that support key business decisions and strategic planning.

  • Innovation in Tools & Analytics: System administration of Business Intelligence Tools in Electrification, developing and enhancing business intelligence tools, such as Power BI, and support marketing teams globally by ensuring optimal use of sales tracking systems and data quality.

  • Continuous Improvement: Propose and apply enhancements to business analysis tools so the organization can collect, interpret, and use intelligence more effectively

• Qualifications for the role:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in market intelligence, business insights, or related functions.

  • Demonstrated experience building intelligence and designing processes that scale across large organizations and working effectively in multinational organizations with geographically dispersed teams.

  • Demonstrated skill in stakeholder management, including work alongside commercial leaders across regions and business units

  • Solid analytical capabilities, including experience with data analysis, visualization, and insight generation, with a talent for identifying trends and making strategic recommendations

  • Clear, concise communication and engaging storytelling capabilities

  • Ability to combine strategic thinking with practical execution

  • Proficiency in business intelligence tools like MS Office Suite, Anaplan, Power BI, ThinkCell and other market research platforms

  • A results-focused attitude with a commitment to continuous improvement.

  • Experience with market intelligence, analytics, or business intelligence tools.

  • Knowledge of AI-enabled research, text analytics, or insight-generation tools is a strong plus.

  • For Switzerland location: candidates must bel eligible to work in Switzerland. Visa sponsorship is not offered for this position.

Why You’ll Enjoy Working Here

  • You will join a collaborative team, where you will be able to thrive.

  • Strategic Work: Your insights will directly influence strategic decisions and contribute to the growth of the business on a global scale

  • Innovative Environment: Work with up-to-date tools and technologies to support meaningful business improvements

  • Global Collaboration: Collaborate with teams from across the globe, ensuring diverse perspectives and a global mindset in everything you do.

  • Professional Growth: Be part of a forward-thinking team that encourages continuous learning and development, with opportunities to grow within the organization.

Take the next step by joining our team and helping advance our business with innovative market intelligence and strategic insights.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui fonctionne dans le monde.

Cette position se rapporte à:

Strategy Manager

Aimez-vous traduire les données en informations utiles qui appuient la prise de décisions stratégiques? Rejoignez notre équipe en tant qu'analyste de l'intelligence d'entreprise et de marché pour l'électrification, où vous analyserez les tendances du marché, fournirez des idées aux concurrents et découvrirez des opportunités de croissance dans le monde entier. Vous collaborerez avec l'équipe de direction mondiale pour façonner les initiatives stratégiques et assurer la transparence du marché.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-hybrid ou #LI-remote

Ce rôle contribue à l'équipe de la Stratégie du secteur d'activité de l'électrification, de la Recherche sur les affaires et les marchés

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Processus de renseignements commerciaux: Améliorer et définir de nouveaux processus évolutifs pour recueillir, valider et synthétiser les points de vue commerciaux d'une organisation de vente mondiale, y compris encourager l'adoption et l'élaboration de cadres de rapport et de tableaux de bord pour les cadres supérieurs

  • Renseignements sur les marchés et les concurrents: Suivre et évaluer les tendances du marché mondial, en découvrant les lacunes et les possibilités de croissance. Fournir des analyses convaincantes pour guider les décisions de gestion et stimuler la croissance des entreprises.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants internes et les fournisseurs externes afin d'assurer la prestation et l'intégration de haute qualité de l'information opérationnelle dans les processus décisionnels

  • Stratégie axée sur les données: Recueillir et analyser des données sur les marchés, les concurrents et les finances pour fournir des renseignements de haute qualité qui appuient les décisions clés des entreprises et la planification stratégique.

  • Innovation dans les outils et l'analyse: Administration du système d'outils d'information commerciale en matière d'électrification, élaboration et amélioration d'outils d'information commerciale, comme Power BI, et soutien des équipes de marketing à l'échelle mondiale en assurant une utilisation optimale des systèmes de suivi des ventes et de la qualité des données.

  • Amélioration continue: Proposer et appliquer des améliorations aux outils d'analyse opérationnelle afin que l'organisation puisse recueillir, interpréter et utiliser plus efficacement le renseignement

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • 5–7+ ans d'expérience dans le domaine de l'intelligence du marché, des connaissances commerciales ou des fonctions connexes.

  • Expérience démontrée en matière de renforcement du renseignement et de conception de processus à l'échelle des grandes organisations et en travaillant efficacement dans des organisations multinationales avec des équipes géographiquement dispersées.

  • Savoir-faire démontré en gestion des intervenants, y compris travailler aux côtés des dirigeants commerciaux des régions et des unités opérationnelles

  • Capacités analytiques solides, y compris l'expérience de l'analyse des données, de la visualisation et de la production de renseignements, avec un talent pour identifier les tendances et faire des recommandations stratégiques

  • Capacité de combiner la pensée stratégique et l'exécution pratique

  • Connaissance des outils d'information commerciale comme MS Office Suite, Anaplan, Power BI, ThinkCell et d'autres plateformes d'études de marché

  • Une attitude axée sur les résultats et un engagement à l'amélioration continue.

  • Expérience avec des outils d'information commerciale, d'analyse ou d'information commerciale.

  • La connaissance d'outils de recherche, d'analyse de texte ou de génération de perspicacité est un atout.

  • Pour l'emplacement de la Suisse: les candidats doivent être admissibles à travailler en Suisse. Le parrainage de visa n'est pas offert pour ce poste. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe de collaboration, où vous pourrez prospérer.

  • Travaux stratégiques : Vos idées influeront directement sur les décisions stratégiques et contribueront à la croissance de l'entreprise à l'échelle mondiale

  • Environnement innovateur: Travailler avec des outils et des technologies à jour pour appuyer des améliorations commerciales significatives

  • Collaboration mondiale : Collaborer avec des équipes de partout dans le monde, en assurant la diversité des perspectives et un état d'esprit mondial dans tout ce que vous faites.

  • Croissance professionnelle: Faire partie d'une équipe d'avant-garde qui encourage l'apprentissage et le perfectionnement continus, avec des possibilités de croissance au sein de l'organisation.

Prenez l'étape suivante en vous joignant à notre équipe et en aidant à faire progresser notre entreprise grâce à des renseignements innovateurs sur les marchés et à des idées stratégiques.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons les gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Support Manager

__

To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a dedicated, experienced Project Engineer. In this role, you take responsibility as a technical authority for electrical engineering projects with low to medium complexity – particularly for medium-voltage, low-voltage and standby power systems in the service business (retrofit). You implement the requirements of concepts within the specified time and budget framework and ensure that all specifications, quality standards, safety requirements and standards are consistently met.


Work Model: #hybrid
Business Line: Service (Division Electrification)

Your responsibilities

  • Product configuration, creation of electrical schematics using EPLAN and preparation of simple mechanical drawings using AutoCAD

  • Creation of selectivity calculations

  • Execution of type testing (design verifications) for non-standard configurations based on checklists and applicable standards

  • Technical support during tests and commissioning and support of project management in technical reviews, customer meetings and implementation of change and variation requests

  • Development of effort estimates and feasibility recommendations for the quotation team

  • Preparation of system documentation, as-built documents and acceptance records

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an electrician or automation technician plus further training as a technician HF/FH or comparable qualification

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in project engineering, ideally in energy technology. Experience in mechanical engineering is an advantage.

  • Very good CAD skills in EPLAN Electric P8; AutoCAD skills are an advantage

  • Technical understanding of the engineering of power supply systems (MV/LV/emergency supply power), ideally with experience with low-voltage switchgear

  • Strong focus on safe working practices and commitment to compliance with all relevant safety guidelines

  • Very high self-motivation as well as independent, solution-oriented and responsible working methods

  • Team player with a cooperative approach and good communication skills; you are fluent in German and English – French language skills are an advantage

What We Offer

  • Attractive and performance-based compensation

  • Flexible working models (hybrid)

  • Comprehensive further training and development opportunities

  • Modern working environment and international collaboration

  • Occupational social benefits and employee discounts

ABB is a leading technology company that stands for a sustainable and high-performing future. Our solutions are active in the areas of electrification, automation and digitalization and help transform the way we live and work. Visit www.abb.com for more information about our solutions worldwide.

This position reports to:

Workshop Teamleader and Service Coordinator

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will have the opportunity to coordinate service work done at site and ensure it complies with ABB's and customer’s guidelines. Each day, you will act as a single point of contact for the customer during the execution of a service job. You will also showcase your expertise by leading and delivering responsive support coordination to exceed customer expectations/experience.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification Service in Zuzwil (St. Gallen) or Baden (Aargau).

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Plan, schedule, and coordinate service technicians across Switzerland, taking into account availability, qualifications, location, and service priority.

  • Organize and manage service orders, including preventive maintenance, repairs, and installations in the medium- and low-voltage sector.

  • Closely collaborate with internal customers (e.g., project managers) and the service team to ensure the efficient planning and execution of daily service activities.

  • Act as a central point of coordination, continuously monitoring resource allocation and responding flexibly to changing requirements, with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and business success.

Your • Qualifications

  • Completed technical or commercial vocational education/training.

  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in service planning, for example as a Service Dispatcher, Service Coordinator, or in a similar role.

  • Solid knowledge and hands-on experience in the maintenance, service, commissioning, and repair of electrical systems and equipment.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, combined with the ability to perform effectively under pressure.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and ERP systems; experience with Salesforce is an advantage.

  • Fluent in German, both written and spoken; good command of English and French is considered a plus.


More about us

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extracting the maximum value from them, and then recovering and regenerating products and materials at the end of their useful life.

This recruiting process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen, ABB Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Department Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a research scientist in Software Systems Engineering, you will be working on the future architecture and design of ABB’s software-based products, with a special focus on the digitalization of industrial systems. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative international work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to and/or lead research projects that turn state-of-the-art research results into effective software solutions for ABB.
  • Create prototypes of innovative concepts with real business impact
  • Evaluate new technologies and assess their impact on ABB products and roadmaps.
  • Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports.
  • Build a network in the company and actively disseminate your knowledge and expertise.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or in a related field

  • Experience in software engineering and system design
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in one or multiple of the following topics: software engineering, distributed systems, computer networking, embedded systems, machine learning, cyber security
  • Hands-on experience in programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, Rust)
  • Proven publication track record at top scientific conferences and journals
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude
  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:
  • Flexible Work Practices
  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan
  • Canteen

More about us


At the ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on cutting-edge technologies that shape the future of our products. The Industrial Software Systems research team explores topics like machine learning, cybersecurity, computer networking, distributed systems, and real-time systems. Our solutions are used to support the development of next-generation digital products and services of ABB.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

What's in it for you:

We empower you to take initiative, explore new possibilities, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Technical Consulting Manager II

__

Your role and responsibilities

We are seeking a Power System Engineer to join our team supporting customers in the design and implementation of advanced direct current (DC) architectures for data centers and industrial applications. This role focuses on DC distribution equipment, power electronics, and protection systems. You will work closely with customers and collaborate with R&D teams responsible for developing power electronics solutions and DC equipment to co-develop innovative, reliable, and efficient power solutions.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

Location: Global - Germany, Italy, Switzerland and/or USA

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Design DC power distribution systems incorporating DC distribution equipment such as switchgear, circuit breakers, busbars, energy storage and other power electronics devices.
  • Co-develop solutions with customers to ensure alignment with market needs.
  • Perform electrical system simulations and validate architectures through practical evaluation.
  • Conduct system studies (load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination) using simulation tools.
  • Develop and evaluate protection schemes (short-circuit analysis, coordination, etc.).
  • Collaborate with R&D teams responsible for developing power electronics solutions and DC equipment
  • Frequently review and understand relevant standards, including those still under development, to ensure compliance and future readiness.

• Qualifications for the role

  • 5+ years in power system design, preferably DC systems
  • Strong knowledge of DC protection principles and emerging standards (IEC, IEEE)
  • Electrical system design/engineering expertise in DC distribution
  • Master’s in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Electrical system simulation expertise (MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, ETAP)
  • Good knowledge of power electronics, including topologies, basics of semiconductor switching and converter protection
  • Ability to lead technical discussions with customers and internal teams to align on requirements and solutions.
  • Ability to design and evaluate DC protection schemes (short-circuit analysis, coordination)
  • Strong understanding of industry standards, relevant organizations and ability to track evolving regulations.

More about us

Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among
others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Technical Consulting Manager II

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

>Wir suchen einen Power System Engineer, der unsere Kunden bei der Gestaltung und Implementierung von fortschrittlichen Gleichstromarchitekturen für Rechenzentren und industrielle Anwendungen unterstützt. Diese Rolle konzentriert sich auf DC-Verteilungsgeräte, Leistungselektronik und Schutzsysteme. Sie arbeiten eng mit Kunden zusammen und arbeiten mit F&E-Teams zusammen, die für die Entwicklung von Leistungselektroniklösungen und Gleichstromgeräten verantwortlich sind, um innovative, zuverlässige und effiziente Energielösungen zu entwickeln.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist hybrid.

Standort: Global - Deutschland, Italien, Schweiz und/oder USA

Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für

  • DC-Stromverteilungssysteme entwerfen, die Gleichstromverteilungsgeräte wie Schaltanlagen, Leistungsschalter, Stromschienen, Energiespeicher und andere Leistungselektronikgeräte enthalten.
  • Co-Entwicklungslösungen mit Kunden, um die Ausrichtung auf die Marktanforderungen sicherzustellen.
  • Durchführen von Simulationen elektrischer Systeme und Validierung von Architekturen durch praktische Auswertung.
  • Leitungsstudien (Lastfluss, Kurzschluss, Schutzkoordination) mit Simulationswerkzeugen.
  • Schutzschemata entwickeln und bewerten (Kurzschlussanalyse, Koordination usw.).
  • Zusammenarbeit mit F&E-Teams, die für die Entwicklung von Leistungselektroniklösungen und DC-Geräten verantwortlich sind
  • Überprüfen und verstehen Sie häufig relevante Standards, einschließlich derer, die sich noch in der Entwicklung befinden, um die Einhaltung und zukünftige Bereitschaft zu gewährleisten.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • 5+ Jahre im Stromsystemdesign, vorzugsweise DC-Systeme
  • Starke Kenntnisse der DC-Schutzprinzipien und neu entstehenden Standards (IEC, IEEE)
  • Elektronisches Systemdesign/Engineering-Know-how in der DC-Verteilung
  • Master in Elektrotechnik oder verwandten Bereichen
  • Kompetenz in der Simulation elektrischer Systeme (MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, ETAP)
  • Gute Kenntnisse der Leistungselektronik, einschließlich Topologien, Grundlagen der Halbleiterschaltung und des Wandlerschutzes
  • Fähigkeit, technische Gespräche mit Kunden und internen Teams zu führen, um sich auf Anforderungen und Lösungen auszurichten.
  • Fähigkeit, DC-Schutzsysteme zu entwerfen und zu bewerten (Kurzschlussanalyse, Koordination)
  • Starkes Verständnis von Industriestandards, relevanten Organisationen und Fähigkeit, sich entwickelnde Vorschriften zu verfolgen.

Mehr über uns

Elektrifizierung bietet führende Technologien für die elektrische Verteilung und Verwaltung, Lösungen und Dienstleistungen, um die Welt auf sichere, intelligente und nachhaltige Weise zu elektrifizieren. Das Portfolio umfasst elektrische Mittel- und Niederspannungskomponenten, Schaltanlagen, digitale Geräte, Gehäuse und Leistungsschalter, unter anderem
andere. Mit unseren Produkten, Lösungen und Dienstleistungen arbeiten wir mit Kunden zusammen, um die Energieversorgung und -sicherheit zu verbessern, das Energiemanagement, die Effizienz und die Betriebszuverlässigkeit zu verbessern, während wir eine kohlenstoffarme Gesellschaft anstreben. go.abb/electrification

Diese Möglichkeit steht Kandidaten in mehreren Ländern offen, wobei der endgültige Arbeitsstandort auf der Grundlage des ausgewählten Kandidaten festgelegt wird. Da die Vergütung je nach Standort variieren kann, verpflichten wir uns, während des gesamten Einstellungsprozesses transparent zu sein, und teilen Details der Gehaltsspanne, des variablen Vergütungs- und Leistungspakets mit Kandidaten, die in die erste Interviewphase für einen Standort in der Europäischen Union gelangen, der von der EU-Richtlinie über die Entgelttransparenz abgedeckt wird. Das endgültige Angebot wird auf der Grundlage Ihres Standorts, Ihrer Erfahrung, Ihrer Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen, Ihrer Positionierung auf dem Binnenmarkt und Ihrer Ausrichtung auf die internen Standards von ABB zugeschnitten.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Nous cherchons un ingénieur du système d'alimentation pour rejoindre notre équipe qui soutient les clients dans la conception et la mise en oeuvre d'architectures avancées à courant direct (DC) pour les centres de données et les applications industrielles. Ce rôle est axé sur l'équipement de distribution de courant continu, l'électronique de puissance et les systèmes de protection. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les clients et collaborerez avec les équipes de R-D responsables du développement de solutions électroniques de puissance et d'équipement DC pour co-développer des solutions de puissance innovantes, fiables et efficaces.

Lieu: Global - Allemagne, Italie, Suisse et/ou États-Unis

Vous serez principalement responsable de

  • Concevoir des systèmes de distribution d'électricité à courant continu comprenant du matériel de distribution à courant continu, comme des appareils de commutation, des disjoncteurs, des barres d'autobus, des dispositifs de stockage de l'énergie et d'autres appareils électroniques.
    • Concevoir des solutions avec les clients afin d'assurer l'alignement sur les besoins du marché.Performer des simulations de systèmes électriques et valider les architectures au moyen d'une évaluation pratique.
  • Conduire des études de systèmes (flux de charge, court-circuit, coordination de la protection) à l'aide d'outils de simulation.
  • Développer et évaluer des systèmes de protection (analyse de court-circuit, coordination, etc.).
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de R-D responsables du développement des solutions d'électronique de puissance et de l'équipement DC
  • Examiner et comprendre fréquemment les normes pertinentes, y compris celles qui sont encore en cours d'élaboration, afin d'assurer la conformité et la préparation future.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • 5+ ans dans la conception du système d'alimentation, de préférence les systèmes à courant continu
  • Forte connaissance des principes de protection de DC et des nouvelles normes (IEC, IEEE)
  • Expertise en conception et en ingénierie de systèmes électriques dans la distribution de DC
  • Maîtrise en génie électrique ou dans un domaine connexe
  • Expertise en simulation de systèmes électriques (MATLAB/Simulink, CFPAD, ETAP)
  • Bonne connaissance de l'électronique de puissance, y compris les topologies, les bases du changement de semi-conducteur et la protection des convertisseurs
  • Capacité de diriger les discussions techniques avec les clients et les équipes internes afin de s'aligner sur les exigences et les solutions.
  • Capacité de concevoir et d'évaluer des systèmes de protection contre les accidents du travail (analyse en court-circuit, coordination)
  • Mieux comprendre les normes de l'industrie, les organisations pertinentes et la capacité de suivre l'évolution de la réglementation.

Plus sur nous

L'électrification offre des technologies, des solutions et des services de distribution et de gestion d'électricité de premier plan pour électrifier le monde de façon sûre, intelligente et durable. La gamme comprend des composants électriques de moyenne et basse tension, des appareils de commutation, des appareils numériques, des boîtiers et des disjoncteurs, entre autres. Avec nos produits, solutions et services, nous collaborons avec nos clients pour améliorer la fourniture d'électricité et la sécurité, améliorer la gestion de l'énergie, l'efficacité et la fiabilité opérationnelle, alors que nous cherchons à atteindre une société à faible teneur en carbone. go.abb/electrification

Business Line MV Drives Service Operations Manager

You will be responsible for delivering high-quality, cost-effective, and timely engineering solutions while ensuring efficient resource planning, team development, and achievement of contractual and financial targets. descriptionByLocale.it:
At ABB , aiutiamo le industrie a funzionare più snella e più pulita—e ogni persona qui lo fa accadere. Sarete autorizzati a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire il mondo. Siamo alla ricerca di un entusiasta e esperto R&D Senior Engineer con particolare attenzione alla qualità e affidabilità per far parte dell'espansione del nostro business con una nuova tecnologia di trasformatore di stato solido per applicazioni datacenter. In questo ruolo, avrete l'opportunità di far parte del centro ELDS R&D Power Electronics di team di eccellenza per Solid State Transformer responsabile della progettazione e dello sviluppo della futura famiglia di prodotti Solid State Transformer con il primo focus sui requisiti applicativi del Data Center. In questo contesto, e come parte del team di sviluppo R&D SST, il Power Electronics Quality and Reliability Senior R&D Engineer si concentrerà particolarmente sull'esecuzione di analisi teoriche e sperimentali di affidabilità a componenti, sotto-assemblaggi e a livello di sistema, oltre a collegare i risultati ai piani di garanzia della qualità con particolare enfasi agli elementi critici identificati e ai parametri critici di qualità dalla fase di progettazione alla ramp-up della produzione e della gestione del ciclo di vita SST. La posizione di questa posizione è Baden-Daettwil in Svizzera, con possibilità di trasferimento future verso altre località di produzione. Le principali responsabilità includono il team SST per il Data Center R&D, che conduce le analisi di affidabilità e la valutazione per i componenti di elettronica di potenza (ad esempio semiconduttori, controllo HW, condensatori, ventilatori, ecc), assiemi e sottosistemi che utilizzano metodi e strumenti statistici per la predizione e la modellazione dell'affidabilità (MTFB/ FIT). Questo viene eseguito in stretta collaborazione con il team R&D, compresi i rischi di identificazione e la definizione delle corrispondenti azioni di mitigazione e linee guida di progettazione dell'affidabilità attraverso strumenti come le modalità di errore e l'analisi dell'effetto, l'analisi dell'albero di default, la fisica delle metodologie di fallimento, l'analisi elettrica, meccanica e termica, la revisione e la valutazione dei dati di prova e il riferimento ai relativi standard del settore. Condurre i piani di affidabilità e i requisiti di qualità, inclusi i piani di prova di affidabilità e qualità interni e fornitori, nonché sostenere le azioni di garanzia della qualità interna che coinvolgono i team di gestione della supply chain interna, produzione e funzionamento. Questo include l'identificazione di modelli e tendenze relative all'affidabilità, alla qualità e alle prestazioni dai dati di test e produzione di affidabilità interni ed esterni, nonché l'analisi dei casi e azioni correttive e preventive per le questioni identificate durante le fasi di R&D Validazione e Qualifica, Produzione e Field Operation. Fornire un supporto e una collaborazione ravvicinati con i team di productization e operations per i piani di garanzia della qualità del prodotto SST di sviluppo e manutenzione per la produzione di massa e il monitoraggio delle prestazioni della flotta. Questo include controlli interni ed esterni, attività di test di routine e screening, monitoraggio del processo statistico, gestione della documentazione e definizione KPI di qualità, monitoraggio e reporting per garantire la conformità del prodotto e il miglioramento continuo durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Sarete parte delle attività di R&D e di produzione avanzate nel campo dell'elettronica di potenza per l'ABB SST for Datacenter Products, in stretta collaborazione con un team senior altamente qualificato di ingegneri e stakeholder R&D in una configurazione globale e multiculturale. • Qualificazioni per il ruolo

L'esperienza nel campo dei convertitori di tensione media e di alta potenza è un plus. Interessi nella ricerca applicata e nello sviluppo di prodotti, persone auto-organizzate, motivate, che amano lavorare in un team di ricerca e sviluppo altamente qualificato composto da esperti in diversi ambiti e sedi globali. descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

SST Product Architect

__

Your role and responsibilities

We are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced R&D Senior Engineer with focus on Quality and Reliability to be part of the expansion of our business with a novel solid state transformer technology for datacenter applications. In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of the ELDS R&D Power Electronics center of excellence team for Solid State Transformer in charge of the design and development of the future Solid State Transformer products family with first focus on Data Center application requirements. In this context, and as part of the R&D SST development team, the Power Electronics Quality and Reliability Senior R&D Engineer will have special focus on performing theoretical and experimental reliability analysis at components, sub-assemblies and at a system level, as well as linking the findings to the Quality assurance plans with special emphasis to the identified critical elements and their critical to quality parameters from the design phase to the ramp-up of the production and the life cycle management of the SST products. The location for this position is Baden-Daettwil in Switzerland, with future relocation possibilities to other production locations.

The main responsibilities include

  • Member of the SST for Data Center R&D team, leading the reliability analyses and assessment for Power Electronics Components (e.g. semiconductors, control HW, capacitors, fans, etc.), assemblies, and subsystems utilizing statistical methods and tools for reliability prediction and modelling (MTFB/ FIT). This is to be performed in close collaboration with the R&D team, including the identification risks and defining the corresponding mitigation actions and reliability design guidelines through tools such as Failure Modes and Effect Analysis, Fault Tree Analysis, Physics of Failure methodologies, electrical, mechanical and thermal stress analysis, test data review and assessment and reference to relevant industry standards.

  • Lead the reliability plans and quality requirements including internal and suppliers’ reliability and quality testing plans as well as supporting the internal quality assurance actions involving the internal supply chain management, production and operation teams. This includes the identification of patterns and trends related to reliability, quality and performance from internal and external reliability testing and production data as well as root case analysis and corrective and preventive actions for issues identified during the R&D Validation and Qualification phases, Production and Field Operation.

  • Provide close support and collaboration with the productization and operations teams for the SST product quality assurance plans development and maintenance for mass production and fleet performance tracking. This includes internal and external audits, routine and screening testing activities, Statistical Process Control monitoring, documentation management and quality KPIs definition, monitoring and reporting to ensure product conformity and continuous improvement throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Actively contribution to the maintenance and further development of the key Power Electronics Technologies Expertise and Know-How of the SST for Datacenters R&D team with focus on robust design for reliability and quality assurance.

You will be part of advanced R&D and productization activities in the field of power electronics for the ABB SST for Datacenter Products, in close cooperation with a highly qualified senior team of R&D engineers and stakeholders in a global and multicultural setup.

• Qualifications for the role

  • University Master’s degree / PhD in the field of engineering (electrical, mechatronics, etc.), or Equivalent Experience in the field of reliability and quality engineering with focus on Power Electronics products. Experience in the field of Medium Voltage and High Power converters is a plus.

  • Solid background know-how and expertise in Reliability analysis, testing and assessment, with direct impact to product design, production quality plans and mitigation actions identification applying state of the art reliability and quality tools and methods.

  • Experience and high interest in theoretical and practical reliability and quality assurance activities related to Power Electronics products development and lifecycle management for mass production, including interaction and communication with different stakeholders.

  • Interest in applied research and product development, self-organized, motivated person, that likes to work in a highly qualified research and development team composed of experts in different domains and global locations.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English. German is a plus.

  • Availability to travel sporadically.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid.

The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users.

With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated).

The recruiting process is being led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
