Cette position se rapporte à:

SST Product Architect

Votre rôle et responsabilités

Nous recherchons un ingénieur principal en R-D enthousiaste et expérimenté qui mettra l'accent sur la qualité et la fiabilité pour faire partie de l'expansion de notre entreprise avec une nouvelle technologie de transformateur d'état solide pour les applications de datacenter. Dans ce contexte, et dans le cadre de l'équipe de développement de la SST en R-D, l'ingénieur principal en R-D en qualité et fiabilité de l'électronique de puissance mettra tout particulièrement l'accent sur l'analyse théorique et expérimentale de la fiabilité des composants, des sous-ensembles et des systèmes, ainsi que sur l'établissement d'un lien entre les résultats et les plans d'assurance de la qualité, en mettant particulièrement l'accent sur les éléments critiques identifiés et leurs paramètres critiques pour la qualité, de la phase de conception à la montée en puissance de la production et la gestion du cycle de vie des produits de la SST. L'emplacement de ce poste est Baden-Daettwil en Suisse, avec de futures possibilités de relocalisation vers d'autres sites de production.

Les principales responsabilités comprennent

  • Membre de l'équipe de R-D du Centre de données, qui dirige les analyses et l'évaluation de la fiabilité des composants de Power Electronics (p. ex. semi-conducteurs, contrôle HW, condensateurs, ventilateurs, etc.), des assemblages et des sous-systèmes utilisant des méthodes et des outils statistiques pour la prédiction et la modélisation de la fiabilité (MTFB/FIT). Cela doit être effectué en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de R-D, y compris l'identification des risques et la définition des mesures d'atténuation correspondantes et des lignes directrices sur la conception de la fiabilité au moyen d'outils comme l'analyse des modes et des effets de défaillance, l'analyse des arbres de défaillance, les méthodologies de physique de défaillance, l'analyse des contraintes électriques, mécaniques et thermiques, l'examen et l'évaluation des données d'essai et la référence aux normes pertinentes de l'industrie.

  • Diriger les plans de fiabilité et les exigences de qualité, y compris les plans internes et les plans d'essais de fiabilité et de qualité des fournisseurs, ainsi que soutenir les actions internes d'assurance de la qualité impliquant les équipes internes de gestion, de production et d'exploitation de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Cela comprend l'identification des modèles et des tendances liés à la fiabilité, à la qualité et au rendement à partir des données internes et externes sur la fiabilité et la production, ainsi que l'analyse des cas de base et les mesures correctives et préventives pour les questions identifiées au cours des phases de validation et de qualification de la R-D, de la production et de l'exploitation sur le terrain.

  • Fournir un soutien et une collaboration étroits avec les équipes de production et d'exploitation pour l'élaboration et la maintenance de plans d'assurance de la qualité des produits SST pour la production de masse et le suivi des performances de la flotte. Cela comprend les vérifications internes et externes, les activités d'essai de routine et de dépistage, la surveillance du contrôle des processus statistiques, la gestion de la documentation et la définition des ICR de qualité, la surveillance et l'établissement de rapports afin d'assurer la conformité des produits et l'amélioration continue tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.

  • Contribution active à la maintenance et au développement de l'expertise et du savoir-faire clés en matière de technologies de l'électronique de puissance pour l'équipe de R-D des centres de données, en mettant l'accent sur une conception robuste pour assurer la fiabilité et la qualité.

Vous participerez à des activités de R-D et de production de pointe dans le domaine de l'électronique de puissance pour les produits ABB SST for Datacenter, en étroite collaboration avec une équipe supérieure hautement qualifiée d'ingénieurs et d'intervenants en R-D dans une installation mondiale et multiculturelle.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Maîtrise universitaire / doctorat en génie (électrique, mécatronique, etc.), ou expérience équivalente dans le domaine de la fiabilité et de l'ingénierie de la qualité en mettant l'accent sur les produits Power Electronics. L'expérience acquise dans le domaine des convertisseurs à moyenne tension et à haute puissance est un atout.

  • Savoir-faire et savoir-faire solides en matière d'analyse, d'essai et d'évaluation de la fiabilité, avec une incidence directe sur la conception du produit, les plans de qualité de la production et les mesures d'atténuation, en appliquant les outils et les méthodes de fiabilité et de qualité les plus récents.

  • Expérience et grand intérêt pour les activités théoriques et pratiques de fiabilité et d'assurance de la qualité liées au développement de produits Power Electronics et à la gestion du cycle de vie pour la production de masse, y compris l'interaction et la communication avec les différents intervenants.

  • Intérêt pour la recherche appliquée et le développement de produits, personne auto-organisée et motivée, qui aime travailler dans une équipe de recherche et de développement hautement qualifiée composée d'experts dans différents domaines et à l'échelle mondiale.

  • L'allemand est un plus.

  • Disponibilité de voyager sporadiquement.

Plus sur nous

La Division des solutions de distribution d'ABB facilite la distribution, la protection et le contrôle efficaces et fiables de l'énergie en améliorant la qualité de l'électricité tout en renforçant la résilience du réseau.

La Division offre des produits et des solutions spécifiques à certains segments qui servent en grande partie les secteurs des services publics, de l'industrie et de l'infrastructure, fournissant souvent le lien nécessaire entre les systèmes de transmission à haute tension et les utilisateurs à faible tension.

Avec les solutions connectées ABB CapabilityTM à son cœur, l'offre comprend les commutateurs à moyenne tension à air et à gaz (1 à 66 kilovolts), les disjoncteurs intérieurs et extérieurs, les refermeurs, les fusibles, les contacteurs, les relais, les transformateurs d'instruments, les capteurs, les centres de commande moteur, ainsi que les commutateurs à basse tension.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to operate process equipment or machinery to convert raw materials or semi-finished parts into components or finished parts for a final product at the right time and with the required quality. Each day, you will execute the assigned tasks according to agreed workflows and in accordance with ABB standard processes and safety guidelines and reports any non-compliance. You will also showcase your skills by operating machines in accordance with the operating manual, work schedule, and/or production order instructions.

The work model for the role is: onsite

This role is contributing to the overall performance of ABB PMA Uster

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Performing routine machinery set-up, adjustments, and repairing and fitting simple replacement parts.
  • Ensuring regular standard maintenance of the equipment, tools set-up, programming activities, and troubleshooting and reporting issues, if any; and maintaining detailed records of machinery set-ups, repairs, and maintenance activities.
  • Keeping track of approved, defective units, and final products.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Experience in working with injection molding machines of minimum 2 years
  • Experience in packaging and assembly semi finished parts
  • Good communications skills in German
  • Wilingness to work in shift pattern

More about us

ABB Installation Products Division (formerly Thomas&Betts), helps manage the connection, protection and distribution of electrical power from source to socket. The Division’s products are engineered to provide ease of installation and perform in demanding and harsh conditions, helping to ensure safety and continuous operation for utilities, businesses and people around the world. The Commercial Essentials product segment includes electrical junction boxes, commercial fittings, strut and cable tray metal framing systems for commercial and residential construction. The Premier Industrial product segment includes multiple product lines, such as Ty-Rap® cable ties, T&B Liquidtight Systems® protection products, PVC coated and nylon conduit systems, power connection and grounding systems, and cable protection systems of conduits and fittings for harsh and industrial applications. The Division also manufactures solutions for medium-voltage applications used in the utility market under its marquee brands including Elastimold™ reclosers and switchgear, capacitor switches, current limiting fuses, Homac™ distribution connectors, Hi-Tech Valiant™ full-range current limiting fuse for fire mitigation, faulted current indicators and distribution connectors, cable accessories and apparatus with products for overhead and underground distribution. Manufacturing includes made-to-stock and custom-made solutions.

The recruiting process is led by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Global R&D Controller

This position reports to:

Team Lead Production Scheduling

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will have the opportunity to generate a detailed production schedule based on the production plan to maximize the use of resources and meet established production specifications and schedules. Each day, you will feed information on production capacity issues and material availability. You will also showcase your expertise by releasing manufacturing work orders.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Production Planning team within Motion High Power Solutions (MOHP) in Untersiggenthal, Switzerland. Main stakeholders are production, procurement, project management, engineering.

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Creating and maintaining a detailed production schedule from the production plan.
  • Executing daily, plant-level Materials Requirement Planning (MRP) to create and manage production requirements to meet the production delivery schedules.
  • Establishing sequence and lead time of each operation to meet shipment dates per the master schedule plan.
  • Monitoring schedule adherence, identifying key root causes for deviation, and taking follow-up improvement action.

Our team dynamics
You will join a collaborative, experienced and supportive team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role
  • You have 3+ years of experience in production planning or scheduling in a manufacturing environment, ideally in an engineer-to-order (ETO) setting.
  • You are highly adept in SAP (PP/MM modules); experience with wayRTS/Planisware is a strong plus.
  • You enjoy working with structured production planning methodologies and have a solid understanding of MRP processes and capacity management.
  • You are passionate about structured problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Completed education at Höhere Fachschule (HF) level (e.g. Techniker:in HF) or equivalent, ideally in a technical or supply chain related field; a Bachelor's degree is a plus.
  • You are at ease communicating in German (fluent) and English (working proficiency).

Benefits

  • Continuous learning and development opportunities
  • On-site gym and fitness programs to support your well-being and work-life balance

More about us
ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. Quality Manager

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will support the implementation of the local quality strategy, driving a strong quality culture, continuous improvement, and sustainable problem-solving.   • Strong problem-solving skills using root cause analysis methods (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa)

  • Knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and material/component specifications

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Lead


At Sevensense we push the frontiers of mobile robotics. Our mission is to build the eyes and brain for the robots of the future! Equipped with our technology, mobile machines can autonomously navigate in dynamic and crowded environments. Thus, we enable new robotic applications in places such as airports, supermarkets, warehouses and train stations.

We’re looking for a passionate Senior Embedded Platform Engineer to join our Embedded Platform team and help build the next generation of multi-camera and high-performance compute products. In this role, you’ll design, optimize, and scale systems that push the limits of real-time processing and edge intelligence.

You’ll be the go-to expert for electronics, owning our hardware designs and shaping the processes that take ideas from concept to production. Working closely with EMS partners, you’ll ensure exceptional product quality at scale, while collaborating with skilled design partners to bring innovative, cutting-edge systems to life. Along the way, you’ll create smart software and hardware tools to streamline manufacturing and dive deep into challenging, in-depth firmware development.

If you enjoy owning complex systems end-to-end and turning visionary ideas into robust, real-world products, this role is for you.

Your mission

  • Design prototypes for our next generation of products. Oversee prototype fabrication, including performing bring-up, debugging, and rework.

  • Maintain the portfolio of Sevensense products and handle change requests and component end-of-life situations. Additionally, collaborate with our EMS partners to ensure smooth production of our products.

  • Validate your designs through extensive testing of thermal, vibration, humidity, ESD, EMC, and electrical fault conditions.

  • Create test strategies and requirements for testing PCBAs & larger assemblies in production.

Your background

  • Acquired Electrical Engineering skills through a combination of a Masters degree in (Electrical) Engineering, work experience, or relevant projects.

  • Experienced with Altium, KiCAD, Autodesk Fusion/EAGLE or similar CAD programs for schematic capture, PCB design & maintaining component libraries.

  • Capable of simulating electric circuits in spice tools like LTSpice or similar.

  • Proficient with standard electronic lab tools like multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, soldering irons, etc.

  • Knowledge of at least one of the following programming languages: C, C++, Python

  • Basic understanding of the regulatory compliance process with industry standards for safety, EMI/EMC, and environmental regulations.

  • Responsible and detail-oriented team player who never wants to stop learning with a can-do mindset with the ability to take ownership of projects and drive them to success.

·Our offer

  • A unique opportunity to join a young and agile company which is now part of ABB

  • Multiple opportunities to develop your professional career and grow with the company

  • A competitive compensation package

  • A modern office in the center of Zurich

  • An ambitious, supportive and international team that is on a mission to change the world of robotics

If you are enthusiastic about bringing Sevensense to the next level, curious about the opportunity and want to be part of our fast-growing team, apply online. We are interested in intellectually curious and highly motivated candidates so please reach out to us if you have questions or feel unsure about some requirements.

This recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen. Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

Are you ready to make an impact with your sales expertise? As a Sales Engineer for Electrical Installation, you will be the main point of contact for our customers in the field of electrical installation products – including power distributors, intercom systems, and switches & sockets. In this exciting B2B role, you will support electricians and planning engineers across the German-speaking part of Switzerland, actively contributing to the growth of sales and margins.

You will work in a hybrid model (field sales & home office) and report to the Sales Manager for Electrical Installations based in Baden (AG). With your technical know-how and passion for sales, you will build long-term, strategically important customer relationships and sustainably develop your sales territory.

The work model for the role is: #hybrid


They are mainly responsible for

  • Manage your sales region: Provide expert advice to electricians in your area, supporting profitable growth.

  • Acquire new customers: Identify market opportunities, win new clients, and ensure an outstanding customer experience throughout the entire sales process.

  • Grow with the team: Collaborate closely with extended sales teams to explore new market opportunities and contribute innovative ideas.

  • Work in a structured way: Maintain your sales activities and project pipeline consistently in ABB’s CRM system (Salesforce) – transparent and goal-oriented.


• Qualifications for the role

  • At least 3 years of experience in technical sales and business development

  • Good market knowledge in electrical installation and an interest in modern topics like building automation

  • Strong communication skills with proven ability to build and maintain successful customer relationships

  • Completed vocational training as an electrician or a technical university degree (e.g., electrical engineering)

  • Independent, structured working style combined with teamwork and customer orientation

  • Proficient in ERP and CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) as well as MS Office

  • Valid driver’s license category B and a valid work permit for Switzerland

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for
any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment is led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Local Business Line Service Manager & Head of Service Operations

__

Are you ready for new adventures, eager to work on real projects, and driven to shape a productive and sustainable future?

Our ABB Discovery Trainee Program offers a unique entry opportunity with a dynamic role and a motivated team. Experience the operations of an international company firsthand during three different six months assignments over the course of a total of 18 months structured around the topic of Service in Mining.

ABB is a trusted partner to the global mining industry, delivering and supporting critical electrical, automation, and digital infrastructure across mining operations. Our installed base includes power distribution systems, switchgear, transformers, motors, protection relays, automation systems, and industrial cybersecurity solutions that enable safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Through our global service organization, we help customers maximize asset performance, improve operational resilience, reduce downtime, and achieve their sustainability goals. As the mining industry continues its journey toward electrification, digitalization, and autonomous operations, ABB is uniquely positioned to develop innovative service solutions that create long-term value for customers.

Through a personalized, practice-oriented introduction, you will gain the confidence to work independently and as part of inclusive teams. ABB offers various development opportunities and training to enhance your skills and fast-track your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid.

Start date of the program is October 1, 2026. The selection process is taking place between June and July 2026.

Your main availabilities will be:

  • Assignment 1 – Switzerland: Collaborate with the Service Product Management, Service Sales, and Service Project Management teams to gain a comprehensive understanding of ABB's service portfolio, customer challenges, and business drivers. Working closely with technical and commercial stakeholders, support the identification of portfolio gaps and growth opportunities, particularly in the areas of automation, industrial cybersecurity, and electrification, and contribute to the development of future service solutions.
    Assignment 2 – International Assignment: Join an ABB unit abroad and work closely with local teams and customers to gain first-hand exposure to operational challenges, market dynamics, and customer needs. Contribute to identifying opportunities where ABB's service offerings can enhance reliability, productivity, sustainability, and operational performance.
    Assignment 3 – Switzerland: Shape your final assignment together with the business based on organizational priorities and your interests. Potential areas of focus would be in an engineering team, working closely with subject matter experts where you will strengthen your technical foundation while contributing to initiatives that support service innovation, portfolio development, and business growth. Additional collaboration with Product Management, Strategy, and Business Development teams may be included depending on business priorities.
  • Engage in challenging assignments that provide exposure to different functions, allowing you to build a broad understanding of ABB's service business while developing your technical, commercial, and leadership capabilities.
  • Benefit from personalized training, professional mentoring, executive exposure, and continuous support from the Discovery Program team, while receiving regular feedback to accelerate your development.
  • Actively participate in social events and team activities, build a global network across ABB, and become part of our vibrant Discovery Trainee community.

What we're looking for:

  • Master’s degree from university or applied science university in electrical engineering
  • Completed university studies and maximum three years of professional work experience before the start date October 1, 2026
  • Developed analytical and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of English; additional languages are considered an advantage.
  • Authorization to work in Switzerland is required
  • Be curious – sometimes, a question can be more powerful than an answer.
  • Be creative – challenge the status quo with a fresh perspective!
  • Be flexible – this step is just the beginning of a journey that will empower you to find your own path in our company.

More about us:

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry-specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment; digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Mining, Pulp & Paper, Metals, Aluminum and Cement and Food and Beverage.

The recruiting process is being led by Ceren Oezen, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Local Business Line Service Manager & Head of Service Operations

Bist du bereit für neue Abenteuer, eifrig darauf, an echten Projekten zu arbeiten und eine produktive und nachhaltige Zukunft zu gestalten?

Unser ABB Discovery Trainee Programm bietet eine einzigartige Einstiegsmöglichkeit mit einer dynamischen Rolle und einem motivierten Team. Erleben Sie den Betrieb eines internationalen Unternehmens aus erster Hand während drei verschiedenen sechsmonatigen Einsätzen im Laufe von insgesamt 18 Monaten rund um das Thema Service im Bergbau.

ABB ist ein zuverlässiger Partner der globalen Bergbauindustrie und liefert und unterstützt wichtige elektrische, automatisierte und digitale Infrastruktur in allen Bergbaubetrieben. Unsere installierte Basis umfasst Stromverteilungssysteme, Schaltanlagen, Transformatoren, Motoren, Schutzrelais, Automatisierungssysteme und industrielle Cybersicherheitslösungen, die einen sicheren, zuverlässigen und effizienten Betrieb ermöglichen. Durch unsere globale Serviceorganisation helfen wir unseren Kunden, die Anlagenperformance zu maximieren, die betriebliche Widerstandsfähigkeit zu verbessern, Ausfallzeiten zu reduzieren und ihre Nachhaltigkeitsziele zu erreichen. Während die Bergbauindustrie ihren Weg in Richtung Elektrifizierung, Digitalisierung und autonomen Betrieb fortsetzt, ist ABB einzigartig positioniert, um innovative Servicelösungen zu entwickeln, die einen langfristigen Wert für die Kunden schaffen.

Durch eine personalisierte, praxisorientierte Einführung gewinnen Sie das Selbstvertrauen, selbstständig und als Teil inklusiver Teams zu arbeiten. ABB bietet verschiedene Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und Schulungen an, um Ihre Fähigkeiten zu verbessern und Ihre Karriere zu beschleunigen.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle lautet: #LI-Hybrid.

>Startdatum des Programms ist Oktober 1, 2026. Der Auswahlprozess findet zwischen Juni und Juli 2026 statt.

Ihre Hauptverfügbarkeiten sind:

  • Auftrag 1 – Schweiz: Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams Service Product Management, Service Sales und Service Project Management, um ein umfassendes Verständnis des Serviceportfolios von ABB, der Kundenherausforderungen und der Geschäftstreiber zu erlangen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit technischen und kaufmännischen Stakeholdern, Unterstützung bei der Identifizierung von Portfoliolücken und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, insbesondere in den Bereichen Automatisierung, industrielle Cybersicherheit und Elektrifizierung, und Beitrag zur Entwicklung zukünftiger Servicelösungen.
    Auftrag 2 – Internationaler Auftrag: Steigen Sie einer ABB-Einheit im Ausland bei und arbeiten Sie eng mit lokalen Teams und Kunden zusammen, um sich aus erster Hand mit operativen Herausforderungen, Marktdynamik und Kundenbedürfnissen vertraut zu machen. Tragen Sie dazu bei, Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, mit denen das Serviceangebot von ABB die Zuverlässigkeit, Produktivität, Nachhaltigkeit und operative Leistung verbessern kann.
    Auftrag 3 – Schweiz: Formen Sie Ihren endgültigen Auftrag gemeinsam mit dem Unternehmen auf der Grundlage Ihrer organisatorischen Prioritäten und Interessen. Potenzielle Schwerpunkte liegen in einem Engineering-Team, das eng mit Fachexperten zusammenarbeitet, wo Sie Ihre technische Grundlage stärken und gleichzeitig zu Initiativen beitragen, die Serviceinnovation, Portfolioentwicklung und Geschäftswachstum unterstützen. Zusätzliche Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement-, Strategie- und Business Development-Teams kann je nach Geschäftspriorität aufgenommen werden.
  • Engagieren Sie sich in anspruchsvollen • Aufgaben, die unterschiedlichen Funktionen ausgesetzt sind, so dass Sie ein breites Verständnis des Servicegeschäfts von ABB aufbauen und gleichzeitig Ihre technischen, kommerziellen und Führungsfähigkeiten entwickeln können.
  • Profitieren Sie von personalisierten Schulungen, professionellem Mentoring, Executive Exposure und kontinuierlicher Unterstützung durch das Discovery-Programm-Team und erhalten Sie regelmäßiges Feedback, um Ihre Entwicklung zu beschleunigen.
  • Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an sozialen Veranstaltungen und Teamaktivitäten, bauen Sie ein globales Netzwerk für ABB auf und werden Sie Teil unserer dynamischen Discovery Trainee Community.

Was wir suchen:

  • Masterabschluss der Universität oder Fachhochschule für Elektrotechnik
  • Abgeschlossenes Universitätsstudium und maximal drei Jahre Berufserfahrung vor dem Startdatum 1. Oktober 2026
  • Entwickelte analytische und kommunikative Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit technischen und kommerziellen Interessengruppen zusammenzuarbeiten.
  • Starke Englischkenntnisse; zusätzliche Sprachen gelten als Vorteil.
  • Berechtigung zur Arbeit in der Schweiz erforderlich
  • Sei neugierig – manchmal kann eine Frage mächtiger sein als eine Antwort.
  • Sei kreativ – fordere den Status quo mit einer neuen Perspektive heraus!
  • Seien Sie flexibel – dieser Schritt ist nur der Anfang einer Reise, die es Ihnen ermöglicht, Ihren eigenen Weg in unserem Unternehmen zu finden.

Mehr über uns:

Die Division Process Industries liefert komplette Elektrifizierungs- und Automatisierungslösungen, branchenspezifische Produkte und Lifecycle-Services in allen Branchen. Engineering und Bereitstellung von Automatisierungslösungen vom Gerät bis zur Überwachung und Steuerung machen unsere Kunden mehr aus ihrer Investition; Digitalisierungslösungen einschließlich kollaborativer Operationen und Augmented Reality helfen, die Produktivität von Anlagen und Unternehmen zu verbessern, Wartungs- und Energiekosten zu senken. Unser Engineering-, Projektmanagement-, Dienstleistungs- und Lösungsportfolio deckt eine breite Palette von Branchen ab - Bergbau, Zellstoff & Papier, Metalle, Aluminium und Zement sowie Lebensmittel und Getränke.

Der Recruiting-Prozess wird geleitet von Ceren Oezen, Talent Partner bei ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire de services du secteur d'activité local et chef des opérations du service

Êtes-vous prêt pour de nouvelles aventures, désireux de travailler sur de vrais projets et animés pour façonner un avenir productif et durable?

Notre programme ABB Discovery Trainee offre une occasion d'entrée unique avec un rôle dynamique et une équipe motivée. Expérience des activités d'une entreprise internationale de première main au cours de trois affectations de six mois différentes au cours d'un total de 18 mois structurés autour du thème Service in Mining.

ABB est un partenaire de confiance de l'industrie minière mondiale, fournissant et soutenant des infrastructures électriques, d'automatisation et numériques essentielles dans toutes les opérations minières. Notre base installée comprend des systèmes de distribution d'électricité, des commutateurs, des transformateurs, des moteurs, des relais de protection, des systèmes d'automatisation et des solutions de cybersécurité industrielle qui permettent des opérations sûres, fiables et efficaces. Grâce à notre organisation mondiale de services, nous aidons nos clients à maximiser la performance des actifs, à améliorer la résilience opérationnelle, à réduire les temps d'arrêt et à atteindre leurs objectifs de durabilité. Alors que l'industrie minière poursuit son cheminement vers l'électrification, la numérisation et l'exploitation autonome, ABB est particulièrement bien placée pour développer des solutions de service novatrices qui créent une valeur à long terme pour ses clients.

Grâce à une introduction personnalisée axée sur la pratique, vous gagnerez la confiance de travailler de façon indépendante et dans le cadre d'équipes inclusives. L'ABB offre diverses possibilités de perfectionnement et de formation pour améliorer vos compétences et accélérer votre carrière.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-Hybrid.

La date de début du programme est 1 octobre 2026. Le processus de sélection se déroule entre juin et juillet 2026.

Vos principales disponibilités seront :

  • Assignement 1 – Suisse : Collaborer avec les équipes de gestion de produits de service, de vente de services et de gestion de projets de service afin d'acquérir une compréhension complète du portefeuille de services d'ABB, des défis pour les clients et des moteurs d'affaires. Collaborer étroitement avec les intervenants techniques et commerciaux, appuyer l'identification des lacunes du portefeuille et des possibilités de croissance, en particulier dans les domaines de l'automatisation, de la cybersécurité industrielle et de l'électrification, et contribuer au développement de solutions de service futures.
    Assignement 2 – Attribution internationale : Rejoignez une unité d'ABB à l'étranger et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes et les clients locaux afin d'être directement exposés aux défis opérationnels, à la dynamique du marché et aux besoins des clients. Contribuer à identifier les occasions où les offres de services d'ABB peuvent améliorer la fiabilité, la productivité, la durabilité et la performance opérationnelle.
    Assignation 3 – Suisse : Tirez votre dernière affectation en fonction des priorités organisationnelles et de vos intérêts. Une équipe d'ingénieurs pourrait travailler en étroite collaboration avec des experts en la matière afin de renforcer votre base technique tout en contribuant à des initiatives qui appuient l'innovation dans les services, le développement de portefeuilles et la croissance des entreprises. Une collaboration supplémentaire avec les équipes de gestion des produits, de stratégie et de développement des affaires peut être incluse selon les priorités opérationnelles. Les résultats de l'enquête sont présentés dans le tableau ci-dessous. S'engager dans des affectations stimulantes qui offrent une exposition à différentes fonctions, vous permettant de développer une vaste compréhension des activités de service d'ABB tout en développant vos capacités techniques, commerciales et de leadership.
  • Profitez de la formation personnalisée, du mentorat professionnel, de l'exposition des cadres et du soutien continu de l'équipe du Programme de découverte, tout en recevant régulièrement des commentaires pour accélérer votre perfectionnement.
  • Participer activement aux activités sociales et aux activités de l'équipe, créer un réseau mondial à l'échelle de l'ABB et faire partie de notre dynamique communauté de stagiaires en découverte.

Ce que nous cherchons :

  • Maîtrise en génie électrique de l'université ou de l'université de sciences appliquées
  • Études universitaires terminées et expérience professionnelle maximale de trois ans avant la date de début 1 octobre 2026
  • Développer des compétences en analyse et en communication, avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement avec les intervenants techniques et commerciaux.
  • Connaissance accrue de l'anglais; d'autres langues sont considérées comme un avantage.
  • L'autorisation de travailler en Suisse est requise
  • Soyez curieux – parfois, une question peut être plus puissante qu'une réponse.
  • Soyez créatif – remettez en question le statu quo avec une nouvelle perspective!
  • Soyez flexible – cette étape n'est que le début d'un voyage qui vous permettra de trouver votre propre chemin dans notre entreprise.

Plus sur nous:

La division Process Industries offre des solutions complètes d'électrification et d'automatisation, des produits spécifiques à l'industrie et des services de cycle de vie dans toutes les industries. L'ingénierie et la fourniture de solutions d'automatisation de l'appareil à la surveillance et au contrôle font que nos clients tirent davantage parti de leur investissement; les solutions de numérisation incluant des opérations collaboratives et la réalité augmentée contribuent à améliorer la productivité des usines et des entreprises, à réduire les coûts d'entretien et d'énergie. Notre portefeuille d'ingénierie, de gestion de projet, de services et de solutions couvre un large éventail d'industries - mines, pâtes et papiers, métaux, aluminium, ciment et aliments et boissons.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems

__

Your role and responsibilities

Our team's mission is to drive innovation at the intersection of power electronic converters and electromagnetics, translating cutting-edge research into next-generation ABB products. We focus on electromagnetic modeling of power converter systems and components, conducted and radiat-ed emissions mitigation, passive and active filtering strategies, and shielding. By joining us, you will shape the future of energy systems — generating pioneering ideas at the frontier of academic research and industrial innovation, while developing transformative technologies that advance ABB's product portfolio.


Are you passionate about enabling a sustainable future through electromagnetics research in pow-er converter systems? We want to hear from you! A dynamic, international team is excited to wel-come you as our newest member. Together, we will push boundaries and make a lasting impact on the energy transition.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Pioneer innovative concepts for ensuring electromagnetic compatibility and interference compliance in high-power converters

  • Develop EMC models to predict and analyze electromagnetic compatibility and optimize electromagnetic design of circuits and systems

  • EMC measurements of conducted and radiated emissions of converters and HF characterization of components

  • Patent innovative solutions and demonstrate technology leadership through e.g., high-impact publications

  • Collaborate closely with ABB research centers, business units, and universities to transition research into real-world applications


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in electrical engineering, physics or related discipline with specialization in power electronics or electromagnetics

  • Proven research excellence demonstrated through high-impact publications and patents

  • Deep technical expertise in:

    • EMC/EMI theory and solid theoretical background in electromagnetic modelling and field simulations

    • Power electronic converter topologies, filters, magnetics, and semiconductor switching devices

    • Simulation tools such as CST, COMSOL, ANSYS, SPICE circuit simulator (LTSpice, SIMetrix), Simulink

  • Hands-on laboratory skills in HF-electromagnetic measurements (conducted and/or radiated emissions), with a proactive, self-driven approach to designing, building, and testing EMC/EMI-compliant power converters. Versatile skill set with the ability to bridge theory and practice across multiple technical domains.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced industrial research environment and deliver results

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Canteen

  • Flexible work practices

  • Childcare


More about us

At the ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Fulfillment Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end planning and management of inventory, ensuring an efficient flow from purchase requisition through to customer invoicing and delivery execution. A strong focus will be placed on planning activities, including order portfolio management, inventory optimization, replenishment strategies, and the definition of inventory parameters and targets to guarantee material availability and service level performance.

The work model for the role is onsite. #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the IPU in Quartino, Switzerland. Main stakeholders are the P&F, OP&L, Logistics, IPU Stand Alone, Modular and B&S.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Defining inventory policies based on specified segmentation, including ABC/XYZ analysis to optimize inventory strategies, stock levels, and service performance in terms of ROTD

  • Calculating and maintaining the inventory parameters, including safety stock, reorder point, lot size, lead time, and replenishment strategies, in SAP

  • Coordinating material planning with call-offs to ensure that purchase requisitions are converted into purchase orders in collaboration with operations, buyers, and services

  • Collaborating with buyers to achieve the best possible supplier performance in terms of supplier on-time delivery, Minimum Order Quantity, quality, lead time, and flexibility

  • Demonstrating solid knowledge of logistics flows and operational dynamics to ensure efficient material availability, inventory management, and end-to-end supply chain coordination


• Qualifications for the role:

  • +5 years of experience in material planning

  • Degree in Management Engineering/Economics as a preferred qualification

  • Good skills in data analysis, structured thinking, teamwork, and communication

  • Profound knowledge in SAP MM/PP, MS Excel, and Power BI

  • Fluency in Italian and English

More about us:

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop and maintain test infrastructures and test automations in accordance with business strategy to improve safety, efficiency, quality, and cost reduction. Each day, you will ensure existing test systems remain functional and up-to-date while designing new automated solutions for emerging products. You will also showcase your expertise by implementing innovative testing methodologies that enhance production standards and reduce costs.

The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Maintaining and improving existing test systems, both hardware infrastructures and software automations, ensuring they meet current operational standards.

  • Designing new test systems for new products in compliance with specifications and manual test procedures, implementing automation wherever possible.

  • Providing support for the integration and startup of test systems, defining action plans and training relevant personnel.

  • Identifying and recommending opportunities for improving test processes and implementing related projects, ensuring adherence to safety requirements and evaluating new technologies.

• Qualifications for the role

  • You have a minimum of 3 years of experience in UPS testing or commissioning, with proven expertise in test system development and maintenance.

  • Highly skilled in hardware design and automation software development, with the ability to create robust and efficient testing solutions.

  • Possess an enhanced knowledge of electrical infrastructures design and software development in C programming language.

  • You are passionate about workplace safety and technical documentation, ensuring all systems comply with safety requirements and are properly documented.

  • Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • You are at ease communicating in English, both written and spoken.

  • Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, oder einem verwandten Bereich.

Ce poste relève de:

Production Engineering Manager

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la possibilité de développer et de maintenir des infrastructures de test et des automatisations de test conformément à la stratégie d'entreprise pour améliorer la sécurité, l'efficacité, la qualité et la réduction des coûts. Vous présenterez également votre expertise en mettant en oeuvre des méthodes d'essai novatrices qui améliorent les normes de production et réduisent les coûts.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est hybrid. #LI-Hybrid

  • Déterminer et recommander les possibilités d'améliorer les processus d'essai et de mettre en oeuvre des projets connexes, assurer le respect des exigences de sécurité et évaluer les nouvelles technologies.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Vous avez au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le test ou la mise en service d'UPS, avec une expertise éprouvée dans le développement et la maintenance du système de test.

  • Très compétent en conception matérielle et en développement de logiciels d'automatisation, avec la capacité de créer des solutions d'essai robustes et efficaces.

  • Maîtrise une meilleure connaissance de la conception des infrastructures électriques et du développement de logiciels en langage de programmation C.

  • Vous êtes passionné par la sécurité en milieu de travail et la documentation technique, vous assurant que tous les systèmes respectent les exigences de sécurité et sont bien documentés.

  • Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise de communiquer en anglais, à la fois écrit et parlé.

  • Nice-to-have: Connaissance des langages de programmation tels que LabVIEW, Python et C#, expérience de la programmation des IDE comme LabWindows CVI et VSCode, et connaissance des logiciels de conception matérielle tels qu'Altium.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Business Manager - E2E


In this role, you will play a key role in establishing and managing the day-to-day operations of our brand-new, modern Robotics headquarters in Zurich Oerlikon. Reporting to the COO/Head of Operations, you will ensure the office runs efficiently while creating a welcoming and productive workplace for employees and visitors. Over time, you will also provide dedicated administrative support to the COO/Head of Operations and potentially other business leaders, making this a varied role that combines office management with executive assistance in a dynamic international environment.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

The location for the role is Zurich Oerlikon, Switzerland. Office presence is required for at least 3-4 days per week.


• Your responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the day-to-day operations of our new Robotics headquarters, ensuring an efficient, well-organized, and welcoming workplace while coordinating office services, supplies, meeting rooms, catering, and workspace utilization.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for facility and office services, working closely with the landlord, building management, IT support, cleaning services, and external vendors to ensure the office operates smoothly.

  • Coordinate office administration, including visitor management, reception backup, internal communications, and the continuous improvement of administrative processes and office procedures.

  • Organize internal meetings, business events, conferences, business travel, accommodation, and visitor logistics, ensuring a seamless experience for employees and guests.

  • Provide proactive administrative support to the COO/Head of Operations and other business leaders, managing calendar coordination, travel arrangements, correspondence, presentations, and other business-related administrative activities.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • 3+ years of experience in a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, Office Manager, or similar administrative role.

  • Previous experience supporting managers or leadership teams in an international business environment.

  • Experience coordinating office operations, facilities, vendors, and events; experience in setting up or supporting a new office is an advantage.

  • Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills, with a proactive, service-oriented approach and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; experience with SAP or similar ERP systems is an advantage.

  • Fluency in English and German is required.

Please submit your application in English.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A young, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Simulating and optimizing power electronic topologies and converters for various applications including conducting broad system level studies.

  • Leading and participating in converter design projects in collaboration with the business while mentoring juniors.

  • Designing, implementing, and testing converter prototypes in the lab.

  • Driving innovation by developing new power electronic concepts and solutions.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD with emphasis on power electronics converter design, optimization, and prototyping. Additional relevant industrial experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on laboratory skills, a willingness to work independently and take initiative in designing, building, and testing converter prototypes. A broader set of skills is expected.

  • Experience with setting-up converter testing by means of circulating power in a back-to-back configuration will be advantageous.

  • Experience in design, commissioning and testing of medium voltage and 3-phase grid connected inverters/rectifiers will be advantageous.

  • Experience in applied control theory including hardware implementation of control for power electronic systems can be advantageous.

  • Fluency in English, both spoken and written.


More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Business Manager – Energy Storage System

__

Business and Division Description

ABB Traction plays a critical role in shaping the future of electrified mobility. Through our traction battery packs and energy storage solutions, we enable customers globally to achieve higher efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in rail and off highway applications. We combine global scale with strong local execution to deliver performance, innovation, and long-term value.

Location

This role is open globally for ABB employees, but location is set in Switzerland. The work model is hybrid #LI-hybrid.

Key • Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the newly established ESS R&D organization together with the team leaders and around 30 individual contributors – aligned with the Division and Product Line strategy
  • Establish technical thought-leadership and expertise in all relevant disciplines spanning from battery cells to battery systems – nurture an innovation pipeline to stay ahead of the competition
  • Own the ESS R&D budget and manage technology roadmaps, projects, and priorities in close alignment with the ESS product management function.
  • Establish a strong outside-in and customer-oriented culture aligned with the ABB values, courage, care, curiosity and collaboration
  • Build, develop and maintain strong relationships with all relevant internal and external stakeholders – ensure clarity at the interfaces to other functions, such as engineering, production and supply chain management
  • Take full responsibility for a safe working environment and for the correct implementation of guidelines and processes.

• Qualifications

  • Master degree in a STEM discipline
  • Proven direct or indirect leadership skills, with a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills
  • Experience in leading product or platform development in the field of propulsion or battery energy storage systems
  • Knowledge of industry standards and development processes relevant to railway and e-mobility applications
  • A high level of self-motivation, ownership, curiosity, and strong drive to stay one inch ahead
  • Must be fluent in English, fluency in German a strong plus
  • Candidates from the Traction Division will be given preferential consideration

What’s in it for you?

We give you the space to lead, the support to grow, and the chance to make a difference. Whether you're solving problems, building something new, or helping others succeed, your impact is real. You’ll be part of a team that values your voice and celebrates your progress. The position reports to the Head of the Product Line ESS.

Call to action

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Lead


In this role, you will act as a key technical contributor to the base software platform of our products. You will apply your expertise to make sure our algorithms are supplied with fresh sensor data and can run without interruptions, even in the toughest conditions. Your work will glue all pieces of software together and make our robots operate robustly in real-world environments.

The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-hybrid


This role is contributing to the Sevensense by ABB team as part of ABB Robotics in Switzerland and Spain. You will work closely with all software teams at Sevensense to make sure our algorithms reliably execute on our own hardware products.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Designing and implementing the robotics middleware that connects all our sensors and algorithms together.

  • Making sure your fellow developers have the tools to record, visualize and introspect our robotic systems.

  • Ensuring a healthy robot system that can be easily debugged across releases.

  • Improving the stability and reliability of our robots such that they can work 24/7 without interruption to make our customers happy.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering and a degree in Computer Science, Robotics or related field.

  • Track record in writing solid production Python and C++ code and bonus points for Rust or the willingness to learn Rust.

  • Familiarity with robotic middleware like ROS2 or equivalent, and a passion for internal robot software architecture.

  • Deep expertise in real-time systems and knowing how to trace/profile them, additionally you have a good understanding of embedded Linux.

  • Ability to solve complex technical problems independently, taking ownership in a product-driven environment, and collaborating effectively across teams.

  • Bonus points for working with Nvidia Jetson modules, and the application of them in diverse robot setups.

What's in it for you?

You will join a team of highly talented, motivated, and collaborative professionals based in Zurich, Switzerland and Sant Quirze del Vallès (Barcelona). Working alongside experienced engineers with deep expertise in robotics, embedded systems, and distributed software, you will have continuous opportunities to learn and develop your skills. As part of this team, you will play a key role in building a robust foundation for our mobile robots. Together, we push the boundaries of autonomous mobile robots, working with modern middleware, real-time systems, and advanced hardware. You will have the opportunity to design and improve systems that power a large fleet of robots operating in real-world environments, going beyond simulations and prototypes to deliver reliable, production-ready solutions.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

We’re looking for a passionate Technical Account Manager to join our Marketing & Sales team in Zurich, Switzerland.

  • Manage a sales area with a focus on our forklift tracking solution: identify key players and their needs, and generate leads to grow the sales in your area

    • Quote, invoice, forecast, report, and negotiate contracts independently growing revenue and profit

  • Coordinate and influence external and internal stakeholders (technical, managerial, executive) throughout the customer journey to secure high sales volumes and customer satisfaction

Your background:

  • Completed university degree in a technical discipline

  • 3-5 years of work experience in technical sales or project management

  • Analytical attitude with outstanding presentation and communication skills, in particular in situations of conflict and negotiations

  • Willingness to travel: 20-30%

  • Fluency in English

  • A unique opportunity to join a young and agile team inside ABB Robotics

  • Multiple opportunities to develop your professional career and growth with the company

  • A competitive compensation package

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager - Switzerland

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Front-End Sales Engineer, it is your exciting task to implement our sales strategy and to distribute our products and solutions to customers in Switzerland. In close cooperation with our internal service, you consult and convince customers of the benefits of our high-performance products. In addition to looking after existing customers, you are also responsible for the acquisition of new clients. You will systematically conclude contracts with business partners and thus contribute to a sustainable increase in our company's market share.


The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid


This role is contributing to the ABB Motors & Drives division in Switzerland.


You will be mainly accountable for

  • Leading project tendering activities by identifying, qualifying, and actively pursuing project opportunities; coordinating internal stakeholders (engineering, product management, and service) to deliver competitive and compliant technical and commercial proposals
  • Influencing engineering companies and key decision-makers early in the project lifecycle to position ABB solutions as the preferred specification, ensuring alignment with customer technical requirements and long-term value propositions
  • Building strong customer relationships by understanding needs and offering tailored ABB solutions, while leading technical and commercial contract negotiations
  • Tracking market trends, identifying new opportunities, and managing sales processes and documentation, including account plans and SFDC reporting

• Qualifications for the role

  • University degree or diploma of higher education (TS/HF) in a technical field
  • In-depth technical knowledge of motors, generators, drives, and services
  • Demonstrated experience in the management of customer accounts and sales strategy with proven ability to develop and maintain customer relationships
  • Market and customer knowledge are a plus
  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills
  • Availability for travel throughout Switzerland, but mainly in the German-speaking part
  • Fluent in German and English, other languages are an advantage

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:


  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance
  • Eco bonus
  • Company Car

More about us

ABB Motors and Drives delivers a complete range of motors, generators and drive products for all industries and applications. Our mission is to be an expert in automated industrial systems, to focus on reliability in our partnerships, and to know our customers’ requirements by heart.


The recruitment process is led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Operations Manager

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

As part of our strategic growth agenda, we are hiring a new Global Head of Quality for our Motion Traction Division.

This role is open globally, and preferred locations are set close to our main Motion Traction locations in Switzerland, Germany, Italy, and Poland.

The work model is hybrid and regular presence in our factories and suppliers' location will be expected, with the ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

#LIhybrid

To support the continued growth of our Motion Traction business and the increasing expectations of our customers, we are looking for a Global Head of Quality who will elevate quality into a true source of competitive advantage across our global organization.

This is a high-impact leadership role for a technical quality leader who wants to shape the future of quality in a complex, engineered-to-order environment. Beyond defining strategy, you will be expected to build a lasting quality culture, one that is owned by every function, every site, and every team involved in delivering reliable, high-performance solutions to our customers.

As a member of the divisional leadership team, you will lead a global network of quality professionals and act as a key connector across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, R&D, Project Execution, and Customer-facing teams. You will bring people together around a shared ambition: preventing issues before they occur, solving problems at the root cause, and continuously raising the standard of performance across the full value chain.

This role calls for a leader who combines strong technical credibility with the ability to influence, engage, and mobilize people in a global matrix organization. You will need to move confidently between strategic transformation and operational detail, from quality governance, supplier performance, and closed-loop quality systems to shopfloor engagement, customer feedback, and data-based decision making.

Success in this role will depend on your ability to create ownership rather than control. You will empower teams to identify risks early, strengthen prevention over detection, and embed accountability for quality into everyday decisions. By doing so, you will help build a culture where quality is not a department or a process, but a mindset that enables customer trust, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.

For a technical leader who is motivated by impact, complexity, and global collaboration, this is an opportunity to shape quality at scale, driving measurable improvement today while building the capabilities, systems, and culture that will define the future of Motion Traction.

Key • Responsibilities

  • Set and execute the global quality strategy in line with business priorities, ABB quality standards, and QMS requirements.

  • Lead the global Quality organization and strengthen a consistent, prevention-focused quality culture across regions.

  • Build and sustain a robust closed-loop quality process from product development through customer feedback.

  • Drive global standards for supplier quality, production quality assurance, testing, and outgoing inspection.

  • Lead data-driven quality governance, including analytics, risk identification, non-conformance management, and prevention initiatives.

  • Partner with Engineering, R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer teams to resolve issues systematically, prevent recurrence, and improve quality performance.

  • Oversee global quality processes, audits, governance models, and continuous improvement frameworks.

  • Embed quality early in product and process development through structured planning, APQP/PPAP where applicable, and proactive risk detection.

• Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Quality, Engineering, or Operations within complex industrial or engineered-to-order environments.

  • Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent technical experience will also be considered.

  • Proven record of driving quality improvement, leading structured problem solving, and using data to improve business performance.

  • Strong expertise in quality systems, QMS governance, root cause analysis, 8D, and Lean, ideally gained in automotive, rail, or heavy equipment environments; APQP, PPAP, DFMEA, and PFMEA knowledge is a strong advantage.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders in a global matrix organization.

  • Familiarity with IRIS, EN/IEC standards, and regulatory requirements related to traction or railway applications is an advantage.

  • Proven experience leading teams, developing (seasoned) people, and creating a positive, collaborative environment that supports engagement, accountability, and high performance.

  • Excellent communication skills with fluency in English

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% globally.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role, location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.


ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing, and circular solutions for customers, industries, and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit careers.abb to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences

This position reports to:

Global Project Execution Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape and elevate our global engineering function, providing strategic direction and leadership across Engineering Units within Sales and Solutions Global Solutions Centers.

You will drive team growth and capability development, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and process excellence to strengthen our engineering and design expertise.

You will also ensure outstanding project execution, supporting teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet customer expectations, safety and compliance standards, and business performance goals — on time and within budget.


The work model for the role is: hybrid

Position location: Global

This role is contributing to the Electrification Distribution Solutions Business Division.

  • Lead and oversee Engineering Leaders and Teams located in different regions.

  • Drive performance and delivery excellence, setting clear KPIs and supporting teams to achieve results on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

  • Build trusted, long-term customer partnerships, collaborating closely to understand needs, identify opportunities, and co-create innovative solutions.

  • Strengthen engineering capabilities and ways of working, fostering continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and consistent frameworks across teams.

  • Lead, coach, and empower diverse teams, creating an inclusive environment where people can grow, contribute, and perform at their best while upholding HSE and integrity standards.

  • Contribute to the training of Engineering Teams and Service Teams

  • Proactively manage risks and opportunities, embedding structured review processes that support sustainable growth and informed decision-making.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Deep knowledge of MV/LV systems, System design (Protection and Control, Automation, Auxiliary systems), eHouse solutions and Switchgear engineering processes with experience in EPC engineering business.

  • Sound knowledge of Data Center applications for Hyperscale and Colocations

  • Experience of commissioning activities and quality procedures for FAT and SAT.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling effective collaboration across functions, regions, and organizational levels.

More about us

Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way.
