descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A young, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Develop low- to medium-frequency, high-power magnetic components with medium-voltage insulation for emerging power electronics applications.
  • Generate innovative concepts at the intersection of power electronics and magnetics.
  • Plan, set up, and execute experimental characterization, including model validation of magnetic components.
  • Contribute your expertise to research projects and translate results into patent applications, scientific publications, and technical reports.
  • Build and maintain a professional network within the organization, actively sharing knowledge and fostering collaboration.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Ph.D. in electrical engineering, power electronics, physics, or a related field.
  • Excellent scientific publication record in high-impact journals and leading power electronics conferences.
  • Expertise in designing medium-frequency transformers with medium-voltage insulation.
  • Experience with magnetic core materials and winding technologies (e.g., Litz wire, foil) across low to high frequency ranges.
  • Strong modeling capabilities for magnetic components, including electromagnetic simulations and thermal management.
  • Proven hands-on laboratory experience in testing and characterization, with a solid foundation in power electronics and fluency in English (written and spoken).

More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, was die Welt beherrscht.


Diese Position berichtet an:

R&D Team Lead


Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

Die Mission dieses Teams ist es, moderne und disruptive leistungselektronische Lösungen aus der Forschung in die Produktentwicklung zu bringen. Wir verbessern unsere Produkte durch ganzheitliche Optimierung, die Weiterentwicklung neuartiger Konvertertopologien sowie die Optimierung von Schlüsselkomponenten. Indem Sie sich uns anschließen, beteiligen Sie sich an der Ideengenerierung an der Grenze der akademischen Forschung und der industriellen Anwendungen sowie an der Entwicklung fortschrittlicher Technologien für die Produkte von ABB.

Möchten Sie durch den Einsatz fortschrittlicher und hocheffizienter leistungselektronischer Lösungen für verschiedene Anwendungen zu einer grüneren Zukunft beitragen? Kontaktieren Sie uns! Ein junges, multinationales Team freut sich darauf, Sie als sein neuestes Teammitglied willkommen zu heißen!

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle lautet: #LI-Hybrid

Die Hauptaufgaben umfassen

  • Entwickeln Sie nieder- bis mittelfrequente, leistungsstarke magnetische Komponenten mit Mittelspannungsisolierung für neue Leistungselektronikanwendungen.
  • Erzeugen Sie innovative Konzepte an der Schnittstelle von Leistungselektronik und Magnetik.
  • Planen, Einrichten und Ausführen der experimentellen Charakterisierung, einschließlich Modellvalidierung von magnetischen Komponenten.
  • Bringen Sie Ihre Expertise in Forschungsprojekte ein und übersetzen Sie die Ergebnisse in Patentanmeldungen, wissenschaftliche Publikationen und technische Berichte.
  • Aufbau und Pflege eines professionellen Netzwerks innerhalb der Organisation, aktiver Wissensaustausch und Förderung der Zusammenarbeit.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Ph.D. in Elektrotechnik, Leistungselektronik, Physik oder einem verwandten Bereich.
  • Exzellente wissenschaftliche Publikation in renommierten Zeitschriften und führenden Konferenzen der Leistungselektronik.
  • Expertise in der Entwicklung von Mittelfrequenztransformatoren mit Mittelspannungsisolierung.
  • Erfahrung mit magnetischen Kernmaterialien und Wicklungstechnologien (z. B. Litzdraht, Folie) in niedrigen bis hohen Frequenzbereichen.
  • Starke Modellierungsmöglichkeiten für magnetische Komponenten, einschließlich elektromagnetischer Simulationen und Wärmemanagement.
  • Bewährte praktische Laborerfahrung im Testen und Charakterisieren, mit einer soliden Basis in Leistungselektronik und fließend Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen).

Mehr über uns

Im ABB-Forschungszentrum in Baden-Dättwil bei Zürich arbeiten wir an spannenden Technologien, die die Zukunft unserer Produkte prägen. Unsere internationalen Forschungsteams konzentrieren sich auf Leistungselektronik, Energiespeicherung, intelligente Systeme und Switching.

Cette position se rapporte à:

R&D Team Lead


Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

La mission de cette équipe est d'apporter des solutions électroniques modernes et perturbatrices de la recherche au développement de produits. Nous améliorons nos produits par l'optimisation holistique, en poussant de nouvelles topologies de convertisseur et en optimisant les composants clés. En vous joignant à nous, vous participerez à la génération d'idées à la frontière de la recherche universitaire et des applications industrielles, ainsi qu'au développement de technologies de pointe pour les produits ABB.

Vous voulez contribuer à un avenir plus écologique en utilisant des solutions électriques et électroniques avancées et très efficaces pour diverses applications? Contactez-nous ! Une jeune équipe multinationale est impatiente de vous accueillir comme leur dernier membre de l'équipe!

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est: #LI-Hybrid

Les principales responsabilités comprennent

  • Développer des composants magnétiques à basse et moyenne fréquence avec une isolation à moyenne tension pour les applications électroniques de puissance émergentes.
  • Générer des concepts novateurs à l'intersection de l'électronique de puissance et de l'électronique magnétique.
  • Planifier, mettre en place et exécuter la caractérisation expérimentale, y compris la validation de modèles de composants magnétiques.
  • Apportez votre expertise aux projets de recherche et traduisez les résultats en demandes de brevet, publications scientifiques et rapports techniques.
  • Créer et maintenir un réseau professionnel au sein de l'organisation, partager activement les connaissances et favoriser la collaboration.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Ph.D. en génie électrique, en électronique de puissance, en physique ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Excellente publication scientifique dans des revues à fort impact et conférences sur l'électronique de puissance.
  • Expertise dans la conception de transformateurs à moyenne fréquence avec isolation à moyenne tension.
  • Expérience des matériaux de base magnétiques et des technologies d'enroulement (p. ex. fil Litz, feuille) sur des gammes de fréquences basses à élevées.
  • Capacités de modélisation solides pour les composants magnétiques, y compris les simulations électromagnétiques et la gestion thermique.
  • Expérience de laboratoire pratique éprouvée dans les essais et la caractérisation, avec une solide base en électronique de puissance et la fluidité en anglais (écrit et parlé).

Plus d'informations sur nous

Au centre de recherche ABB de Baden-Dättwil à proximité de Zurich, nous travaillons sur des technologies passionnantes qui façonnent l'avenir de nos produits. Nos équipes de recherche internationales se concentrent sur l'électronique électrique, le stockage de l'énergie, les systèmes intelligents et le commutation.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop service sales, from lead generation, service sales opportunities creation until securing the profitable sales within the designated areas. Each day, you will focus on Installed Base (IB) and sell the entire Service portfolio. You will also showcase your skills by building long-term customer relationships and ensuring immediate response to specific customer needs and issues.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

This role contributes to the Service of Mining and Materials Business Line within the Automation Process Industries division in a defined global region.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Penetrating into IB, promoting various upgrades, retrofits, and value-add services to the benefit of the customers and ABB.
  • Understanding the channel strategy and the establishment of related prices, preparing sales plans, reviewing them, and proposing recovery plan(s) when needed.
  • Generating service sales leads and developing new market opportunities by utilizing market trend information and through identifying and exploring potential new service portfolios.
  • Acting as a marketer/salesperson of ABB’s service products and solutions during marketing activities (campaigns, trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings).


Our team dynamics
You will join an international collaborative team working in a changing business environment, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Degree in Engineering Disciplines or Business and 5+ years of experience in similar roles
  • You are highly motivated and enjoy working in agile market and you’re willing to travel up to 30%
  • Demonstrated experience in managing accounts, increasing sales growth, and complex negotiations
  • Solid stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams and customers
  • Solid data-driven pipeline & forecasting discipline (e.g., SFDC)
  • Proven tender/pursuit leadership up to complex, high-value solution deals
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English; German and other languages are welcome

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Learning and growth opportunities
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Generous vacation allowance


More about us
We help the mining industry become safer, leaner, and more sustainable by combining electrification, automation, and digital technologies with over 130 years of experience.
Our comprehensive mining services portfolio - ranging from engineering and maintenance to digital and lifecycle solutions - supports customers in maximizing asset performance and availability.
Together with our customers, we deliver tailored, data-driven solutions that enable reliable operations today while shaping the future of the all-electric, connected mine.

This position reports to:

Project Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role within the Customer Project Execution Team, you will conduct customer witnessed testing and verification activities for assignments of medium/high testing complexity of systems,
subsystems, or products effectively and cost-efficiently and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies and standards.

The work model for the role is: onsite

This role is contributing to the ABB Electrification, Smart Power, Critical Power and Customer Projects Execution team in Quartino, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • End-to-End Testing Accountability: Plan, prepare, and execute customer-witnessed type tests, including full documentation, while ensuring compliance with contractual, regulatory, and industry standards.

  • Technical Expertise & Support: Provide technical support during installation and testing, perform first-level troubleshooting, and collaborate closely with Project Management and Sales to ensure successful validation and delivery.

  • Leadership & Collaboration: Guide and support test engineers, promote best practices across projects, and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to ensure testing readiness and quality.

  • Process, Risk & Quality Management: Apply and continuously improve standardized processes and tools, conduct risk assessments to ensure safe operations, and proactively identify and report improvement opportunities.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in testing and validation of products within the electromechanical field. Experience with UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) systems is considered a strong advantage.

  • Strong passion for technical excellence, with the ability and willingness to share knowledge and best practices across teams and projects.

  • Native Italian speaker with strong English (B1) communication skills; able to interact confidently and professionally with customers and internal stakeholders in an international environment.

  • Positive, collaborative, and proactive approach, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to contribute to team performance and engagement.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: EL Sales Supp. Mgr.-Configur.&Quotation __ Votre rôle et vos responsabilités Dans ce poste de Bid & Proposal Engineer – Distribution moyenne tension Products and Solutions - vous jouez un rôle central dans le processus commercial des solutions moyenne tension. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de vente, nos fournisseurs et nos clients tout au long des phases de consultation et d’appel d’offres. Vous contribuez directement à la qualité et à la compétitivité de nos offres en combinant expertise technique, sens commercial et rigueur d’exécution. Le modèle de travail pour ce rôle est: hybride. Ce rôle contribue activement au développement de la base installée moyenne tension chez nos clients au sein de la division Distribution Solutions – ABB Electrification Suisse. Vos principales responsabilités - Coordonner les demandes d’offres et assurer le respect des délais tout au long du processus d’appel d’offres - Analyser les cahiers des charges, spécifications techniques et exigences clients sous les angles technique et commercial, et sélectionner les solutions et produits les plus adaptés en fonction des besoins clients et du portefeuille de solutions - Définir les stratégies d’offre en collaboration avec les équipes commerciales, d’ingénierie et de gestion de projet, et mener les négociations avec les fournisseurs durant la phase d’offre - Réaliser les calculs des coûts et structurer la documentation technique et commerciale des offres (descriptions produits, services, livrables)
• Votre profil - Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme en génie électrique ou d’une formation équivalente (HES, école d’ingénieurs ou formation technique supérieure) - Expérience confirmée en environnement technique industriel, idéalement dans la gestion d’offres ou de projets - Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de flexibilité et d’une forte orientation client - Excellentes compétences en communication en français et en anglais (l’allemand est un atout) - Vous êtes passionné(e) par l’analyse et la sélection de stratégies commerciales et de solutions en fonction des besoins clients - Bonne maîtrise des calculs de coûts et de la structuration d’offres techniques - Vous possédez un esprit d’équipe, de la fiabilité et une grande intégrité professionnelle Your role and responsibilities In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the assigned Sales organization (division and market) and customers during the proposal process. Each day, you will serve as a key technical resource in the assigned area. You will also showcase your expertise by preparing technical descriptions of the products and technology, determining costs, and preparing final documentation. The work model for the role is: hybrid. This role is contributing to the Medium Voltage Switchgear business within the Electrification Distribution Solutions division in Switzerland. You will be mainly accountable for - Coordinating quote requests and deadlines as well as conducting procurement negotiations with suppliers during the tendering phase - Analyzing and evaluating requests, specifications and tenders from technical and commercial perspectives - Defining sales strategies and designing product configurations based on customer requirements in collaboration with sales, engineering and project management - Creating commercial and technical quote documentation, including detailed description of products and services
• Qualifications for the role - You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering field, or a higher professional qualification in engineering (e.g. Höhere Fachschule, Fachhochschule) - You are captivated by independent, flexible and customer-oriented working style - You are at ease communicating in French and English (German is an advantage) - You are passionate about finding the right sales strategies and products based on customer needs - Proven experience of cost calculations - You are a reliable team player and personality with integrity ​ More about us ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations. We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Höhere Fachschule, Fachhochschule) - Vous êtes séduit par un style de travail indépendant, flexible et axé sur le client - Vous êtes à l'aise de communiquer en français et en anglais (l'allemand est un avantage) - Vous êtes passionné par la recherche des bonnes stratégies de vente et des produits basés sur les besoins des clients - Expérience éprouvée de calcul des coûts - Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe fiable et de la personnalité avec intégrité Plus sur nous La division Distribution Solutions d'ABB fournit des composants de tension moyenne, des commutateurs et des solutions qui connectent et protègent le réseau électrique en évolution, assurant une distribution d'énergie fiable et prévisible. descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Materials

__

Your role and responsibilities:
In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain vocational experience through a temporary work placement. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing personal education/employment opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Materials team at the ABB corporate research center in Switzerland. In the frame of a six-month internship scheduled to start in August or September 2026, you will be able to put theory into practice by contributing to our projects related to future energy technologies.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to current technology development projects focusing on sustainable thermoplastic and thermoset polymers
  • Optimize processing and curing conditions of the materials at laboratory scale
  • Characterize thermal, mechanical and electrical properties, and investigate surface wettability and accelerated aging performance of sustainable polymer materials
  • Perform polymer recycling experiments to enable a circular polymer economy
  • Analyze and document experimental data, present results to the project team, and contribute to technical discussions

You will join a highly motivated and multidisciplinary team that is passionate about materials, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor`s or Master`s degree in Chemistry, Materials Science/Engineering, or a related discipline (completion of at least six semesters); official enrollment is essential
  • General understanding of and interest in polymer materials
  • Fundamental knowledge in polymers is of advantage
  • Experience in laboratory work and know-how in experimental methods
  • Motivated, self-motivated mindset and ability to work independently
  • Highly conscientious individual with a keen sense of responsibility
  • Fluent command of English, both written and spoken; German is a plus

What's in it for you

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products.

The Materials team at ABB’s Swiss research center in the proximity of Zurich focuses on the development and manufacturing of innovative materials to be implemented in the company’s future products. We are currently offering outstanding students the chance to join our multidisciplinary team of researchers in the field of metallic, composite and polymer materials.

The recruiting process is being led by Mara Werne, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Call to action

Be part of something bigger. This is where progress is powered, teams initiate action, and we move the world forward together. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Research Team Manager - Materials

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten:
In dieser Funktion haben Sie die Möglichkeit, durch ein befristetes Praktikum Berufserfahrung zu sammeln. Jeden Tag erwerben Sie Wissen, indem Sie Aufgaben wie angewiesen ausführen. Sie werden auch Ihre Expertise präsentieren, indem Sie die Aktivitäten von ABB unterstützen und persönliche Bildungs- / Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten verbessern.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: #LI-Onsite

Diese Rolle trägt zum Materialteam des ABB Unternehmensforschungszentrums in der Schweiz bei. Im Rahmen eines sechsmonatigen Praktikums, das im August oder September 2026 beginnen soll, können Sie Theorie in die Praxis umsetzen, indem Sie zu unseren Projekten im Zusammenhang mit zukünftigen Energietechnologien beitragen.

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Beitragen zu aktuellen Technologieentwicklungsprojekten mit Schwerpunkt auf nachhaltigen thermoplastischen und duroplastischen Polymeren
  • Optimieren Sie die Verarbeitungs- und Aushärtungsbedingungen der Materialien im Labormaßstab
  • Charakterisieren Sie die thermischen, mechanischen und elektrischen Eigenschaften und untersuchen Sie die Oberflächenbenetzbarkeit und die beschleunigte Alterungsleistung nachhaltiger Polymermaterialien
  • Durchführen von Polymerrecyclingexperimenten, um eine zirkuläre Polymerwirtschaft zu ermöglichen
  • Analysieren und dokumentieren Sie experimentelle Daten, präsentieren Sie dem Projektteam Ergebnisse und tragen Sie zu technischen Diskussionen bei

Sie werden einem hochmotivierten und multidisziplinären Team beitreten, das sich für Materialien begeistert, wo Sie gedeihen können.


• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Derzeit verfolgen einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Chemie, Materialwissenschaften / Engineering, oder eine verwandte Disziplin (Abschluss von mindestens sechs Semestern); offizielle Einschreibung ist wichtig
  • Allgemeines Verständnis und Interesse an Polymermaterialien
  • Grundlegende Kenntnisse in Polymeren sind von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung in Laborarbeit und Know-how in experimentellen Methoden
  • Motivierte, selbstmotivierte Denkweise und Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten
  • Hoch gewissenhafte Person mit einem ausgeprägten Verantwortungsbewusstsein
  • Fluent beherrscht Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen; Deutsch ist ein Plus

Was ist für dich drin

Wir befähigen Sie, Initiative zu ergreifen, Ideen herauszufordern und mit Zuversicht zu führen. Sie werden durch sinnvolle Arbeit, kontinuierliches Lernen und Unterstützung wachsen, die auf Ihre Ziele zugeschnitten ist. Jede Idee, die du teilst und jede Handlung, die du unternimmst, trägt zu etwas Größerem bei.

Mehr über uns

ABB Corporate Research entwickelt in enger Zusammenarbeit mit seinen verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen die Grundlagen für die nächste Generation von ABB-Produkten.

Das Materialteam im Schweizer Forschungszentrum von ABB in der Nähe von Zürich konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung und Herstellung innovativer Materialien, die in die zukünftigen Produkte des Unternehmens integriert werden sollen. Wir bieten derzeit herausragenden Studierenden die Möglichkeit, sich unserem multidisziplinären Forscherteam auf dem Gebiet der Metall-, Verbundwerkstoff- und Polymerwerkstoffe anzuschließen.

Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Mara Werne, Talent Partner bei ABB Schweiz, Ltd.

Wenn Sie mehr über ABB erfahren möchten, werfen Sie einen weiteren Blick auf unsere Website www.abb.com.

Gestionnaire d'équipe de recherche - Matériel

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la possibilité d'acquérir une expérience professionnelle grâce à un stage temporaire. Chaque jour, vous acquerrez des connaissances en accomplissant les tâches comme indiqué. Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Contribuer aux projets de développement technologique actuels axés sur les polymères thermoplastiques et thermorésistants durables
  • Optimiser les conditions de traitement et de traitement des matériaux à l'échelle du laboratoire

  • Exercer des expériences de recyclage des polymères pour permettre une économie de polymères circulaire

  • Les connaissances fondamentales en polymères sont avantageuses
  • Expérience dans le travail en laboratoire et le savoir-faire en méthodes expérimentales
  • Maîtrise motivée et automotivée et capacité de travailler de façon indépendante

Ce qu'il y a dedans pour vous

Chaque idée que vous partagez et chaque action que vous prenez contribue à quelque chose de plus grand. En savoir plus sur nous

ABB Corporate Research, en étroite collaboration avec ses différents secteurs d'activité, développe les bases de la prochaine génération de produits ABB.

L'équipe Matériaux du centre de recherche suisse d'ABBS à proximité de Zurich se concentre sur le développement et la fabrication de matériaux innovants à mettre en œuvre dans les futurs produits de la société. Nous offrons actuellement aux étudiants exceptionnels la possibilité de rejoindre notre équipe multidisciplinaire de chercheurs dans le domaine des matériaux métalliques, composites et polymères.

Le processus de recrutement est dirigé par Mara Werne, Talent Partner chez ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Materials

__

Your role and responsibilities:
In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain vocational experience through a temporary work placement. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing personal education/employment opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Materials team at the ABB corporate research center in Switzerland. In the frame of a six-month internship scheduled to start in July or August 2026, you will be able to put theory into practice by contributing to our projects related to future energy technologies.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • You will significantly contribute to our current research projects focusing on metals, alloys, and metal matrix composites as well as the associated manufacturing processes for ABB's innovative switchgear products
  • You prepare alloys and metal matrix composites and optimize their manufacturing processes on the lab-scale
  • You analyze materials and engineering prototypes using metallographic preparation, optical microscopy and other techniques to obtain a good understanding of the relationship between process parameters, microstructure, and material performance
  • You evaluate the obtained data, document your findings and present them to the team

You will join a highly motivated and multidisciplinary team that is passionate about materials, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • You currently pursue a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Science/Engineering or a related discipline (completion of at least six semesters); official enrollment is essential
  • You have a general understanding of metals and metal matrix composite materials and the related processing technologies, and you are keen in deepening your knowledge in this field
  • You have experience in specimen preparation by metallography, microstructure analysis by light microscopy and you enjoy laboratory work
  • Experience in powder metallurgy, sintering, brazing, know-how in experimental methods (XRD, SEM, EDX, EBSD, Hardness, etc.) is an advantage
  • Fluent command of English, both written and spoken; German is a plus

What's in it for you

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products.

The Materials team at ABB’s Swiss research center in the proximity of Zurich focuses on the development and manufacturing of innovative materials to be implemented in the company’s future products. We are currently offering outstanding students the chance to join our multidisciplinary team of researchers in the field of metallic, composite and polymer materials.

The recruiting process is being led by Mara Werne, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Be part of something bigger. This is where progress is powered, teams initiate action, and we move the world forward together. Run What Runs the World.

Ce poste relève de :

Gestionnaire d'équipe de recherche - Matériel

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités:
Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la possibilité d'acquérir une expérience professionnelle grâce à un stage temporaire. Chaque jour, vous acquerrez des connaissances en accomplissant les tâches comme indiqué. Vous présenterez également votre expertise en soutenant les opérations d'ABB et en améliorant les possibilités d'éducation/d'emploi personnelles.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-Onsite

Ce rôle contribue à l'équipe Matériaux du centre de recherche d'ABB en Suisse. Dans le cadre d'un stage de six mois qui doit débuter en juillet ou août 2026, vous pourrez mettre la théorie en pratique en contribuant à nos projets liés aux technologies énergétiques futures.


Vous serez principalement responsable de :

  • Vous contribuerez de façon significative à nos projets de recherche actuels axés sur les métaux, les alliages et les composites à matrice métallique ainsi que sur les procédés de fabrication associés aux produits de commutation innovants d'ABB
  • Vous préparez des alliages et des composites à matrice métallique et optimisez leurs processus de fabrication à l'échelle du laboratoire
  • Vous analysez les matériaux et les prototypes d'ingénierie à l'aide de la préparation métallographique, de la microscopie optique et d'autres techniques afin d'obtenir une bonne compréhension de la relation entre les paramètres du procédé, la microstructure et la performance du matériau
  • Vous évaluez les données obtenues, documentez vos constatations et les présentez à l'équipe

Vous rejoindrez une équipe très motivée et multidisciplinaire qui est passionnée par le matériel, où vous serez en mesure de prospérer.


• Qualifications pour le rôle:

  • Vous suivez actuellement un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en sciences des matériaux/ingénierie ou une discipline connexe (achèvement d'au moins six semestres); l'inscription officielle est essentielle
    • Vous avez une compréhension générale des métaux et des matériaux composites à matrice métallique et des technologies de traitement connexes, et vous êtes désireux d'approfondir vos connaissances dans ce domaine
  • Vous avez de l'expérience dans la préparation de spécimens par métallographie, l'analyse de microstructure par microscopie légère et vous appréciez les travaux de laboratoire
  • L'expérience de la métallurgie des poudres, du frittage, du brasage, du savoir-faire en méthodes expérimentales (XRD, SEM, EDX, EBSD, Hardness, etc.) est un avantage
  • La maîtrise de l'anglais, à la fois écrite et parlée; l'allemand est un plus

Ce qu'il y a dedans pour vous

Nous vous donnons les moyens de prendre des initiatives, de contester les idées et de diriger avec confiance. Vous grandirez grâce à un travail significatif, l'apprentissage continu et le soutien qui est adapté à vos objectifs. Chaque idée que vous partagez et chaque action que vous prenez contribue à quelque chose de plus grand. En savoir plus sur nous

ABB Corporate Research, en étroite collaboration avec ses différents secteurs d'activité, développe les bases de la prochaine génération de produits ABB.

L'équipe Matériaux du centre de recherche suisse d'ABBS à proximité de Zurich se concentre sur le développement et la fabrication de matériaux innovants à mettre en œuvre dans les futurs produits de la société. Nous offrons actuellement aux étudiants exceptionnels la possibilité de rejoindre notre équipe multidisciplinaire de chercheurs dans le domaine des matériaux métalliques, composites et polymères.

Le processus de recrutement est dirigé par Mara Werne, Talent Partner chez ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

Si vous voulez en savoir plus sur ABB, consultez notre site Web www.abb.com

C'est là que les progrès sont activés, que les équipes commencent à agir et que nous faisons avancer le monde ensemble. Lancer What Runs the World.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons les gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop and implement people strategy through the execution of HR processes. Each day, you will provide HR support for a defined team or location, by partnering with respective managers. You will also showcase your HR skills by representing HR in the business and establishing close relationships with all business leaders and employees.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the local Motion Market and Factory Teams in Switzerland. Reporting to the lead division manager, additional important main stakeholders are other Local Division Managers, department and team leaders, as well as the HR community in Switzerland and beyond.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Ensuring an effective overall HR contribution and value-add to the business in partnership with the functions and Shared Services.

  • Supporting the business and the execution of HR processes involved across the end-to-end employee lifecycle by determining and delivering the most effective approach in the area of responsibility and executing the HR priorities while adding value to the business.

  • Partnering with respective managers to develop and implement people strategies.

  • Facilitating change management initiatives and supporting behavior change & continuous improvement across the respective business area / area of responsibility.

  • Support and contribution of Country HR Projects as well as Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in human resources, especially from an international company

  • Knowledge of the Labor Code and employment law

  • Solid business acumen with a customer-focused mindset which will enable you to align HR strategies with organizational goals.

  • Deep understanding of employee relations, coaching methods, investigations, and labor practices. Demonstrated ability to build relationships and collaborate with people at all levels of the organization.

  • Ability to handle several tasks and prioritize in a demanding environment.

  • You are at ease communicating in German and English, French and any other language in addition is a plus

Benefits

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

Gestionnaire de division locale

  • En assurant une contribution et une valeur ajoutée efficaces aux RH dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, en partenariat avec les fonctions et les services partagés.

  • Soutien et contribution des projets de RH par pays ainsi que des initiatives de diversité et d'inclusion

  • Baccalauréat en ressources humaines, en administration des affaires, en psychologie ou dans un domaine connexe; Master est un plus.

À ABB, nous ne faisons que faire bouger les industries — nous les rendons plus maigres et plus propres. descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Head of Strategy and Business Intelligence, Motion

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

As part of our strategic growth agenda, we are hiring a new Strategy Manager for our Motion Business Area.

This role is open globally, with preferred locations near our main Motion hubs in Switzerland, Spain, Germany, and Italy. The work model is hybrid #LIhybrid.

This role aims at strengthening our Motion Business Area’s strategy capability by driving strategic analyses, projects, and narratives that inform senior leadership decision-making. It is designed for a strategy professional who can operate with autonomy, lead strategic workstreams end to end, and translate insights into clear, compelling, and leadership-ready outputs.

The role will collaborate closely with the Motion Leadership Team, Divisions, and key Business Area functions such as M&A, Ventures, Finance, and Sustainability. It will contribute both to core strategy processes and to forward-looking strategic topics, including new growth areas and long-term opportunities.

This role reports to our global Head of Strategy & Business Intelligence, Motion.

Key • Responsibilities

Strategic studies, deep dives & projects

  • Support strategic studies and deep dives, either as standalone projects such as long-term market or technology opportunities, or in close collaboration with Divisions.

  • Structure and deliver strategic projects by defining scope, driving execution with limited supervision, and supporting topics from ideation through analysis to leadership readout and follow-up.

External market & growth opportunity screening

  • Screen external markets, technologies, and competitive dynamics to inform Motion’s strategic priorities, in close collaboration with the Business Intelligence team.

  • Identify and assess new growth opportunities, including Horizon 3 topics, emerging sectors, geographies, and business models.

  • Synthesize external insights into clear implications for Motion’s strategy and portfolio.

Strategic deliverables & leadership narratives

  • Support strategic deliverables for Motion by shaping clear, insight-driven narratives for the Motion Leadership Team, internal stakeholders, and selected external audiences.

  • Translate analyses into concise, strategic, and decision-oriented presentations.

  • Ensure a high standard of storyline, logic, and messaging across all strategy-related outputs.

M&A and portfolio support (strategy perspective)

  • Support M&A and portfolio topics from a strategic perspective, primarily at the Motion Business Area level.

  • Contribute to commercial and strategic assessments for Motion-led deals, including market attractiveness, strategic fit, and value creation logic.

  • Prepare strategy-focused materials for internal reviews and decision forums.

• Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in relevant fields

  • Several years of experience in strategy, management consulting, corporate development, business intelligence, or a related strategic role

  • Strong strategic thinking & synthesis: Ability to frame problems, structure analyses, and articulate clear strategic implications

  • Independent content creation: Proven ability to build high‑quality presentations and strategic documents with minimal coaching; Excellent PowerPoint and report‑writing skills; able to simplify complex topics into Leadership‑ready material

  • Communication & storytelling: Able to consolidate diverse viewpoints and challenge assumptions constructively

  • Cross‑functional collaboration: Experience working effectively in decentralized organization with multitude of stakeholders to align data, insights, and strategic narratives

  • Proactive mindset & ownership: Demonstrates initiative, curiosity, and a strong sense of accountability; Pushes topics forward and delivers on commitments, even under time pressure

  • Agility & resilience: Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a dynamic, senior‑stakeholder environment

  • M&A exposure: Prior exposure to portfolio topics and strategy‑led deal support is a plus

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit careers.abb to learn more about us and discover the impact of our solutions around the world.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Senior Engineer

__

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products. We would like to give a motivated student an opportunity to complete a six-month internship with a multidisciplinary team at the Sensing and Analytics group of ABB.

At ABB, we envisioned future marine and port operations that are safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. To realize this future, we are developing advanced technological solutions that are based on various sensing modalities.

During this internship, you will have an opportunity to work on different aspects of a system for marine and port automation. The focus is on machine learning algorithms. You will work with synthetic and real-world data from various sensors (e.g., camera or LiDAR).

Your role and responsibilities

  • Exploration of current challenges in Marine or Ports via direct interaction with ABB R&D units

  • Review of academic literature

  • Design, evaluation and documentation of potential solutions

  • Quick prototyping of solutions through proof-of-concept implementations

• Qualifications for the role

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology or similar field; enrollment to 5th semester or higher is essential

  • Interest in at least one of the following fields: data analytics, machine learning, computer vision

  • Experience with Python and PyTorch is required. Experience with ROS2 and/or LiDAR is a plus

  • Proficiency in English

  • Willingness to learn and quickly adapt to new research topics

  • Self-motivation and hands-on attitude

  • Ability to think conceptually and express ideas clearly and convincingly

  • Availability for six months (start and end dates are open for discussion)

Application Details:

Non-EU/EFTA citizens, please note that a certificate from your university, showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies, is required for the visa application.

More about us

Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification

We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruiting process is being led by Mara Werne, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Call to action

Be part of something bigger. This is where progress is powered, teams initiate action, and we move the world forward together. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This Position reports to:
Maintenance Team Leader

Your Role and
• Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the maintenance team by carrying out daily activities in accordance with agreed maintenance guidelines and procedures. You will contribute your technical skills to increase the overall efficiency of equipment and production lines across our highly automated machinery landscape.

Work model: Onsite

This position supports the Electrification, Smart Buildings, Energy Distribution business in Schaffhausen.

Your
• Responsibilities

-
Diagnosing and resolving mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic issues on equipment within our diverse and highly automated machinery park

-
Performing preventive maintenance and servicing of production equipment

-
Working closely with production cells as well as collaborating with Production Engineering and external service providers

-
Contributing to and implementing continuous improvement initiatives within the production environment

-
Supporting improvements in Lean Management practices

Your
• Qualifications

-
Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician, mechatronics technician, polymechanic, production mechanic, electrician, or a comparable technical qualification

-
At least 10 years of experience diagnosing and repairing production and assembly equipment (mechanical / electrical / pneumatic)

-
NIV13 or NIV15 installation authorization is an advantage, or willingness to obtain it (costs covered by ABB)

-
Engages constructively with coworkers, communicates clearly, maintains high motivation, and organizes work without close supervision

-
Basic knowledge of MS Office and SAP

-
Fluent German skills; basic English skills are an advantage

-
Willingness to work in a 3‑shift system with on‑call duty after an intensive onboarding period

Benefits

• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

-
Salary and bonus structure that includes a 13th‑month payment and participation in an employee share program (ESAP)

-
Professional development through targeted training and career advancement opportunities

-
Sustainability and mobility benefits: eco‑bonus for employees who do not commute by car

-
Discounts such as REKA checks, Swibeco benefits, and access to Felfel food vending machines

More About Us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Partner Mara Werne .

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Marketing & Sales Manager

__


Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop an effective division sales strategy within a regional market scope (Europe) and maintain it, to improve ABB’s market penetration and realize growth aspirations. Each day, you will define, plan, lead, and ensure the execution of sales strategy to achieve both qualitative and quantitative sales targets for products, systems, and/or services to ensure sustainable order growth, revenue, profitability, market share, sales productivity, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your expertise by leading, developing, and coaching the Sales organization (other sales managers and sales specialists within scope) to achieve the sales targets through high performance.

The work model for the role is: hybrid (#LI-hybrid)

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Defining sales targets, establishing performance metrics, and monitoring performance to ensure target achievement

  • Identifying and developing opportunities with existing and potential customers, including resource planning and execution

  • Supporting pricing decisions and ensuring alignment with market levels in collaboration with Product Management

  • Managing risks related to contracts, customers, and financial exposure, while supporting compliance with internal standards and policies

• Qualifications for the role:

  • You have experience in developing and executing sales strategies in a B2B environment involving products, systems, and/or services

  • You demonstrate a strong track record in achieving sales targets and driving business performance

  • You bring experience in leading, coaching, and developing sales teams

  • You are comfortable working with performance metrics and implementing corrective actions where needed

  • You have experience in customer engagement, including opportunity development and participation in contract-related activities

  • You hold a degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or bring equivalent practical experience

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Lead Power Systems Architect_Data Center Incubator

We are looking for a Lead Power Systems Architect to join our Direct Current Data Center Incubator, where you will play a pivotal role in accelerating the transition to next‑generation Direct Current data center architectures.

This is a high‑visibility, highly strategic role at the intersection of technology innovation, customer solutions, and industry leadership. You will lead the Direct Current Architecture Workstream, translating customer needs into robust, scalable, and future‑ready technical solutions, while working in close partnership with peers leading LVDC Distribution and Direct Current Source workstreams.

If you are passionate about redefining how data centers are powered, and want to influence standards, roadmaps, and real‑world deployments, this role offers a rare opportunity to make a lasting impact.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

Key • Responsibilities

As Lead Power Systems Architect, you will:

  • Own the technical direction of Direct Current architecture solutions for data centers, with a strong focus on safety, efficiency, scalability, and reliability.

  • Design end‑to‑end Direct Current power systems, from concept to pilot and deployment, combining current product portfolios with future technologies.

  • Design advanced control strategies,

  • Define testing strategies and validation plans, ensuring solutions are robust, compliant, and ready for customer deployment.

  • Serve as a technical authority and thought leader, contributing to standards bodies and industry working groups shaping the future of Direct Current data centers.

  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with engineering, product management, and system teams to identify technology gaps and influence product and platform roadmaps.

  • Lead customer pilot projects and installations, defining the skills, capabilities, and resources required for successful execution.

• Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.

  • 5+ years of experience in power system design, consulting, or solution architecture.

  • Strong expertise in data center power systems and/or DC power solutions.

  • Experience in adjacent environments such as industrial DC systems, marine, rail, or utility applications is highly valued.

  • Proven ability to deliver complex, high‑impact technical solutions.

  • Solid technical foundation in electrical power systems, including switchgear, transformers, protection, and control systems.

  • Leadership & Mindset

  • Experience leading (directly or indirectly) multidisciplinary teams in complex technical environments.

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to balance long‑term vision and near‑term execution.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder‑management skills across cultures and geographies.

  • Comfortable operating in fast‑evolving, innovation‑driven environments.

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products. We would like to give a motivated student an opportunity to complete a six-month internship with a multidisciplinary team at the Energy Storage group of ABB.

At ABB, we envision integration of Energy Storage systems for reliable and sustainable electrical mobility applications as well as for the power grids of the future. To realize this vision, we are developing advanced technological solutions that are based on various battery cell chemistries.

As an intern, you will contribute to advanced research projects in battery technology and advanced manufacturing.

• Your responsibilities will include:

  • Polymer Additive Manufacturing (3D Printing):
  • Operate and support polymer 3D printing processes using state‑of‑the‑art industrial-grade equipment for prototyping and functional components.
  • Development of Battery Test Setups:
  • Assist in the design, development, and assembly of battery test systems. This includes practical work such as designing innovative cell holders, building fixtures, and supporting laser-welding jig development.
  • Testing Operations & Data Analysis:
  • Support test maintenance, launch activities, and experimental campaigns. Collect, process, and analyze test data to contribute to research outcomes.
  • Battery Safety Testing Preparation:
  • Assist in the preparation of battery safety tests, including setup and integration of sensing and measurement equipment.
  • Research Support on Novel Battery Concepts:
  • Contribute to ongoing research activities focused on next-generation battery technologies, including experimental validation and documentation.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Currently pursuing a Master`s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or similar field
  • Interest in battery energy storage & state of the art technologies
  • Experience with CAD and additive manufacturing is required. Already maturated practical experience in a lab setting and working knowledge of Python is preferred
  • Proficiency in English
  • Willingness to learn and explore new research topics
  • Committed to learning and taking initiative
  • Ability to think conceptually and express ideas clearly and convincingly
  • Availability for six months (start and end dates are open for discussion)

Application Details:

Non-EU/EFTA citizens, please note that a certificate from your university, showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies, is required for the visa application.

More about us

Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification

We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruiting process is being led by Mara Werne, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Joignez-vous à nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

R&D Team Lead

AB Corporate Research, en étroite collaboration avec ses différents secteurs d'activité, développe les bases de la prochaine génération de produits ABB. Nous aimerions donner à un étudiant motivé l'occasion de terminer un stage de six mois avec une équipe multidisciplinaire au sein du groupe Energy Storage d'ABB.

Chez ABB, nous envisageons l'intégration de systèmes de stockage d'énergie pour des applications de mobilité électrique fiables et durables ainsi que pour les réseaux électriques du futur. Pour réaliser cette vision, nous développons des solutions technologiques de pointe basées sur diverses chimies des piles à piles.

En tant que stagiaire, vous contribuerez à des projets de recherche de pointe dans le domaine de la technologie des piles et de la fabrication de pointe.

  • Fabrication d'additifs au polymer (3D) :
  • Exploiter et soutenir des procédés d'impression 3D en polymère à l'aide d'équipements de qualité industrielle de pointe pour le prototypage et les composants fonctionnels.
  • Développement de systèmes d'essai de batterie:
  • Aider à la conception, au développement et à l'assemblage des systèmes d'essai de batterie. Cela comprend des travaux pratiques comme la conception de porte-cellules innovateurs, l'installation de bâtiments et l'élaboration de gabarits de soudure laser.
  • Testing Operations & Data Analysis:
  • Soutenir la maintenance des essais, les activités de lancement et les campagnes expérimentales. Recueillir, traiter et analyser les données d'essai afin de contribuer aux résultats de la recherche.
  • Préparation des tests d'innocuité des batteries:
  • Aider à la préparation des essais de sécurité de la batterie, y compris l'installation et l'intégration de l'équipement de détection et de mesure.
  • Appui à la recherche sur les concepts nouveaux de batterie:
  • Contribuer aux activités de recherche continues axées sur les technologies de la batterie de prochaine génération, y compris la validation expérimentale et la documentation.

• Qualifications pour le rôle :

  • Maîtrise en génie mécanique, en génie électrique ou dans un domaine semblable
  • Intérêt pour le stockage de l'énergie des batteries et les technologies de pointe
  • L'expérience de la fabrication de CAO et d'additifs est requise. L'expérience pratique déjà mûrie dans un laboratoire et les connaissances de travail de Python sont préférées
  • Profiabilité en anglais
  • Convenance d'apprendre et d'explorer de nouveaux sujets de recherche
  • Engagé à apprendre et à prendre des initiatives
  • Capacité de penser conceptuellement et d'exprimer des idées clairement et de façon convaincante
  • Disponibilité pendant six mois (les dates de début et de fin sont ouvertes à la discussion)

Détails de la demande :

Un certificat de votre université, montrant qu'un stage est une partie obligatoire de vos études, est requis pour la demande de visa.

Plus à propos de nous

L'électrification fournit des technologies, des solutions et des services de distribution et de gestion électriques de pointe pour électrifier le monde de manière sûre, intelligente et durable. La gamme comprend des composants électriques à moyenne et basse tension, des appareils de commutation, des appareils numériques, des boîtiers et des disjoncteurs, entre autres. Avec nos produits, solutions et services, nous collaborons avec nos clients pour améliorer la fourniture d'électricité et la sécurité, améliorer la gestion de l'énergie, l'efficacité et la fiabilité opérationnelle, alors que nous cherchons à atteindre une société à faible teneur en carbone. go.abb/electrification

The Salesforce Solution Architect for Marketing & Sales will play a critical role in shaping ABB’s Salesforce platform, ensuring scalable, secure, and high‑quality solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and long‑term platform strategy. This role partners closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and delivery teams to translate business needs into sustainable technical solutions while minimizing technical debt and maximizing solution reuse.

This is a global role and the working model is: Hybrid / Remote.

You will be mainly accountable for:

- Lead architectural governance, design reviews, and technical decision forums while promoting Salesforce best practices and standardization

- Mentor developers and technical teams, supporting DevOps practices (CI/CD, release management) and driving continuous improvement across the platform

- Support demand prioritization and solution feasibility discussions, advising stakeholders on architectural trade‑offs and long‑term impacts

- Relevant Salesforce certification is highly desirable (Salesforce Certified Administrator / Advanced Administrator / Salesforce Application Architect and/or System Architect / Salesforce Data Architect, Integration Architect, and Identity & Access Management Architect / Salesforce Platform Developer I & II / Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud Consultant / Salesforce Experience Cloud Consultant / Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist / Salesforce JavaScript Developer Certification

- Proven experience delivering large-scale, enterprise Salesforce implementations within complex, global environments.

- Deep expertise in Salesforce architecture, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Marketing Cloud / Account Engagement

- Strong hands‑on technical experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, APIs, integrations, and Salesforce security architecture

- Solid understanding of integration patterns ( REST, events, middleware such as MuleSoft), DevOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines

- Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills, with the ability to bridge business and technical perspectives

- Ability to operate effectively in Agile environments and balance short‑term delivery with long‑term platform strategy

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Head of Assurance, Risk and Internal Controls (ARIC)

__

ABB's Data & Systems Modernization (DSM) Program is a multi-years, company-wide initiative to modernize and harmonize ABB's data and systems landscape. DSM aims to simplify complexity, improve governance and data quality, and enable a common roadmap for enterprise platforms and ERP evolution, supporting better, faster decision-making and scalable operations across regions, functions, and business areas.

The Program Assurance, Risks and Internal Controls Lead is accountable for defining, governing, and overseeing the assurance, risk, internal controls, across the end-to-end data and systems modernization program. Primary goal for the Program IC lead is to support the maintenance of the same level of assurance within the DSM program. The role ensures that risks are identified within the program as per the milestones of the program and mitigated through internal controls where necessary.

The lead ensures also the program runs by respecting the ABB assurance governance and framework. Additionally, the lead identifies opportunities for further streamlining the IC framework through the SAP S/4HANA implementation.

This role acts as the single point of accountability at program level for assurance, risk, and controls, working in close partnership with internal controls and compliance leads in the business areas, processes and global functions (e.g. Finance, HR, IT) to ensure consistency, transparency, and audit readiness.

Your
• Responsibilities

-
Own the program-wide framework for assurance, risk, and internal controls, aligned with ABB policies, regulatory requirements, and internal governance standards, including the ARIC Handbook

-
Lead the IC SMEs team to deliver the future‑state internal control and GRC design for SAP S/4HANA, including manual and automated controls

-
Coordinate and align IT, business area and process internal controls & compliance leads, ensuring consistent implementation of controls, roles, and access governance across ABB

-
Act as the primary interface to Internal Audit, external auditors, and corporate assurance functions, supporting audit readiness, stage‑gate decisions, and timely remediation of findings

-
Report regularly to program governance bodies on risk exposure, control design maturity, authorization readiness, and remediation progress

-
Provide regular reporting and insights to program governance bodies on control maturity, risks, and remediation progress

Your Background

-
10+ years of experience in assurance, risk management, and internal controls within large, complex, multinational organizations

-
Experience with ERP transformation programs, including SAP S/4HANA

-
Experience working in a Big 4 accounting firm with exposure to SOX and ERP transformation projects preferrable

-
Solid knowledge of IT General Controls (ITGCs), Automated Control environments (ITACs)

-
Demonstrated skill in collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders without formal managerial authority

-
Experience operating at the intersection of Business, IT, and Risk, with a solid governance and transformation mindset

-
Structured, pragmatic approach with the ability to balance compliance requirements and business enablement

-
Highly effective communicator with the credibility and presence to work well with program leadership and business stakeholders

-
Candidates must be eligible to work in Switzerland. Visa sponsorship is not offered for this position.

Join us to play a pivotal role in building a future-ready enterprise, where robust controls and smart governance enable sustainable transformation at scale.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

A l'ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus propre, et chaque personne ici fait que cela arrive. Ce poste relève de : Responsable de l'assurance, des risques et des contrôles internes (ARIC) Le Programme de modernisation des données et des systèmes d'ABB (DSM) est une initiative pluriannuelle visant à moderniser et à harmoniser le paysage des données et des systèmes d'ABB. DSM vise à simplifier la complexité, à améliorer la gouvernance et la qualité des données, et à permettre une feuille de route commune pour les plates-formes d'entreprise et l'évolution des ERP, en soutenant une meilleure prise de décision et des opérations évolutives dans les régions, les fonctions et les secteurs d'activité. Le responsable de l'assurance des programmes, des risques et des contrôles internes est responsable de la définition, de la gouvernance et de la surveillance de l'assurance, des risques et des contrôles internes dans l'ensemble du programme de modernisation des données et des systèmes de bout en bout. Le principal objectif du responsable du programme IC est d'appuyer le maintien du même niveau d'assurance dans le cadre du programme GSM. Le rôle consiste à veiller à ce que les risques soient identifiés dans le programme conformément aux étapes du programme et atténués par des contrôles internes, au besoin. Le responsable assure également le fonctionnement du programme en respectant la gouvernance et le cadre d'assurance ABB. En outre, le chef de file identifie les possibilités de rationaliser davantage le cadre d'IC grâce à la mise en œuvre du SAP S/4HANA. Ce rôle sert de point unique de responsabilisation au niveau du programme en ce qui concerne l'assurance, les risques et les contrôles, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les contrôles internes et la conformité, dirige les secteurs d'activité, les processus et les fonctions globales (p. ex. Finances, RH, TI) pour assurer l'uniformité, la transparence et la préparation à la vérification.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs.
