At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: President Traction Division __ At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner . Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world . A s part of our ambitious growth, we are hiring a new Global Business Line Manager, for our Traction Products business line , part of our Motion Traction Division . This role is open globally, and preferred location s are set close to our main Traction locations in Switzerland, Germany, Italy, Sweden, France, Poland. As Global Business Line Manager, Traction Products, you will hold end-to-end accountability for a uniquely positioned and strategically critical product portfolio spanning Traction Motors, Energy Storage Systems (ESS), Auxiliary Converters, and DC-DC Converters. This is a pivotal enterprise leadership role with responsibility for shaping the future of the product business within the division, advancing commercial excellence, and delivering sustainable, profitable growth across global markets. Reporting directly to the Division President, you will lead a geographically diverse organization and set the strategic direction for the end-to-end Traction Products business line across its four Product Lines: Traction Motors, Energy Storage Solutions (ESS), Auxiliary Converters, and Brightloop . You will steer the full value chain , from the performance and direction of Product Line-owned factories and embedded capabilities such as R&D, Engineering, and Product Management to commercial execution , while accelerating growth, strengthening customer relevance, and building long-term competitive advantage globally. Key
• Responsibilities - Own full P&L accountability for the Global Traction Products business line, driving sustainable growth, profitability, and cash performance. - Lead the strategic evolution and scaling of a competitive product portfolio across motors, ESS, DC-DC converters, and auxiliary systems, strengthening value propositions and market positioning across target segments. - Set clear accountability across Product Lines for factories, product management, and engineering, while ensuring alignment with business line priorities and enterprise objectives . - Define and execute global go-to-market strategies that expand market share, reinforce pricing discipline, and deepen customer intimacy across segments and regions. - Establish and drive performance targets that promote a culture of quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the organization. - Champion high-impact marketing, sales, and customer engagement strategies that elevate market presence and accelerate growth. - Strengthen relationships with key customers and OEMs, positioning ABB as the partner of choice for traction and onboard energy solutions. - Lead the successful integration of acquired entities into ABB, realizing targeted value creation, synergies, and organizational alignment. - Ensure best-in-class operational performance across manufacturing, supply chain, quality, delivery, and HSE, aligned with ABB’s standards and business ambitions. - Build and develop high-performing, values -driven teams through coaching, talent development, and robust succession planning.
• Qualifications - Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering , Business Administration, or related field. - Proven success leading global business lines or holding significant P&L responsibility within industrial, rail, mobility, or comparable sectors. - Strong strategic and commercial acumen, with a demonstrated ability to scale complex product portfolios and translate strategy into measurable business results. - Experience leading multi-product, technology-driven businesses with a manufacturing footprint and end-to-end operational accountability. - Demonstrated ability to lead a Product Line–driven operating model with distributed ownership, embedded capabilities, and strong enterprise alignment. - Strong understanding of customer ecosystems across multiple industries, with the ability to anticipate market shifts and shape competitive positioning. - Proven leadership of large, cross-regional organizations, with the ability to align diverse teams around a shared vision and performance agenda. - Track record of delivering results in fast-paced environments with complex operational structures, balancing speed, rigor, and execution excellence. - Experience in M&A and integration, ideally with direct leadership in integration programs and delivery of targeted value creation. - High personal integrity and a strong commitment to ABB’s values, ethics, and compliance standards, serving as a role model for principled leadership. - Skilled in leading change and transformation, while fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and organizational resilience. - Adept at stakeholder management, with strong communication and influencing skills at executive, board, and cross-functional leadership levels. - Passion for people, customers, quality, and technology, with a leadership mindset grounded in impact and long-term value creation. - Ability to develop people and lead with clarity, purpose, and consistency. #ABBCareers #RunwithABB #Runwhatrunstheworld ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb /motion We value people from different backgrounds . Could this be your story? Apply today or visit careers.abb to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Head of R&D and Life Cycle Management


Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will oversee the global manufacturability, quality, and cost optimization of service products within your scope, with focus on LCI. You will play a key role in shaping product development by aligning with product managers on roadmap execution, defining and prioritizing tasks that reflect business needs. Your technical skills, combined with close collaboration across Motion Service and Motion High Power teams, will be essential in advancing solutions.

As a technical partner, you will act as the primary contact for market-facing product management and other stakeholders such as engineering and operations, supporting them on product-related topics and ensuring smooth coordination across functions.


The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid


This role is contributing to the Business Line Medium Voltage Drives in Motion Service.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Managing and prioritizing product-related tasks, ensuring smooth execution and delivery. This includes gathering input from various teams, making decisions on minor topics, consulting stakeholders for complex ones, and maintaining all relevant documentation.
  • Overseeing the product lifecycle in alignment with strategic goals, including proactive obsolescence management, assessing the impact of standard changes, and maintaining service-specific tools in collaboration with compliance and portfolio teams.
  • Contributing to service R&D projects and support the transition of service products through their release phases. You’ll also help evaluate engineered solutions and collaborate with product management to decide when to productize.
  • Supporting sales and operations by clarifying technical questions, assisting with technical solution agreements (TSAs), and reviewing complex engineered solutions to ensure they align with product strategy and customer needs.


• Qualifications for the role

  • You have a degree in electrical or power engineering, or a similar field such as mechanical engineering (M.Sc. or B.Sc.), and enjoy applying your knowledge in industrial settings.
  • You have 5+ years of experience in the industrial sector, within the power energy field, and 2-3 years of experience in functionally leading small engineering teams.
  • You are highly skilled in ABB products, supported by internal training, and possess an understanding of product lifecycle and documentation processes.
  • You are motivated by collaboration and communication, a team player who is well-organized, with a high sense of responsibility, and a commitment to safety and integrity.
  • You are fluent in English, and communicating effectively in a multicultural environment; German language skills are a plus.


More about us

ABB Motion Service Division serves customers worldwide by maximizing uptime, extending product life cycle and enhancing the performance and energy efficiency of their electrical motion solutions. The Division is advancing digitalization by securely connecting motors and drives, increasing operational uptime and improving efficiency. The services offered make the difference for our customers and partners every day by helping keep their operations running profitably, safely and reliably.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). The recruiting process is being led by Azra Filan, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Leiter F&E und Life Cycle Management

In dieser Funktion beaufsichtigen Sie die globale Herstellbarkeit, Qualität und Kostenoptimierung von Serviceprodukten in Ihrem Bereich mit Schwerpunkt auf LCI. Diese Rolle trägt zum Business Line Medium Voltage Drives in Motion Service bei.

Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich sein für:

  • Verwalten und Priorisieren von produktbezogenen Aufgaben, um eine reibungslose Ausführung und Lieferung zu gewährleisten. Dazu gehören das Sammeln von Input aus verschiedenen Teams, das Treffen von Entscheidungen zu kleineren Themen, die Beratung von Stakeholdern für komplexe Themen und die Pflege aller relevanten Dokumentationen.
  • Überwachung des Produktlebenszyklus in Übereinstimmung mit strategischen Zielen, einschließlich eines proaktiven Obsoleszenzmanagements, der Bewertung der Auswirkungen von Standardänderungen und der Pflege servicespezifischer Tools in Zusammenarbeit mit Compliance- und Portfolioteams.

  • Unterstützung von Vertrieb und Betrieb durch Klärung technischer Fragen, Unterstützung bei technischen Lösungsvereinbarungen (TSAs) und Überprüfung komplexer technischer Lösungen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie mit der Produktstrategie und den Kundenbedürfnissen übereinstimmen.


• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Sie haben einen Abschluss in Elektro- oder Energietechnik oder einem ähnlichen Bereich wie Maschinenbau (M.Sc. oder B.Sc.) und genießen es, Ihr Wissen in industriellen Umgebungen anzuwenden.
  • Sie haben mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Industriesektor, im Energiebereich und 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung in der funktionalen Führung kleiner Ingenieurteams.
  • Sie sind hochqualifiziert in ABB-Produkten, unterstützt durch interne Schulungen und besitzen ein Verständnis für den Produktlebenszyklus und die Dokumentationsprozesse.
  • Sie sind motiviert durch Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation, einen Teamplayer, der gut organisiert ist, mit einem hohen Verantwortungsbewusstsein und einer Verpflichtung zu Sicherheit und Integrität.
  • Sie sprechen fließend Englisch und kommunizieren effektiv in einem multikulturellen Umfeld; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.


Mehr über uns

ABB Motion Service Division bedient Kunden weltweit, indem sie die Verfügbarkeit maximieren, den Produktlebenszyklus verlängern und die Leistung und Energieeffizienz ihrer elektrischen Bewegungslösungen verbessern. Die angebotenen Dienstleistungen machen den Unterschied für unsere Kunden und Partner jeden Tag, indem sie helfen, ihren Betrieb profitabel, sicher und zuverlässig laufen zu lassen.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Govt Relations & Public Affairs Mgr.

__

Your role and responsibilities:

As part of ABB’s Group Government Relations & Public Affairs (GRPA) team, you will support the development and execution of ABB’s global GRPA strategy. You will contribute to high-level advocacy with policymakers, advance strategic partnerships with external stakeholders, and support senior leadership visibility on key public policy platforms. The role reports to the Director of Policy and Partnerships and is based in Zurich.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

-
Stakeholder engagement, partnerships and advocacy : Support engagement on priority policy topics with governments, international organizations, trade associations, and industry platforms. Contribute to stakeholder mapping, prepare briefings and messaging, organize meetings and events, and manage follow-up actions. Support the strategic direction and day-to-day management of public affairs partnerships, and represent ABB’s policy positions in external fora and internal cross-functional teams.

-

This position reports to:
R&D Manager Critical Power

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute your creativity and technical knowledge to the development of new and innovative solutions. You will be responsible for product development in the field of high-performance miniature circuit breakers, including conducting preliminary studies, planning, evaluating and developing key product features that require broad technical knowledge

The working model for the role is: onsite

They are mainly responsible for:

-
Coordinate tasks involving employees from other departments to investigate problems, develop solutions, and make recommendations in the role of senior engineer or project manager

-
Analysis of technical and economic aspects of proposed solutions to support decision-making

-
Proactively identify and execute tasks to improve operations, reduce costs, and increase customer satisfaction

-
Developing, planning, implementing and coordinating recommendations for studies to promote innovation

-
Representation of the organization at international meetings; Interact with customers to resolve key technical issues and develop appropriate action plans

-
This position reports to the R&D Platform Owner High Performance MCB's

• Qualifications for the role

-
Bachelor's or master’s degree in electrical engineering/Mechatronics or a related field

-
At least 5 years of experience as a development engineer or design engineer

-
Strong technical knowledge in the following areas:

-
Mechanical and electrical systems of low-voltage products

-
Design of mechanical and electrical interfaces

-
Construction of plastic and metal parts

-
Manual and automated assembly processes for components in low-voltage technology

-
Good understanding of project management methodologies with proven experience

-
Good knowledge of the use of CAD software, preferably Solidworks

-
Strong written and spoken communication skills (German and English)

-
Experience working with global suppliers, manufacturing and engineering resources

ABB Smart Buildings digitizes commercial, industrial and residential buildings for the highest levels of comfort, efficiency, safety and protection – and increases the quality of life in buildings of the future through safe, intelligent and sustainable electrification solutions, services and products.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the deployment of the quality strategy for a local organisational unit, including quality culture, systems, tools, and competent teams with the aim to achieve and exceed customer expectations, while ensuring sustainable operations. Each day, you will assist the organization in achieving the right mix of prevention, continuous improvement, robust root cause analysis, quick response, and sustainable solutions to problems. You will also showcase your expertise by collaborating with local functions that impact the quality results to reach the targets for the organizational unit and aim for world-class performance.

The work model for the role is: #LI- hybrid

This role is contributing to the Power Protection, Smart Power division in Quartino, Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing the customer and processes issues systematically to identify root causes and initiate cases in the Practical Problem Solving (PPS) tool to track corrective activities and ensure resolution.

  • Presenting quality reports and improvement initiatives to customers, with systematic follow-up on agreed actions.

  • Defining containment, corrective, and preventive actions. Facilitate Level 2 Quality Circles and escalate critical cases to the line manger when necessary.

  • Contributing to the improvement of key quality metrics including First Pass Yield (FPY) manufacturing, Supplier PPM, Customer DPU, and overall Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).


You will join a dynamic, talented and high-performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in quality or equivalent role

  • Deep understanding of quality processes, problem-solving methodologies, and continuous improvement tools

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with proven ability to engage stakeholders at all organisational levels

  • Flexibility to work beyond standard hours and perform effectively under pressure

  • Fluent in English and Italian (written and spoken)

  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification is a plus

  • Willingness to travel up to 10% of the time for customer visits and site inspections​


More about us

ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

You will also monitor CTQ and quality indicator of OEE to take preventive action on quality problems and supervising the release of production batches in accordance with quality prescriptions.

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

- Performing series release tests of manufactured components or products and monitoring the results.

- Participating in shopfloor meetings within production.

- Resolving internal claims in cooperation with other departments.

- Conducting first‑line internal non‑conformity analysis and initiating the problem‑solving process in case of escalation.

- Managing Q‑data including deployment of quality control procedures in Q‑software and adjustment of process parameters.

- Controlling and reporting production‑related Q‑KPIs such as internal failure costs, CTQs, and FPY.

- Providing quality training to production staff, supervising test equipment, and carrying out process audits and confirmations.

• Qualifications for the role:

- Test equipment verification including calibration.

- Technical background in electrical and/or mechanical fields.

- Experience performing release tests for serial production.

- Understanding of Q‑KPIs and control charts.

- Knowledge of process audits and related quality methods.

- Good language skills in German and English, written and spoken.

- Goal‑oriented, problem‑solving mindset with L6S knowledge (yellow/green belt preferred), collaborative approach, initiative, teamwork ability, and responsiveness.

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

Be part of something bigger. This is where progress is powered, teams initiate action, and we move the world forward together. Run What Runs the World.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

SST Product Architect

__

Your role and responsibilities

We are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced Senior Power Electronics Testing and Laboratory Specialist to be part of the expansion of our business with a novel solid state transformer technology for datacenter applications. In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of the ELDS R&D center of excellence team for Solid State Transformer in charge of the design and development of the future Solid State Transformer products family with first focus on Data Center application requirements. In this context, and as part of the R&D SST development team, the Senior Testing and Laboratory Specialist will have special focus on the implementation and execution of the validation, qualification and certification testing activities and protocols for components, sub-systems and systems within the internal and external R&D and Production Lab facilities for the new ABB SST offering. The location for this position is Baden-Daettwil in Switzerland, with relocation possibilities to other production locations.

You will be mainly responsible for:

  • Member of the SST for Data Center R&D team, leading the testing activities in R&D labs for the Validation, Qualification and Certification of the SST components, sub-systems and systems using the R&D Prototypes and Tests Units in the existing and new internal testing setups and areas and in external facilities. This includes planning, practical implementation and execution, analysis and documentation activities of SST tests, with close interaction with program manager, product architect, other R&D engineers, testing and laboratory specialists and technicians.

  • Responsible for the definition of the SST dedicated lab test processes and protocols, infrastructure, areas and equipment, with active interaction and collaboration with the different stakeholders in the different locations involved (CH, CZ, IT, US), including the Lab Infrastructure and the Health Safety and Environment (HSE) teams.

  • Close support and collaboration with the productization and factory teams for the SST production testing activities, involving the definition of the test specifications, the training of testing engineers, test data and results documentation, adaptation of tests protocols, etc.

  • Contribution to the maintenance and further development of the key Power Electronics Technologies Expertise and Know-How of the SST for Datacenters R&D team in testing, validation and certification.

You will be part of advanced R&D activities in the field of power electronics for the ABB SST for Datacenter Products, in close cooperation with a highly qualified senior team of R&D engineers and scientists in a global and multicultural setup.

• Qualifications for the role

  • University, University of Applied Sciences Bachelor or Master degree, or Equivalent Experience in the field of electrical engineering with focus on Power Electronics testing, validation, qualification and certification.

  • Solid background experience and high interest on practical R&D experimentation, testing and validation in Medium Voltage and High Power lab environment for the introduction to the market of Power Electronics converter new products and functionalities. Expertise in solutions and components validation, productization and certification in MV environment is desired.

  • Know-how and expertise in test systems, equipment and infrastructure related to the validation and qualification of power electronics components and sub-systems testing, including protocols for safety, quality, reliability, and certification.

  • Interest in applied research and development, self-organized, motivated person, that likes to work in a highly qualified research and development team composed of experts in different domains and global locations.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English. German is a plus.

  • Availability to travel sporadically.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). The recruiting process is being led by Ece Özen, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Order Management Specialist

__

In this role, you have the opportunity to provide customer support. You are a problem solver for all inquiries, including technical support as well as assistance with orders, delivery performance questions, and payments—to achieve the targeted goals regarding service quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. You implement the customer service strategy daily to increase operational excellence and customer satisfaction in the sales process. Additionally, you bring in your expertise by supporting the achievement of defined goals, monitoring progress, and implementing improvement measures as needed. In your role, you serve as an interface with internal and external partners to ensure a smooth flow of order processing.

The working model is: #LI-hybrid

This role contributes to the Local Product Group Smart Buildings in the Switzerland region. Key contacts are internal and external customers, sales, logistics, product marketing, procurement, planning, and quality assurance.

You will be part of a young, dedicated, experienced, and customer-focused team in which you can develop and actively contribute to continuous improvement.

Your main responsibilities will be:

-
Close collaboration with internal and external customers via meetings, email, and Teams.

-
Processing orders, complaints, and returns through coordination with sales, product marketing, logistics, quality, planning, scheduling, and other internal teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery of products to customers.

-
Serving as the first point of contact for customer inquiries and orders as well as ensuring the resolution of customer problems.

-
Support in pre-sales or after-sales service by solving customer problems and ensuring effective and efficient customer communication using specific commercial communication tools.

What we’re looking for:

-
You have commercial training/education, ideally with further training in foreign trade or at a higher vocational education level (e.g., HF).

-
At least 1 year of professional experience, preferably in sales support, order processing, or comparable areas.

-
You are proficient in SAP Sales & Distribution, MS Office, and customer communication tools.

-
You are a team player with a solution-oriented and independent work style, strong communication skills, and a positive attitude towards change.

-
You have a good understanding of logistics processes.

-
You communicate confidently in German and English.

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables the optimization of energy efficiency, security, protection, and comfort for all types of buildings—both for new construction and retrofit solutions. The division offers integrated digital technologies for controlling HVAC, lighting, blinds, and security as well as solutions for energy distribution, including DIN rail products, enclosures, emergency lighting, and industrial connectors and conventional installation materials. The division's highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve the worldwide increasing demand from real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meet social and environmental requirements, and support even the most complex CO₂ reduction strategies of customers.

The recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Partner Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

In this role, you will manage the marketing of ABB’s training service offerings for Medium Voltage Drives, targeting defined market segments and ensuring alignment with market needs and business line strategy. You will be accountable for the full lifecycle of the offering portfolio, from development and launch to go-to-market, maintenance, pricing, and profitability.

You will own the long-term profitable growth of the training services portfolio, ensuring offerings are scalable, competitive, and deliver customer value. By collaborating across functions and regions, you will support business results and continuously optimize performance, enabling high-quality service execution and capability development worldwide.

Location

This role is open globally, with preferred locations in Poland, Switzerland, Finland, China, India, and the United States. The work model is hybrid #LI-hybrid.

• Responsibilities

- Own and manage the global training services portfolio for Medium Voltage Drives, ensuring clear service definitions and scalability.

- Drive full lifecycle management of training services (concept, development, launch, scaling, phase‑out).

- Define training service roadmap aligned with business line strategy and product lifecycle evolution.

- Collaborate with sales, service, and regional teams to identify skill gaps and position training as part of service solutions.

- Translate installed base and modernization needs into targeted training offerings that improve execution and win rates.

- Enable field teams and customers through structured, role-based training paths and service offerings.

- Track performance (revenue, utilization, customer satisfaction) and drive continuous improvement and profitability.

- Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards across global training services

• Qualifications

- Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Management, or related field.

- Several years of experience in training services, adult education, or service product management.

- Strong understanding of industrial service environments and capability development.

- Proven experience working in global, cross-functional and matrix organizations.

- Commercial mindset with ability to manage service portfolios and lifecycle.

- Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

- Ability to translate technical/operational needs into scalable service offerings.

- Customer- and safety-oriented, with proactive and collaborative approach.

We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. Run What Runs the World.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit careers.abb to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for the operational execution of medium-size customer projects within the Medium Voltage Switchgear business, from order handover through delivery and close-out. You will ensure disciplined project execution in line with contractual requirements, internal processes, and quality standards. Acting as the central coordination point, you will closely interface international factories, engineering, production, logistics, and local stakeholders to ensure reliable delivery, cost control, and customer satisfaction.

The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

This role is contributing to the Medium Voltage Switchgear business within the Electrification Distribution Solutions division in Switzerland.

You will be mainly accountable for:

- Owning end-to-end project execution towards the customer, coordinating with factory-based project managers, engineering, production, and logistics to deliver according to scope, schedule, cost, and quality commitments.

- Actively driving detailed planning, progress tracking, expediting, and interface management, with a strong focus on delivery reliability, issue resolution, and adherence to milestones.

- Managing project financials, risks, changes, and claims in close alignment with internal stakeholders, ensuring early identification of deviations and implementation of corrective actions.

- Leading project close-out activities, including customer acceptance, documentation completeness, and the structured capture, evaluation, and implementation of lessons learned to continuously improve project execution.

• Qualifications for the role:

- You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering field, or a higher professional education qualification in engineering (e.g. Höhere Fachschule), with strong relevance to electrical products and systems.

- You have several years of hands-on experience managing or coordinating industrial customer projects, ideally within medium voltage switchgear, or complex engineered products.

- You have solid practical experience applying project management methodologies (e.g. IPMA, PMP, or equivalent) in an operational, delivery-focused environment.

- You are highly proficient in project execution tools, including MS Office, MS Project, SharePoint, Teams, and SAP, and use them actively to drive transparency and control.

- You are confident working with international factories and cross-functional teams, with strong skills in interface management, expediting, and problem solving.

- You bring sound knowledge of contracts, change management, and claim handling, and are comfortable addressing deviations with internal and external stakeholders.

- You communicate fluently in German and English (minimum C1 level in both), demonstrate a pragmatic, resilient mindset, and are comfortable operating in a fast-paced, execution-driven environment.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.

With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations.

We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). The recruiting process is being led by Reto Korstick, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com .

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Garantirai l'esecuzione del progetto disciplinata in linea con i requisiti contrattuali, i processi interni e gli standard di qualità. Essendo il punto di coordinamento centrale, si interfaccia a stretto contatto con fabbriche internazionali, ingegneria, produzione, logistica e stakeholder locali per garantire la consegna affidabile, il controllo dei costi e la soddisfazione del cliente. Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: ibrido #LI-hybrid Questo ruolo contribuisce al business Medium Tensione Switchgear nella divisione Elettrification Distribution Solutions in Svizzera. Sarete principalmente responsabili per: - Possedere l'esecuzione di progetto end-to-end verso il cliente, coordinando con i project manager basati sulla fabbrica, l'ingegneria, la produzione e la logistica per fornire secondo scopi, programmi, costi e impegni di qualità. - Guidare attivamente pianificazione dettagliata, monitoraggio dei progressi, expediting e gestione dell'interfaccia, con una forte attenzione all'affidabilità della consegna, risoluzione dei problemi, e l'adesione a pietre miliari. - Gestione finanziaria dei progetti, dei rischi, dei cambiamenti e dei reclami in stretta allineamento con gli stakeholder interni, assicurando l'identificazione precoce delle deviazioni e l'attuazione delle azioni correttive. - Le principali attività di chiusura del progetto, tra cui l'accettazione del cliente, la completezza della documentazione e la cattura strutturata, la valutazione e l'implementazione delle lezioni imparate a migliorare continuamente l'esecuzione del progetto.
• Qualifiche per il ruolo: - Hai una laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica o in un campo di ingegneria correlato, o una qualifica di istruzione professionale superiore in ingegneria (ad esempio Höhere Fachschule), con forte rilevanza per i prodotti e sistemi elettrici. - No. Hai diversi anni di esperienza di gestione o coordinamento di progetti di clienti industriali, idealmente all'interno di switchgear di media tensione, o prodotti ingegnerizzati complessi. - No. Hai una solida esperienza pratica nell'applicazione di metodologie di gestione del progetto (ad esempio IPMA, PMP o equivalente) in un ambiente operativo, orientato alla consegna. - No. Siete altamente competenti negli strumenti di esecuzione del progetto, tra cui MS Office, MS Project, SharePoint, Teams e SAP, e utilizzarli attivamente per guidare la trasparenza e il controllo. - No. Sei sicuro di lavorare con fabbriche internazionali e team interfunzionali, con forti competenze nella gestione delle interfacce, expediting e problem solving. - No. Porti una solida conoscenza dei contratti, della gestione dei cambiamenti e della gestione dei reclami, e stai affrontando le deviazioni con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. - Si comunica fluentemente in tedesco e in inglese (minimo livello C1 in entrambi), dimostrare una mentalità pragmatica e resiliente, e sono confortevoli che operano in un ambiente veloce e guidato dall'esecuzione. La divisione Distribuzione Solutions di ABB fornisce componenti di media tensione, interruttori e soluzioni che collegano e proteggono la rete elettrica in evoluzione, garantendo una distribuzione energetica affidabile e prevedibile. Collegamo sistemi ad alta tensione a consumatori di media e bassa tensione, garantendo una fornitura continua di energia agli utenti industriali, commerciali e residenziali, consentendo l'integrazione di fonti energetiche rinnovabili nella rete. Le nostre soluzioni intelligenti, alimentate da AI, migliorano la resilienza della griglia e ottimizzano l'utilizzo del sistema elettrico. Grazie alle soluzioni connesse abilitate ABB AbilityTM, l'offerta include interruttori isolati ad aria e gas ad alta tensione (da 1 a 46 chilogrammi), interruttori a circuito chiuso ed esterno, relè di protezione, trasformatori di strumenti, sensori e soluzioni per stazioni di distribuzione. Sosteniamo i nostri clienti e partner a rimanere in vista di crescenti esigenze di elettrificazione, tecnologia e cambiamenti normativi, fornendo il potere di adattarsi a un panorama energetico in rapida evoluzione. At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Materials

__

Your role and responsibilities:
In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain vocational experience through a temporary work placement. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing personal education/employment opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Materials team at the ABB corporate research center in Switzerland. In the frame of a six-month internship scheduled to start in July or August 2026, you will be able to put theory into practice by contributing to our projects related to future energy technologies.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • You will significantly contribute to our current research projects focusing on metals, alloys, and metal matrix composites as well as the associated manufacturing processes for ABB's innovative switchgear products
  • You prepare alloys and metal matrix composites and optimize their manufacturing processes on the lab-scale
  • You analyze materials and engineering prototypes using metallographic preparation, optical microscopy and other techniques to obtain a good understanding of the relationship between process parameters, microstructure, and material performance
  • You evaluate the obtained data, document your findings and present them to the team

You will join a highly motivated and multidisciplinary team that is passionate about materials, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • You currently pursue a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Science/Engineering or a related discipline (completion of at least six semesters); official enrollment is essential
  • You have a general understanding of metals and metal matrix composite materials and the related processing technologies, and you are keen in deepening your knowledge in this field
  • You have experience in specimen preparation by metallography, microstructure analysis by light microscopy and you enjoy laboratory work
  • Experience in powder metallurgy, sintering, brazing, know-how in experimental methods (XRD, SEM, EDX, EBSD, Hardness, etc.) is an advantage
  • Fluent command of English, both written and spoken; German is a plus

What's in it for you

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

ABB Corporate Research, in close collaboration with its different business areas, is developing the foundations for the next generation of ABB products.

The Materials team at ABB’s Swiss research center in the proximity of Zurich focuses on the development and manufacturing of innovative materials to be implemented in the company’s future products. We are currently offering outstanding students the chance to join our multidisciplinary team of researchers in the field of metallic, composite and polymer materials.

The recruiting process is being led by Mara Werne, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Tax Global Process and Transformation Le

__

The Data & Systems Modernization (DSM) Program was launched in April 2025 as a strategic initiative to build a unified, company-wide data and systems framework across ABB. Building on the foundations of the Finance Transformation Program (FTP) and the HR Transformation Program (HRTP), DSM aims to simplify our complex systems landscape, harmonize relevant non-finance master data, and establish a common ERP roadmap for the whole company.

The DSM Global Indirect Tax Technology Manager is a specialist role within the DSM program, forming part of the Indirect Tax Practice Team. The role acts as the single global design authority for indirect tax within enterprise platforms and Business-led transformation programs, ensuring that indirect tax is built in once and built right across the full business lifecycle.

The position partners closely with business areas, finance, IT, transformation programs (DSM and BA initiatives), and external providers to define, standardize, and govern indirect tax determination, controls, and reporting in core systems. The objective is to reduce complexity, risk, and cost while enabling scalable, future ready compliance.

This role is based in Europe and reports to the Global Indirect Tax Practice Lead.

Your
• Responsibilities:

-
Act as the single global indirect tax design authority for indirect tax across DSM, BA transformations, and core platforms (ERP, S/4HANA, CFIN).

-
Define and own a standard global indirect tax model covering tax codes, tax triggers, determination logic, and data dependencies.

-
Own global indirect tax determination for AR, AP, and Intercompany processes.

-
Ensure indirect tax is embedded end to end across the business lifecycle: master data, procurement, order management, delivery, billing, and reporting.

-
Enable centralized indirect tax decision making, reducing local deviations, rework, and project delays.

-
Partner with IS and transformation teams to design scalable, future proof solutions aligned with regulatory change (e.g. e invoicing, digital reporting).

-
Leverage core system capabilities (e.g. SAP DRC, CFIN) to ensure consistency and reuse, avoiding bespoke solutions.

-
Improve first-time-right outcomes to reduce audit, compliance and operational risk.

-
Serve as the single global point of contact for indirect tax technology across projects and operations.

-
Enable business growth through automated, compliant and efficient indirect tax processes

Your Experiences:

-
Significant experience in indirect tax technology, ERP tax determination ERP-enabled tax transformations, or indirect tax process design, gained in house and/or in a professional services environment.

-
Typically, 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in tax, including substantial ownership of tax technology, ERP implementations or global transformation initiatives.

-
Solid understanding of indirect tax across business processes, not limited to reporting.

-
Demonstrated experience working with global ERP platforms (e.g. SAP S/4 HANA) and tax related system design.

-
Ability to translate complex tax requirements into scalable system solutions and standards.

-
Experience working in global, multi stakeholder transformation environments.

-
Advanced analytical, problem solving, and decision-making skills.

-
Skilled in clear communication and stakeholder coordination

Desirable Experiences:

-
Experience with digital reporting and e invoicing frameworks (e.g. EU VAT reforms).

-
Exposure to large scale finance or ERP transformation programs.

-
Familiarity with SAP tax and reporting tools (e.g. SAP DRC, CFIN).

Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to develop the global indirect tax technology strategy of a multinational organization. The role works closely with senior stakeholders and plays a critical role in delivering compliant, efficient and sustainable indirect tax outcomes globally.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
A l'ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner de façon plus propre, et chaque personne ici fait que cela arrive. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à gérer ce qui dirige le monde. Ce poste relève de : Tax Global Process and Transformation Le Le Programme de modernisation des données et des systèmes (DSM) a été lancé en avril 2025 dans le cadre d'une initiative stratégique visant à créer un cadre unifié de données et de systèmes à l'échelle de l'entreprise dans l'ensemble de l'ABB. S'appuyant sur les fondements du Programme de transformation des finances (PTF) et du Programme de transformation des RH (PTRH), DSM vise à simplifier notre paysage complexe de systèmes, à harmoniser les données maîtresses non financières pertinentes et à établir une feuille de route commune pour l'ensemble de l'entreprise. Le DSM Global Indirect Tax Technology Manager joue un rôle de spécialiste dans le cadre du programme DSM, qui fait partie de l'équipe des pratiques fiscales indirectes. Le rôle joue le rôle d'autorité de conception mondiale unique en matière de fiscalité indirecte au sein des plates-formes d'entreprises et des programmes de transformation dirigés par les entreprises, en veillant à ce que la fiscalité indirecte soit intégrée une fois et construite tout au long du cycle de vie de l'entreprise. Le poste est étroitement lié aux secteurs d'activité, aux finances, aux TI, aux programmes de transformation (initiatives de MSM et de BA) et aux fournisseurs externes afin de définir, normaliser et régir la détermination, les contrôles et la déclaration des impôts indirects dans les systèmes de base. L'objectif est de réduire la complexité, les risques et les coûts tout en permettant une conformité évolutive et future. Ce rôle est basé en Europe et relève du responsable des pratiques fiscales mondiales indirectes.
• Responsabilités: - Agir comme l'unique autorité mondiale de conception de l'impôt indirect pour l'ensemble des transformations DSM, BA et plates-formes de base (ERP, S/4HANA, CFIN). - Définir et posséder un modèle mondial standard de fiscalité indirecte couvrant les codes fiscaux, les déclencheurs fiscaux, la logique de détermination et les dépendances en matière de données. - Oui. Détermination globale de la fiscalité indirecte pour les processus AR, AP et Intercompany. - S'assurer que la taxe indirecte est intégrée à la fin du cycle de vie de l'entreprise : données maîtresses, achats, gestion des commandes, livraison, facturation et rapports. - Permettre une prise de décision centralisée en matière de fiscalité indirecte, en réduisant les écarts locaux, en retravaillant et en retardant le projet. - Établir des partenariats avec les équipes de l'IS et de la transformation pour concevoir des solutions évolutives et futures, alignées sur les changements réglementaires (p. ex. facturation, rapports numériques). - Tirer parti des capacités du système central (par exemple SAP RDC, CFIN) pour assurer la cohérence et la réutilisation, en évitant les solutions sur mesure. - Améliorer les résultats de première fois pour réduire les risques de vérification, de conformité et de fonctionnement. - Servir de point de contact mondial unique pour les technologies fiscales indirectes dans tous les projets et opérations. - Favoriser la croissance des entreprises grâce à des processus de fiscalité indirecte automatisés, conformes et efficaces Vos expériences : - Expérience importante dans la technologie de la fiscalité indirecte, la détermination de la taxe ERP Les transformations fiscales ERP, ou la conception de processus de fiscalité indirecte, acquises en maison et/ou dans un environnement de services professionnels. - Typiquement, 10 ans et plus d'expérience progressivement responsable en matière d'impôt, y compris la propriété substantielle de la technologie fiscale, la mise en œuvre de PGI ou des initiatives de transformation mondiale. - Une bonne compréhension de l'impôt indirect dans tous les processus commerciaux, sans se limiter à la déclaration. - Expérience démontrée de travail avec les plateformes ERP mondiales (par exemple SAP S/4 HANA) et la conception du système fiscal. - Capacité de traduire des exigences fiscales complexes en solutions et en normes évolutives. - Expérience de travail dans des environnements de transformation mondiaux et multi-acteurs. - Compétences avancées en analyse, résolution de problèmes et prise de décisions. - Compétence en communication claire et coordination avec les parties prenantes Expériences souhaitables: - Expérience en matière de rapports numériques et de cadres de facturation (par exemple, réformes de la TVA dans l'UE). - Exposition à des programmes de financement à grande échelle ou de transformation des ERP. - Connaissance des outils de déclaration et d'imposition SAP (par exemple SAP RDC, CFIN). Pourquoi nous rejoindre Ce rôle offre l'occasion de développer la stratégie mondiale en matière de technologies fiscales indirectes d'une organisation multinationale. Ce rôle travaille en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants de haut niveau et joue un rôle essentiel dans l'obtention de résultats fiscaux indirects conformes, efficaces et durables à l'échelle mondiale. Die Service Division von ABB arbeitet mit unseren Kund*innen zusammen, um die Verfügbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Vorhersagbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit von elektrischen Produkten und Anlagen zu verbessern. At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità:

In questo ruolo, contribuirai all'implementazione della nostra strategia di qualità in tutta l'unità organizzativa locale, promuovendo una forte cultura della qualità e implementando sistemi efficaci, strumenti e team qualificati, tutti incentrati sul superamento delle aspettative dei clienti e sul mantenimento di operazioni sostenibili. Ogni giorno, bilancerai prevenzione, miglioramento continuo e risposta rapida alle sfide di qualità, collaborando con team interfunzionali per migliorare i risultati di qualità. Il tuo lavoro supporterà direttamente l'unità organizzativa nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi di performance e nel progresso verso standard di livello mondiale.

Il modello di lavoro per questo ruolo è in sede: #LI-Onsite #Work-Shifts

Questo ruolo contribuisce alla divisione Critical Power, Smart Power presso Quartino, Svizzera.

Sarai principalmente responsabile di:

  • Supportare attivamente le linee di produzione come primo punto di contatto per le questioni relative alla qualità.
  • Tracciare e registrare sistematicamente tutte le non conformità generate dalle linee di produzione.
  • Contribuire al miglioramento degli indicatori chiave di qualità, principalmente il First Pass Yield (FPY) e il costo complessivo della scarsa qualità (COPQ).
  • Segnalare tempestivamente e accuratamente le non conformità al fornitore.
  • Controllare, implementare e migliorare continuamente i controlli di qualità per migliorare la qualità dei prodotti e il controllo dei processi.
  • Gestire il magazzino dei prodotti non conformi e lavorare attivamente per ridurre i livelli di inventario.

• Requisiti per il ruolo:

  • Tecnico meccanico o elettrico o settore correlato.
  • Minimo 2 anni di esperienza in ruoli relativi alla qualità o equivalenti.
  • Profonda conoscenza dei processi di qualità, comprese le metodologie di risoluzione dei problemi e gli strumenti di miglioramento continuo.
  • Capacità comunicative e interpersonali con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli organizzativi.
  • Disponibilità a lavorare su turni e oltre l'orario standard quando richiesto, e capacità di lavorare in modo efficiente in situazioni impegnative.
  • La lingua principale è l'italiano, scritto e parlato.
  • La conoscenza dell'inglese è considerata un vantaggio.

Si prega di notare che le candidature e i CV devono essere inviati in inglese.

Maggiori informazioni su di noi

ABB Smart Power fornisce soluzioni di distribuzione dell'energia per data center, impianti di produzione, infrastrutture critiche ed edifici commerciali. I team tecnici della Divisione lavorare a stretto contatto con i partner del settore, fornendo soluzioni avanzate che supportano la rapida crescita, transizione e gli obiettivi di sostenibilità. Il portafoglio della Divisione comprende interruttori industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, applicazioni di avviamento motore e dispositivi di sicurezza come interruttori e relè. La sua unità Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center del mondo con soluzioni UPS avanzate ed efficienti dal punto di vista energetico. ABB Ability™ Energy Manager della Divisione fornisce una piattaforma scalabile e facile da usare che aiuta le organizzazioni a risparmiare energia e ridurre le emissioni di CO2.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Supervisor

__

Job Summary

Contributes to ensuring a safe working environment in compliance with company guidelines, guaranteeing the achievement of Production targets during the shift. Supports the Production Supervisors in the daily coordination of operational activities, providing technical assistance to operators in the assembly and packaging areas.

The work model for this role is on-site: #LI-Onsite

Main Roles and • Responsibilities

  • Monitoring and ensuring compliance with ABB safety guidelines and Code of Conduct during the shift

  • Supporting the Production Supervisor / Logistics Supervisor to ensure the correct execution of production activities

  • Providing technical support to operators (Assembly, Packaging) during daily operations

  • Acting as the reference point for on‑the‑job training of production personnel

  • Serving as the first level of contact for operational issues to be escalated to the relevant Production Supervisor

  • Participating in Level 1 Q Circles by gathering technical and quality issues and communicating them to the appropriate supervisor

License to Operate / Core Values

  • Ensuring that all personnel (within the area of responsibility) understand ABB’s core values and the group’s safety and integrity standards, and acting accordingly

  • Implementing and ensuring compliance with ABB’s Code of Conduct, tools, policies, and processes within the assigned area

Collaboration / Leadership

  • Promoting and enabling collaboration within the relevant work areas

  • Managing relationships with stakeholders in the area of responsibility and ensures alignment

Professional Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in operations, with experience in coordination roles

  • Experience in the electromechanical field

  • Previous experience in team coordination roles is considered a plus

Education

  • Vocational school diploma or equivalent

Please note that applications and CVs should be submitted in English.

More About Us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is managed by Mara Werne, Talent Partner.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

You will join a dynamic, talented, high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

IS Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will have the opportunity to own software solution architecture across multiple architecture categories and ensure its alignment with enterprise and data architecture standards. Each day, you will be responsible for the design and build, integrity, and quality of an Information Systems (IS) solution and associated IS services delivered to business. You will also showcase your expertise by consulting, advising, and supporting on the installation of new IS solutions/services, or changing existing IS solutions/services.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Ensuring that the IS solutions/services provide the required functionality, meet the expectations of business and are reliable, maintainable, compliant, and auditable.

  • Approving, signing-off, and building any solution to be implemented on ABB production environment, within the respective service line, ensuring required quality and safety standards.

  • Contributing to IS problem and incident management by identifying and eliminating the reoccurring defects.

  • Defining the technical IS solution and ensuring alignment with other modules and surrounding IS applications through cooperation and collaboration among IS solution architects and IS delivery units.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed apprenticeship (EFZ) or equivalent qualification

  • Good communication skills in German and English (both written and spoken)

  • First professional experience is a plus (internship or entry-level experience)

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team

  • Basic knowledge of MS Office (e.g., Outlook, Excel, Teams)


More about us
This recruitment process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

You will join an agile, cross‑functional team of approximately 8–15 employees focused on designing and developing new products.

This role is contributing to the Power Protection/EL/SP/R&D in Switzerland.

The work model for the role is: On Site

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Working as an independent and reliable contributor in R&D projects with limited supervision.

  • Understanding and applying applicable processes, standards, guidelines, and requirements, including architectural and design constraints.

  • Driving the achievement of assigned targets (quality, time, scope, cost) and raising and addressing risks.

  • Design and develop power converters

  • Specify components and define technical requirements with suppliers

  • Support the overall design cycle of the new product, from simulation to validation and documentation, through design and test

  • Conduct and coordinate complex analyses, develop recommendations based on technology/engineering practices and business considerations

  • Support operations and after sales organization during trouble shooting phases

  • Plan and coordinate a range of complex technology/engineering activities


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Master in Electrical/Electronics Engineering with thesis in Power Electronics or Bachelors Degree in Electrical/Electronics and equivalent work experience

  • 6+ years of electrical engineering experience

  • Experience with power electronic design topologies, knowledge of UPS technology and familiarity with the power protection

  • Mastering simulation tools -MATLAB/Simulink, LT Spice- and programming language -C-

  • Good communication skills in English, both oral and written. Other languages are an asset

  • Significant experience in working within complex organization

  • Willingness to travel occasionally (10%)


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Continuous Improvement Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support production process definition to ensure optimization of cost, quality, and on-time delivery of product. Each day, you will participate in the sequence definition, cycle time calculation, and analysis of the working phases of new production processes/products. You will also showcase your knowledge by sharing TPM and cycle time data and improvement ideas with internal teams.

Work model: #LI-Onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • TPM (Total Productive Maintenance):

  • Handle tool management activities, including but not limited to maintenance, purchasing, standardization, and ensuring functionality and calibration.

  • Assure production line availability assuring preventative maintenance is adhered to and review data to support improvement interventions.

  • Collaborate with internal customers and external suppliers to meet tool requirements.

  • Project Support:

  • Support Continuous Improvement Specialist with lean projects

  • Training:

  • Develop and implement training documents for TPM, 5S, ESD and other relevant areas.

  • Conduct training sessions for coworkers to enhance their skills and knowledge.

  • Time Keeping:

  • Perform time studies on all prioritized process steps to identify opportunities for improvement and increased efficiency.

  • Ensure the documented times in SAP are correct to actual base line times from your measured time study.

  • Order Processing:

  • Place and confirm orders in “Smart Buy”.

  • Tracking of orders to assure correct and timely arrival.

Your • Qualifications

  • Demonstrated a clear focus on safe work practices with a dedication to following all relevant workplace safety guidelines

  • Demonstrated work ethic characterized by motivation, willingness to handle tasks, and a willingness to take initiative.

  • Comfortable in a teaching environment with the ability to effectively communicate information to a group but also to tailor your teaching approach for individualized learning experiences.

  • Good knowledge of current tools used in operations.

  • Experience working with SAP, Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.

  • Good organization, collaborative and problem-solving skills.

  • Minimum of two years of experience in UPS manufacturing.

  • Yellow Belt certified and English language a plus

Please note that applications and CVs should be submitted in English.

More About Us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Partner Mara Werne.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Specialist


Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact. - Work model: {onsite}

  • Sells control system, instrument, and service to customers, focusing on volume, mix, and profitability targets for the assigned divisions. Establishes and maintains effective customer relationships to understand their needs, promotes their understanding of ABB’s complete offering, and aligns with them to provide a solution.
  • Ensures a positive customer experience throughout the sales process. Prepares sales plans using ABB authorized tools. Creates added value for the customer and ABB and ensures the successful outcome of transactions, contracts, and proposals, by using effective sales techniques. Communicates to the customers about the details related to delivery time, payments, and general terms and conditions, in line with ABB’s offering and strategy.
  • Ensures efficient marketing activities and communicates value proposition to customers. Manages administrative procedures in sales processes and supports cash collection and project management activities, when needed .Prepares offers in coordination with the bid and proposal department and/or the Marketing/Sales Manager. Ensures appropriate technical and financial aspects of offers are in place, including prices and trading conditions.

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Portfolio Management. Market Intelligence. Go-to-market Strategy. Customer Experience Success. Regulation & Legal Compliance
  • Budget & Performance Targets. Account Management. Business Development & Adoption. Sales Enablement General Sales Practices. Channel Sales. Contract & Risk Management. Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office(Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)
  • Proficient communication in English, Cantonese and Putonghua(Mandarin). Able to work in multiple locations

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

Sarete principalmente responsabili per: - No. Mantenere competenze riconosciute in un settore specifico integrando gli ultimi sviluppi in tecnologie, strumenti e metodologie nel vostro lavoro. - No. Trovare nuovi modi di risolvere i problemi seguendo le vostre idee, creando ipotesi e definendo modi per convalidarli. - No. Documentazione dei risultati del lavoro (come risultati, progetti o software), permettendo ad altri di mantenere e migliorare. - No. Comprendere e avviare la generazione di IP nella vostra area di specializzazione e partecipare allo sviluppo di strategia IP del progetto.
