• Qualifiche per il ruolo - No. Siete altamente qualificati e appassionati nella modellazione e nella simulazione di reti di distribuzione elettrica, sia in AC che in DC, compresi i Convertitori di potenza, Interruttori di circuito, Fusibili, ecc. - No. Hai 5 anni di esperienza in Analisi della selettività, Flussi di carico e Analisi Transienti & Ottimizzazione - No. Esperienza nel lavoro come Senior Power Systems Architetto con strumenti di ingegneria informatici - No. Siete qualificati in MATLAB - Simulink, PSCAD, PowerFactory, PSS®E, EMTP-ATP, ecc. - No. Esperienza dimostrata in Ingegneria Elettrica (Power Electronic Systems) - No. Sei a tuo agio a comunicare in inglese (lingua italiana considerata un plus) Cosa c'è dentro per te? Ti forniamo il potere di prendere il comando, condividere idee audaci e modellare risultati reali. Crescerai attraverso esperienza pratica, mentorship e apprendimento che si adatta ai tuoi obiettivi. Qui, il vostro lavoro non importa solo, muove le cose in avanti Ulteriori informazioni su di noi ABB Smart Power fornisce soluzioni di distribuzione energetica per data center, impianti industriali e produttivi, infrastrutture critiche e edifici commerciali. I team tecnici della Divisione lavorano a stretto contatto con i partner del settore, offrendo soluzioni avanzate che supportano obiettivi di crescita rapida, transizione energetica e sostenibilità. Il portafoglio della Divisione comprende interruttori industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, applicazioni di avviamento motore e dispositivi di sicurezza come interruttori e relè. La sua unità Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center del mondo con soluzioni UPS ad alta efficienza energetica. ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager offre una piattaforma scalabile e facile da usare che consente alle organizzazioni di risparmiare energia e ridurre le emissioni di CO2. Maintenir une expertise reconnue dans un domaine particulier en intégrant les derniers développements en matière de technologies, d'outils et de méthodologies dans votre travail. - Oui. This position reports to:

Production Supervisor

__

Job Summary

Contributes to ensuring a safe working environment in compliance with company guidelines, guaranteeing the achievement of Production targets during the shift. Supports the Production Supervisors in the daily coordination of operational activities, providing technical assistance to operators in the testing areas.

Your Roles and • Responsibilities

  • Monitoring and ensuring compliance with ABB safety guidelines and Code of Conduct during the shift

  • Supporting the Production Supervisor to ensure the correct execution of production activities

  • Providing technical support to operators (Testing) during daily operations

  • Acting as the reference point for on‑the‑job training of production personnel

  • Serving as the first level of contact for operational issues to be escalated to the relevant Production Supervisor

  • Participating in Level 1 Q Circles: gathers technical and quality issues and communicating them to the appropriate supervisor

The work model for this role is on-site: #LI-Onsite

License to Operate / Core Values

  • Ensuring that all personnel (within the area of responsibility) understand ABB’s core values and the group’s safety and integrity standards, and act accordingly

  • Implementing and ensuring compliance with ABB’s Code of Conduct, tools, policies, and processes within the assigned area

Collaboration / Leadership

  • Promoting and enabling collaboration within the relevant work areas

  • Managing relationships with stakeholders in the area of responsibility and ensures alignment

Professional Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in operations, with experience in coordination roles

  • Experience in the electrical/electronic field

  • Previous experience in team coordination roles is considered a plus

Education

  • Vocational school diploma or equivalent

Please note that applications and CVs should be submitted in English.

More About Us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment process is managed by Mara Werne, Talent Partner.

At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:
Global Training Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to design, develop and deliver technical trainings in person or remotely to participants across the globe. Each day, you will make sure to prepare highly qualified ABB and Channel Partner front-end sales personnel worldwide who are confident in their product knowledge, sales techniques, and ability to effectively communicate the value of our products and solutions to customers. You will also showcase your expertise by guaranteeing excellent customer service and securing high level of customer satisfaction through trainings.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the to the Critical Power business line in the Electrification Smart Power division. Main stakeholders are Sales, Product Management, Project Management, and Engineering.

You will be mainly accountable for:

- Preparing and delivering training courses in classroom, online, or on-site and following up on pre- and post-training activities (e.g., training needs and feedback collection, and preparing course material, tools, and equipment).

- Designing and developing lesson plans and course material for classroom, on-site and online training in own area of responsibility, and advising on updates needed in e-learning material. Creating and updating course descriptions and training programs. Considering feedback given on courses and implementing corrective actions to ensure continuous improvement

- Supporting the Center of Expertise Bid & Proposal and other teams/units in the Power Protection organization when necessary by using own expertise.

- Supporting Training Coordinators in making course arrangements, answering course enquiries, and providing proposals for training courses.

Our team dynamics
You will join a dynamic, motivated, and performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role

- You have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in the critical power field, with roles in Training, Sales, Service, or R&D. Experience with UPS, STS, PDU, Power Conditioning Systems, and Battery Systems is desirable.

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent.

- Further education in adult teaching is a plus.

- Possess the ability to learn, understand, and apply new technologies.

- You enjoy working with methodologies for facilitating adult learning and communication.

- You possess a self-motivated mindset, are innovative in communication skills, and are passionate about interpersonal skills.

- You are at ease communicating in English. Proficiency in additional languages is beneficial.

ABB , aiutiamo le industrie a gestire più snella e più pulita, e ogni persona qui lo fa accadere. Sarete autorizzati a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che gestisce il mondo.

Questa posizione riporta a:
Global Training Manager

Non lo so.

Il vostro ruolo e responsabilità

In questo ruolo, avrete l'opportunità di progettare, sviluppare e fornire allenamenti tecnici di persona o in remoto ai partecipanti di tutto il mondo. Ogni giorno, vi assicurerete di preparare personale altamente qualificato di vendita ABB e Channel Partner in tutto il mondo che sono fiduciosi nella loro conoscenza del prodotto, tecniche di vendita e la capacità di comunicare efficacemente il valore dei nostri prodotti e soluzioni ai clienti. Potrai anche mostrare la tua esperienza garantendo un servizio clienti eccellente e garantendo un alto livello di soddisfazione del cliente attraverso allenamenti.

Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è: ibrido

Questo ruolo contribuisce alla linea di business Critical Power nella divisione Electrification Smart Power. I principali stakeholder sono vendite, gestione dei prodotti, gestione dei progetti e ingegneria.

Sarete principalmente responsabili per:

- Preparare e fornire corsi di formazione in aula, online o in loco e seguire le attività di pre- e post-formazione (ad esempio, le esigenze di formazione e la raccolta di feedback, e preparare materiale, strumenti e attrezzature del corso).

- Progettare e sviluppare piani di lezione e materiale didattico per l'aula, la formazione on-site e on-line nella propria area di responsabilità, e consigliare sugli aggiornamenti necessari in materiale e-learning. Creazione e aggiornamento delle descrizioni dei corsi e programmi di formazione. Considerando il feedback dato sui corsi e implementando azioni correttive per garantire un miglioramento continuo

- Sostenere il Center of Expertise Bid & Propost e altre squadre/unità nell'organizzazione Power Protection quando necessario utilizzando la propria competenza.

- Sostenere i coordinatori della formazione nell'organizzazione del corso, rispondere alle richieste dei corsi, e fornire proposte per corsi di formazione.

La nostra dinamica di squadra
Ti unirai a un team dinamico, motivato e performante, dove potrai prosperare.

• Qualifiche per il ruolo

- Hai un’esperienza minima di 3 anni nel campo della potenza critica, con ruoli in Formazione, Vendite, Servizio o R&D. L'esperienza con UPS, STS, PDU, sistemi di condizionamento di potenza e sistemi di batteria è auspicabile.

- Laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica o equivalente.

- L'ulteriore istruzione nell'insegnamento degli adulti è un vantaggio.

- Possede la capacità di imparare, capire e applicare nuove tecnologie.

- Ti piace lavorare con metodologie per facilitare l'apprendimento e la comunicazione degli adulti.

- Possiedi una mentalità auto-motivata, sono innovative nelle capacità di comunicazione, e sono appassionati di abilità interpersonali.

- Sei a tuo agio a comunicare in inglese. La competenza in altre lingue è utile.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente prende tutti i tipi di menti: i curiosi, i coraggiosi e i creativi. Ecco perché accogliamo le persone da tutti gli sfondi e le esperienze.

Pronti a fare un impatto?

Applicare o visitare https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen – und jeder Mensch macht das hier. Sie werden ermächtigt, zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen, und stolz auf die Auswirkungen, die wir zusammen schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie zu laufen, was die Welt führt.

Diese Position meldet:
Global Training Manager

...

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung

In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, technische Schulungen persönlich oder remote an Teilnehmer weltweit zu entwerfen, zu entwickeln und zu liefern. Jeden Tag stellen Sie sicher, hochqualifizierte ABB und Channel Partner-Front-End-Vertriebspersonal weltweit vorzubereiten, die in ihren Produktkenntnissen, Verkaufstechniken und in der Lage sind, den Wert unserer Produkte und Lösungen effektiv an Kunden zu kommunizieren. Sie präsentieren auch Ihr Know-how, indem Sie einen exzellenten Kundenservice und eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit durch Schulungen garantieren.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: hybrid

Diese Rolle trägt zur Critical Power Business-Linie im Bereich der Electrification Smart Power bei. Hauptakteure sind Vertrieb, Produktmanagement, Projektmanagement und Engineering.

Sie werden hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

- Vorbereitung und Bereitstellung von Schulungen in Klassenzimmern, online oder vor Ort und auf Vor- und Nachbildungsmaßnahmen (z.B. Schulungsbedarf und Feedback-Sammlung, Vorbereitung von Kursmaterial, Werkzeugen und Geräten).

- Konzeption und Entwicklung von Unterrichtsplänen und Kursmaterial für Klassenzimmer, Vor-Ort- und Online-Ausbildung im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und Beratung auf Updates, die im E-Learning-Material benötigt werden. Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Kursbeschreibungen und Trainingsprogrammen. Rückmeldungen zu Kursen und Durchführung von Korrekturmaßnahmen, um eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu gewährleisten

- Unterstützung des Center of Expertise Bid & Vorschlags und anderer Teams/Einheiten in der Power Protection Organisation, wenn nötig mit eigener Expertise.

- Unterstützung von Ausbildungskoordinatoren bei der Durchführung von Kursvereinbarungen, Beantwortung von Kursanfragen und Vorschlägen für Ausbildungskurse.

Unsere Teamdynamik
Sie werden sich einem dynamischen, motivierten und leistungsfähigen Team anschließen, in dem Sie gedeihen können.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

- Sie haben mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich der kritischen Macht, mit Rollen in Ausbildung, Vertrieb, Service oder R&D. Die Erfahrung mit UPS, STS, PDU, Power Conditioning Systems und Battery Systems ist wünschenswert.

- Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Elektrotechnik oder gleichwertig.

- Weiterbildung in der Erwachsenenbildung ist ein Plus.

- Ermöglicht die Fähigkeit, neue Technologien zu lernen, zu verstehen und anzuwenden.

- Sie arbeiten gerne mit Methoden zur Erleichterung des Lernens und der Kommunikation von Erwachsenen.

- Sie besitzen eine selbstmotivierte Denkweise, sind in Kommunikationsfähigkeiten innovativ und leidenschaftlich an zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten.

- Sie sind einfach auf Englisch kommunizieren. Vorteile in weiteren Sprachen sind vorteilhaft.

Die Schaffung einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft nimmt alle Arten von Gedanken: die neugierig, mutig, und die kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Bereit, einen Einfluss zu machen?

Wenden Sie sich heute an oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

Chez ABB , nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres, et chaque personne ici fait que cela arrive. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à gérer ce qui dirige le monde.

Cette position porte sur :
Gestionnaire mondial de la formation

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion de concevoir, de développer et de fournir des formations techniques en personne ou à distance aux participants à travers le monde. Chaque jour, vous vous assurerez de préparer le personnel de vente ABB et Channel Partner hautement qualifié dans le monde entier qui sont confiants dans leurs connaissances des produits, techniques de vente, et la capacité de communiquer efficacement la valeur de nos produits et solutions aux clients. Vous présenterez également votre expertise en garantissant un excellent service à la clientèle et en assurant un haut niveau de satisfaction de la clientèle grâce à des formations.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est: hybride

Ce rôle contribue au secteur d'activité de Critical Power de la division Électrification Smart Power. Les principaux intervenants sont les ventes, la gestion des produits, la gestion de projet et l'ingénierie.

Vous serez principalement responsable de:

- Préparation et prestation de cours de formation en classe, en ligne ou sur place et suivi des activités de pré-formation et de post-formation (p. ex. besoins de formation et collecte de commentaires, préparation de matériel, d'outils et d'équipement).

- Concevoir et élaborer des plans de cours et du matériel didactique pour la formation en classe, sur place et en ligne dans son propre domaine de responsabilité, et donner des conseils sur les mises à jour nécessaires dans le matériel d'apprentissage en ligne. Création et mise à jour de descriptions de cours et de programmes de formation. Compte tenu de la rétroaction donnée sur les cours et la mise en œuvre de mesures correctives pour assurer une amélioration continue

- Soutenir le Centre d'expertise en matière de soumission et de proposition et d'autres équipes/unités de l'organisation Power Protection au besoin en utilisant son expertise.

- Aider les coordonnateurs de la formation à organiser des cours, à répondre aux demandes de formation et à proposer des cours de formation.

Notre dynamique d'équipe
Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique, motivée et performante, où vous pourrez prospérer.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

- Vous avez au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la puissance critique, avec des rôles dans la formation, la vente, le service ou la R-D. L'expérience avec UPS, STS, PDU, Power Conditioning Systems et Battery Systems est souhaitable.

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique ou équivalent.

- La formation continue dans l'enseignement des adultes est un plus.

- Possède la capacité d'apprendre, de comprendre et d'appliquer de nouvelles technologies.

- Vous aimez travailler avec des méthodologies pour faciliter l'apprentissage et la communication des adultes.

- Vous possédez un état d'esprit automotivé, sont innovants dans les compétences en communication, et sont passionnés par les compétences interpersonnelles.

- Vous êtes à l'aise pour communiquer en anglais. La maîtrise de langues supplémentaires est bénéfique.

• Requisiti per il ruolo - Hai esperienza sostanziale in vendite di servizi e sei altamente specializzato nel ruolo. - Mostra abilità commerciali efficaci e capacità promozionali, con un focus sull'identificazione di opportunità di business, l'ingaggio dei clienti e l'espansione della portata del mercato. - Hai abilità avanzate in sistemi di alimentazione continua o prodotti simili con un approccio motivato e orientato ai clienti. - Laurea in ingegneria elettrica (o campo tecnico correlato). - Sei a tuo agio nel comunicare in tedesco e inglese. - Qualsiasi ulteriore lingua come francese o italiano è benvenuta. - Sei disponibile a viaggiare in tutto il paese per supportare l'azienda e gli eventi, la formazione. descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Production Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, equipment performance, work instruction, and materials/components in support of production targets. You will also demonstrate your skills by defining the working phase sequence of a new production process to meet the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Power Protection

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Identifying and recommending improvement opportunities and implements improvement projects, ensuring adherence to timeframe, quality, and cost requirements.
  • Providing the necessary work instruction
  • Ensure product maintenance through the introduction of the engineering change notice
  • Approving the design for processes developed internally or externally and performing final tests with respect to the project.
  • Providing support to Production during the internal process/equipment start-up, defining action plans and training relevant maintenance and production resources.
  • Evaluating new process technologies to improve productivity, quality, and cost reduction, defining and managing testing activities, approval criteria, and external provider choices.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Degree in Electric/Mechanic Engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience in operation and production line activities.
  • Knowledge of Engineering & Manufacturing Processes.
  • Proficiency in MS Office; preferred are: 2D/3D CAD systems, sap and Windchill.
  • Knowledge of the English language.
  • Positive spirit, self-motivation, team working, efficiency and problem-solving orientation; focus on delivering results by taking responsibility for assigned tasks and projects

Benefits:

  • Attractive compensation including bonus, 13th-month salary, and participation programs (ESAP).
  • Career development through targeted training and development opportunities.
  • REKA checks for leisure and travel.
  • Company holidays between Christmas and New Year.
  • Various discounts on sports equipment, electronics, and health & wellness offers.
  • Contribution toward gym membership.

More about us:

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

We look forward to receiving your application.

The recruiting process is led by Talent Partner Pedro Labian Sanchez.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Call to action

Be part of something bigger. This is where progress is powered, teams initiate action, and we move the world forward together. Run What Runs the World.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This position reports to:

Warehouse/Internal Logistics Manager

__

In this role you will have the opportunity to lead and continuously improve warehouse and internal logistics operations in a manufacturing environment, ensuring safe, efficient and reliable material flows that support production and business objectives. Each day, you will coordinate inbound and outbound logistics activities, supervise warehouse operations, and ensure inventory accuracy while driving operational excellence.

You will also showcase your expertise by identifying and implementing continuous improvement initiatives, optimizing warehouse layout and capacity, and collaborating cross functionally to enhance service levels and efficiency.

You will join a collaborative, engaged, and performance driven team, where continuous improvement, ownership, and teamwork are strongly encouraged, and where you will be able to thrive and make a tangible impact.

Main stakeholders are Production, Planning, Quality, Engineering, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, and External Logistics Providers.

The work model for the role is: Onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Coding and preparing proper receipt/dispatch paperwork.
  • Ensuring maintenance of equipment and facilities and identifying and recommending technical equipment and facility improvements as necessary
  • Optimizing warehouse capacity, inventory, and floor utilization and supervising and assisting in daily warehouse and shipping operations
  • Recommending measures to improve service quality, increase departmental efficiency, and boost the performance of work crews and equipment; and ensuring stock accuracy by conducting periodic stock takes and/or cycle counting

• Qualifications for the role:

  • You are highly skilled in warehouse and internal logistics operations, working with ERP systems, inventory management, lean logistics, and continuous improvement methodologies within the manufacturing / industrial automation sector
  • You have at least 5 years of experience in warehouse, logistics, or supply chain operations, preferably in an industrial or manufacturing environment
  • You possess strong knowledge of ERP systems (SAP) and WMS (Warehouse management system) tools, with a solid understanding of inventory control and stock accuracy processes.
  • You are innovative and proactive, with strong problem solving and continuous improvement capabilities, and a handson leadership approach
  • You have proven experience leading or supervising operational teams, ensuring safety, performance, and adherence to procedures
  • You hold a degree or equivalent experience in Logistics, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
  • You are at ease communicating in Italian and English

What's in it for you?

  • Opportunity to work in a high technology manufacturing environment within a growing and strategic product line
  • High level of ownership and visibility, with real impact on operational performance and efficiency
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities in logistics, automation, and operational excellence

More about us (Mandatory)
ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. By connecting its engineering and digitalization expertise, ABB helps industries run at high performance, while becoming more efficient, productive and sustainable so they outperform. At ABB, we call this ‘Engineered to Outrun’. The company has over 140 years of history and around 110,000 employees worldwide. ABB’s shares are listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (ABBN) and Nasdaq Stockholm (ABB). www.abb.com

At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity, generations, etc. Together, we are embarking in a journey where each one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences.

Guide the future. This is where innovation accelerates, industries are reimagined, and your impact powers the world ahead. Run What Runs the World.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Chapter Lead

__

In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact. We are looking for an R&D Senior Hardware Engineer to join our Electrification business. The selected candidate will join a team working on High Power DC converters.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Critical member of the Systems and Electrical team, Work within a multidisciplinary team to develop world class mission critical power protection equipment
  • Performs a variety of complex technology and engineering assignments
  • Realize the design of architecture and technical details, the circuit simulation and the development of electronic projects which require knowledge of analog, digital and low power electronics
  • Take care of design optimization by identification of technical, architectural and circuitry solutions, exploiting the highest integration (mechanical part, electrical components, PCBAs, etc.) and collaborating with other departments involved in the Product Development Process
  • Carry out preliminary tests for design pre-validation
  • Support the Test Lab during all the testing phases, evaluate reports of Test Lab and Quality Laboratories and express your definitive opinion on validation of final product
  • Draw up the technical documentation of systems, components, and interfaces

Our Team Dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor or Master’s degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering
  • 5+ years' experience with electrical systems and complex power electronic systems.
  • Experience in digital and analog circuit design and simulation.
  • Experience with EMI design and troubleshooting
  • Knowledge of environmental, reliability, and safety requirements for Industrial products.
  • Knowledge and experience with Agile methodology is a plus.
  • Excellent command of English

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Critical Power unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

## Descrizione
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Chapter Lead __ Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification. In this role you will be part in pioneering a new way of working within our Smart Power Division. You will implement and lead the Agile practices at team level for one or more teams. You will guide on the Agile principles, helping the team to achieve valuable outcomes, and identify continuous improvement, bringing a data driven approach in day‑to‑day management. The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

## Mansioni
- Guide and coach Scrum teams in applying Agile practices and principles, fostering positive team dynamics, collaboration, and continuous improvement
- Develop high‑performing teams by identifying strengths and areas for growth, using effective coaching techniques, and promoting empowering Agile behaviors
- Facilitate key Scrum event s (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective) to ensure engagement, transparency, and smooth delivery
- Strengthen Agile maturity across the organization by building cross‑team alliances, improving Agile practices, and ensuring adherence to Scrum theory, practices, and guidelines

## Requisiti
- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent (this position is not embedded in the IT environment; we are open for profiles with different backgrounds like psychology, social science, engineering, business administration, economics etc.)
- 5 or more years of e xperience as Scrum Master or in a similar Agile role applying Agile principles and practices is an advantage
- Fluent command of English with Italian considered as additional advantage
- Motivated to work in an Agile, dynamic workplace and cross functional team
- Experience in leading people with the ability to earn trust while challenging the team to improve and operate outside its comfort zone
- Strong creative problem – solving skills and the ability to get things done
- Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, coaching, risk management and conflict‑resolution skills, with the ability to foster positive team dynamics and collaboration

## Contatto
Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en: At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world. This Position reports to: Fulfillment Lead Your role and responsibilities Join ABB and become a vital part of our supply chain, ensuring the seamless flow of materials from our global suppliers to our production lines. In this critical role, you will be the central point of contact for purchasing and fulfillment, where your planning and problem-solving skills will directly impact our ability to deliver high-quality products to our customers on time, every time. The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid You will be mainly responsible for - End-to-End Order Management: Manage the entire purchasing lifecycle within SAP, from creating and releasing purchase orders to actively monitoring and expediting them to align with production schedules and customer delivery deadlines. - Supplier Performance & Partnership: Drive supplier excellence by monitoring key performance indicators such as on-time delivery, quality, and lead times. You will conduct performance reviews and proactively resolve issues to strengthen our supply chain partnerships. - Logistics Coordination & Problem Solving: Oversee the inbound logistics process, including freight and customs clearance. You will be the go-to expert for handling urgent delivery situations and managing non-conformance reports to ensure operational continuity. - Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities to improve our fulfillment process by analyzing order backlogs, identifying root causes for delays, and implementing effective recovery plans. You will monitor and ensure the integrity of data exchanged through supplier EDI systems. Qualifications for the role - A degree or diploma in a technical field, Process Management, or Supply Chain Management. - Proven experience in a similar role within a manufacturing or industrial environment. - Strong, hands-on knowledge of SAP is essential for this role. - Excellent communication skills with fluency in both English and Italian. - A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic setting. - Experience with order handling, inventory management, and data analysis would be a significant advantage. More about us ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.en: At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Global Project Operations Manager __ You are responsible for supporting sales and execution in contract and risks management and ensuring consistent management of all proposals and contracts. Define and deploy the best practices and guidelines to ensure consistent and complete preparation of global risk reviews. Oversight of the contract management process, bidding submission, contract negotiations and document management as required. Key Responsibilities - Responsible jointly with the Sales Responsible to develop project specific contractual strategies, risk assessments and corresponding cost provision considerations. Work with the sales and account management team on Frame Agreements. - Overviews the legal function in reviewing and commenting on the contractual tender terms and conditions and corresponding update of the Risk Review database. Actively participates in Risk Review preparation and meetings. - Support the continuous improvement of the contract and risk management process and other improvements (e.g. rev split agreement, etc.) within the Global Business Line. Develop and maintain contract and risk management training program and contribute to regular Sales Operations Handbook updates. - Support the handover of all relevant contract and risk management aspects from tendering to execution stage. - Participate in project reviews to identify contract and risk management aspects to be addressed and support definition of corresponding mitigation strategies upon request (e.g. notifications, claims, variation orders, etc.). Participate in lessons learned exercises to assess and outline the contract and risk management related improvement areas and to divulgate the improvement actions within the organization. - Support Legal function in handling formal dispute resolution (mediation, litigation or arbitration) as required. - Maintain overview and track all ongoing significant contractual issues and communicate with business partners and management on an ongoing basis. - Be the first point of contact and act as interface between business and corresponding Group or Corporate function to address project related commercial, tax and insurance topics. - Be the first point of contact and act as interface between Integrity functions to address project related integrity Qualifications - Strong expertise in contractual terms, frame agreements, and global risk review policies, with the ability to assess and mitigate contractual and operational risks. - Solid understanding of project management, project execution models, and financial implications (FCM) throughout the project lifecycle. - Proven experience in regulatory compliance, legal frameworks, and the application of both Common and Civil Law in commercial contexts. - Skilled in negotiation and claim management, ensuring effective resolution of commercial issues and protection of business interests. - Knowledge of business strategy, sales processes, account management practices, and engineering project sales channels. - Familiarity with relevant product portfolios and the capability to translate technical offerings into commercially sound contract structures. We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger. Guide to the future. This is where innovation accelerates, industries are reimagined, and your impact powers the world ahead. descriptionByLocale.fr: Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à devenir plus efficientes et plus propres — et chaque personne ici contribue à faire cela. Vous serez habilité à prendre des initiatives, soutenu pour progresser et fier de l’impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à faire tourner ce qui fait tourner le monde. Ce poste relève de : Global Project Operations Manager Vous êtes responsable du soutien aux ventes et à l’exécution en matière de gestion des contrats et des risques, en garantissant une gestion cohérente de toutes les propositions et contrats. Définir et déployer les meilleures pratiques et lignes directrices afin d’assurer une préparation cohérente et complète des revues globales des risques. Supervision du processus de gestion contractuelle, soumission des offres, négociation des contrats et gestion des documents selon les besoins. Responsabilités clés - Responsable conjointement avec le Responsable des Ventes d’élaborer des stratégies contractuelles spécifiques au projet, des évaluations des risques et les considérations de provisions de coûts correspondantes. Travailler avec l’équipe commerciale et de gestion des comptes sur les Accords-Cadres. - Superviser la fonction juridique dans l’examen et le commentaire des termes et conditions contractuels d’appel d’offres et la mise à jour correspondante de la base de données Risk Review. Participer activement à la préparation et aux réunions de Risk Review. - Soutenir l’amélioration continue du processus de gestion des contrats et des risques ainsi que d’autres améliorations (ex. accord de partage des revenus, etc.) au sein de la Global Business Line. Développer et maintenir le programme de formation à la gestion des contrats et des risques et contribuer aux mises à jour régulières du Sales Operations Handbook. - Soutenir le transfert de tous les aspects pertinents de gestion des contrats et des risques de la phase d’offre à la phase d’exécution. - Participer aux revues de projet afin d’identifier les aspects de gestion des contrats et des risques à traiter et soutenir la définition des stratégies d’atténuation correspondantes sur demande (ex. notifications, réclamations, ordres de variation, etc.). Participer aux exercices de retour d’expérience pour évaluer et définir les domaines d’amélioration liés à la gestion des contrats et des risques et diffuser les actions d’amélioration au sein de l’organisation. - Soutenir la fonction juridique dans la gestion de la résolution formelle des litiges (médiation, contentieux ou arbitrage) selon les besoins. - Maintenir une vue d’ensemble et suivre toutes les questions contractuelles importantes en cours et communiquer de manière continue avec les partenaires commerciaux et la direction. - Être le premier point de contact et servir d’interface entre l’activité et les fonctions Group ou Corporate correspondantes pour traiter les sujets commerciaux, fiscaux et d’assurance liés au projet. - Être le premier point de contact et servir d’interface avec les fonctions Integrity pour traiter les sujets d’intégrité liés au projet. Qualifications - Solide expertise des termes contractuels, accords-cadres et politiques globales de revue des risques, avec capacité à évaluer et atténuer les risques contractuels et opérationnels. - Compréhension approfondie de la gestion de projet, des modèles d’exécution de projet et des implications financières (FCM) tout au long du cycle de vie du projet. - Expérience avérée en conformité réglementaire, cadres juridiques et application du Common Law et du droit civil dans des contextes commerciaux. - Compétences en négociation et gestion des réclamations, garantissant une résolution efficace des questions commerciales et la protection des intérêts de l’entreprise. - Connaissance de la stratégie d’entreprise, des processus de vente, des pratiques de gestion des comptes et des canaux de vente de projets d’ingénierie. - Familiarité avec les portefeuilles de produits concernés et capacité à transformer les offres techniques en structures contractuelles commercialement solides. Nous vous donnons le pouvoir de prendre des initiatives, de défier les idées et de diriger avec confiance. Vous progresserez grâce à un travail significatif, un apprentissage continu et un soutien adapté à vos objectifs. Chaque idée que vous partagez et chaque action que vous entreprenez contribuent à quelque chose de plus grand. Guidez l’avenir. C’est ici que l’innovation s’accélère, que les industries sont réimaginées et que votre impact fait avancer le monde. Run What Runs the World. #ABBCareers #RunwithABB #Runwhatrunstheworld Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent nécessite toutes sortes d’esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C’est pourquoi nous accueillons des personnes de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences. Prêt à avoir un impact ? Postulez dès aujourd’hui ou visitez https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l’impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

descriptionByLocale.it: ## Descrizione At ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a superare - più sottili e pulite. Qui, il progresso è un'aspettativa - per te, il tuo team e il mondo. Come leader di mercato globale, ti daremo ciò di cui hai bisogno per farlo accadere. Non sarà sempre facile, crescere richiede coraggio. Ma ad ABB, non correrai mai da solo. Corri ciò che fa funzionare il mondo. This Position reports to: Quality Manager ## Ruoli e Responsabilità Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità Come Senior Quality Specialist, supporterai la deploy dei Quality strategy, compresa la cultura, i sistemi e le strumentazioni per raggiungere e superare le aspettative dei clienti, assicurando operazioni sostenibili. - Aiuterai l'organizzazione a raggiungere la giusta miscela di prevenzione, miglioramento continuo, analisi di causa radicale robusta, risposta rapida e soluzioni sostenibili ai problemi. - Collaborerai con le funzioni locali che influiscono sui risultati di qualità per raggiungere gli obiettivi per l'unità organizzativa e mirare a un livello di prestazione di classe mondiale. ## Mansioni Il modello di lavoro per il ruolo è ibrido. Questa posizione contribuisce alla divisione Critical Power, Smart Power a Quartino, Svizzera. Sarai principalmente responsabile per: - Assicurare una revisione efficace e efficiente del sistema di gestione della qualità dell'unità locale in collaborazione stretta con le funzioni locali, compresi i processi e le strumentazioni per assicurare un'introduzione di prodotto, la produzione e la consegna di qualità, servizi o esecuzione di progetti, e l'identificazione di lacune e potenziale miglioramento. - Utilizzare il sistema di gestione della qualità locale per fornire ai team locali procedure e documentazione che descrivano a sufficienza le loro attività di lavoro. - Condurre l'esecuzione di audit di conformità/revisioni, preparare rapporti di audit che riassumono le scoperte, i rischi e le raccomandazioni, e comunicare i risultati alla gestione auditata. - Collaborare con il team di sourcing per l'assegnazione e la qualificazione di nuovi fornitori, eseguire audit di fornitori e seguire le azioni. - Monitorare gli indicatori di prestazione di qualità (PPM-FPY-DPU-COQ). - Stabilire un approccio strutturato per migliorare la qualità dei fornitori mediante il concetto di Quality Wins nel'organizzazione dei fornitori e l'implementazione del PPAP sito del fornitore e mantenerlo aggiornato. ## Requisiti Qualifiche per il ruolo - Laurea magistrale in Elettronica, Meccanica o Ingegneria del Management. - 5+ anni di esperienza professionale in un ruolo simile. - Profonda conoscenza dello standard ISO 9001. - Esperienza nel lavoro con metodologie analitiche basate su dati per la qualità industriale e con clienti esigenti. - Approccio forte al miglioramento continuo e alla risoluzione dei problemi. - Buone abilità di comunicazione (scritto e orale) in italiano/inglese. ## Cosa offriamo Ti unirai a un team dinamico, talentuoso e di alto rendimento, dove potrai prosperare. ## Contatto Di più su di noi ABB Smart Power è un leader tecnologico globale, con prodotti e soluzioni che rendono le forniture di energia intelligenti, connesse e protette. I suoi prodotti e soluzioni intelligenti rendono le forniture di energia più competitive migliorando l'efficienza energetica, la produttività e la affidabilità di quasi qualsiasi operazione. Noi valorizziamo le persone da diversi background. Potrebbe essere la tua storia? Candidati oggi o visita www.abb.com per leggere di più su di noi e imparare sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.
descriptionByLocale.en: ## Descrizione At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world. This Position reports to: Quality Manager ## Ruoli e Responsabilità Your role and responsibilities As a Senior Quality Specialist, you will support the deployment of the Quality strategy, including quality culture, systems and tools to achieve and even exceed customer expectations, while ensuring sustainable operations. - Assist the organization in achieving the right mix of prevention, continuous improvement, robust root cause analysis, quick response, and sustainable solutions to problems. - Collaborate with local functions that impact the quality results to reach the targets for the organizational unit and aim for world-class level performance. ## Mansioni The work model for the role is hybrid. This role is contributing to the Critical Power, Smart Power division in Quartino, Switzerland. You will be mainly accountable for: - Ensuring effective and efficient review of the local unit's Quality Management System in close collaboration with local functions, including processes and tools to ensure flawless, repeatable product introduction, manufacturing, and delivery of quality, service, or project execution, and the identification of gaps and potential for improvement. - Utilizing the local Quality Management System to provide the local teams with procedures and documentation that sufficiently describe their work activities. - Leading the execution of compliance audits/reviews, prepares audit reports summarizing findings, risks and recommendations, and communicating results to audited management. - Working with sourcing team for the new supplier assessment and qualification, performing supplier Audits and actions follow-up. - Monitoring quality performance indicators (PPM-FPY-DPU-COQ). - Establishing a structured approach to improve supplier’s quality by deploying Quality Wins concept in supplier’s organization and implementing PPAP supplier site and keep it updated. ## Requisiti Qualifications for the role - Master's degree in Electronic, Mechanical or Management Engineering. - 5+ years of professional experience in a similar role. - Deep Knowledge of the ISO9001 standard. - Experience working with data-driven analytical methodologies for industrial quality and with demanding customers. - Strong approach to Continuous improvement and problem-solving. - Good communication skills (written & verbal) in Italian/English. ## Cosa offriamo You will join a dynamic, talented and high performing team, where you will be able to thrive. ## Contatto More about us ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
descriptionByLocale.de: ## Beschreibung Bei ABB helfen wir Branchen, schneller und sauberer zu werden. Hier ist Fortschritt eine Erwartung - für dich, dein Team und die Welt. Als globaler Marktführer werden wir dir geben, was du brauchst, um es zu erreichen. Es wird nicht immer leicht sein, Wachstum erfordert Mut. Aber bei ABB wirst du nie allein laufen. Lauf, was die Welt in Gang setzt. This Position reports to: Quality Manager ## Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten Deine Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten Als Senior Quality Specialist unterstützt du die Umsetzung der Qualitätsstrategie, einschließlich Qualitätskultur, -systemen und -tools, um Kundenanforderungen zu erfüllen und zu übertreffen, während du nachhaltige Betriebe sicherstellst. - Unterstütze die Organisation bei der Erreichung der richtigen Mischung aus Prävention, kontinuierlichem Verbesserungsprozess, robustem Ursachenanalysen, schneller Reaktion und nachhaltigen Lösungen für Probleme. - Arbeite mit lokalen Funktionen zusammen, die die Qualitätsresultate beeinflussen, um die Ziele für die Organisationsabteilung zu erreichen und einen Weltklasseniveau zu erreichen. ## Aufgaben Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist hybride. Diese Position ist Teil der Critical Power, Smart Power Division in Quartino, Schweiz. Du wirst hauptsächlich für: - Eine effektive und effiziente Überprüfung des lokalen Qualitätsmanagementsystems in enger Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Funktionen, einschließlich Prozessen und Tools, um eine fehlerfreie, wiederholbare Einführung von Produkten, Herstellung und Lieferung von Qualität, Dienstleistungen oder Projektumsetzung sicherzustellen, sowie die Identifizierung von Lücken und potenziellem Verbesserungspotenzial. - Benutze das lokale Qualitätsmanagementsystem, um den lokalen Teams Verfahren und Dokumentationen bereitzustellen, die ihre Arbeitsaktivitäten ausreichend beschreiben. - Leite die Durchführung von Compliance-Audits/Überprüfungen, bereite Auditberichte zusammen, die Erkenntnisse, Risiken und Empfehlungen zusammenfassen, und teile die Ergebnisse mit der auditierten Führung. - Arbeite mit dem Sourcing-Team zusammen, um neue Lieferanten zu bewerten und zu qualifizieren, führe Lieferanten-Audits durch und folge den Maßnahmen auf. - Überwache Qualitätsleistungskennzahlen (PPM-FPY-DPU-COQ). - Stelle einen strukturierten Ansatz zur Verbesserung der Qualität der Lieferanten durch die Implementierung des Konzepts Quality Wins in der Organisation der Lieferanten und die Implementierung des PPAP-Site des Lieferanten und halte es aktuell. ## Anforderungen Qualifikationen für die Rolle - Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau oder Betriebswirtschaft. - 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle. - Tiefes Wissen über den ISO 9001-Standards. - Erfahrung mit der Arbeit mit datengetriebenen analytischen Methoden für industrielle Qualitätszwecke und mit anspruchsvollen Kunden. - Starkes Vorgehen zum kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess und zur Problemlösung. - Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (schriftlich und mündlich) in Deutsch/Englisch. ## Was wir bieten Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen, talentierten und hochleistungsstarken Teams, in dem du dich entfalten kannst. ## Kontakt Mehr über uns ABB Smart Power ist ein globaler Technologieführer, mit Produkten und Lösungen, die die Energieversorgung intelligent, vernetzt und geschützt machen. Seine intelligenten Produkte und Lösungen machen die Energieversorgung effizienter, produktiver und zuverlässiger, fast für jede Operation. Wir schätzen Menschen aus verschiedenen Hintergründen. Könnte dies deine Geschichte sein? Bewirb dich heute oder besuche www.abb.com, um mehr über uns zu erfahren und über den Einfluss unserer Lösungen weltweit zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr: ## Description À ABB, nous aidons les industries à dépasser - plus fines et plus propres. Ici, le progrès est une attente - pour toi, ton équipe et le monde. En tant que leader mondial du marché, nous te donnerons ce dont tu as besoin pour faire en sorte que cela se produise. Ce ne sera pas toujours facile, grandir nécessite de la force. Mais à ABB, tu ne courras jamais seul. Cour, ce qui fait fonctionner le monde. This Position reports to: Quality Manager ## Rôles et responsabilités Ton rôle et responsabilités En tant que Senior Quality Specialist, tu soutiendras la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de qualité, y compris la culture, les systèmes et les outils pour satisfaire et dépasser les attentes des clients, tout en assurant des opérations durables. - Aidera l'organisation à atteindre la bonne mélange de prévention, d'amélioration continue, d'analyse de cause robuste, de réponse rapide et de solutions durables pour les problèmes. - Travaille avec les fonctions locales qui influencent les résultats de qualité pour atteindre les objectifs de l'unité organisationnelle et viser un niveau de performance mondial. ## Tâches Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est hybride. Cette position contribue à la division Critical Power, Smart Power à Quartino, Suisse. Tu seras principalement responsable de: - Assurer une revue efficace et efficiente du système de gestion de la qualité de l'unité locale en collaboration étroite avec les fonctions locales, y compris les processus et les outils pour assurer une introduction de produits, une production et une livraison de qualité, des services ou des exécutions de projets, et l'identification des lacunes et du potentiel d'amélioration. - Utiliser le système de gestion de la qualité local pour fournir aux équipes locales des procédures et des documents qui décrivent suffisamment leurs activités de travail. - Diriger l'exécution d'audits de conformité/revues, préparer des rapports d'audit qui résument les constatations, les risques et les recommandations, et communiquer les résultats à la direction auditée. - Travaille avec l'équipe de sourcing pour l'évaluation et la qualification de nouveaux fournisseurs, effectuer des audits de fournisseurs et suivre les mesures. - Surveiller les indicateurs de performance de qualité (PPM-FPY-DPU-COQ). - Établir un approche structurée pour améliorer la qualité des fournisseurs en mettant en œuvre le concept de Quality Wins dans l'organisation des fournisseurs et en mettant en œuvre le PPAP-Site du fournisseur et en le garder à jour. ## Exigences Qualifications pour le rôle - Diplôme de master en électrotechnique, mécanique ou gestion. - 5+ ans d'expérience professionnelle dans un rôle similaire. - Connaissance approfondie du standard ISO 9001. - Expérience dans le travail avec des méthodologies analytiques basées sur des données pour les besoins de la qualité industrielle et avec des clients exigeants. - Approche forte de l'amélioration continue et de la résolution des problèmes. - Bonnes compétences de communication (écrit et oral) en français/anglais. ## Ce que nous offrons Tu rejoindras un équipe dynamique, talentueuse et de haute performance, où tu pourras prospérer. ## Contact En savoir plus sur nous ABB Smart Power est un leader technologique mondial, avec des produits et des solutions qui rendent les fournitures d'énergie intelligentes, connectées et protégées. Ses produits et solutions intelligents rendent les fournitures d'énergie plus efficaces, plus productives et plus fiables, presque pour toute opération. Nous valorisons les personnes de différents horizons. Pourrais-tu être notre prochaine histoire ? Candidats-toi aujourd'hui ou visitez www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur nous et sur l'impact de nos solutions dans le monde entier.
